If the aerie protector chooses a domain as her nature bond, she must choose the ‹domain/Air›, ‹druiddomain/Eagle›, ‹domain/Earth›, ‹druiddomain/Mountain›, or ‹domain/Weather› domain. ::: ::ab[Wild Empathy (Ex)]{icon=boost-down passive="An aerie protector gains a +4 bonus on *wild empathy* checks on flying animals, but she takes a -4 penalty on checks on other animals." alter="Wild empathy"} ::ab[Sky and Stone (Ex)]{l=2 icon=boost passive="An aerie protector gains a bonus equal to ‹misc/half› her level on Knowledge (geography) and Survival checks involving mountainous terrain or high altitudes, and she cannot be tracked in such an environment." replace="Woodland stride"} ::ab[Wind at Her Back (Su)]{l=4 icon=def passive="An aerie protector gains a +4 bonus to CMD and on saving throws against the effects of high altitude and effects that rely on air pressure or strong wind to move her or impede her flight. This bonus also applies on Reflex saves against effects that deal electricity damage." replace="Resist nature's lure"} ::ab[Wild Shape]{icon=down-boost l=6 ability="An aerie protector gains *wild shape,* except her effective druid level is her druid level - 2. If she takes on the form of a flying animal, she instead uses her druid level + 2." alter="Wild shape"} ::ab[In the Wind (Ex)]{icon=boost l=9 passive="The climb and fly speeds of forms the aerie protector assumes with her *wild shape* ability (if any) increase by 10 feet. The maneuverability of her flying forms improves by one category." replace="Venom immunity"}

name: Ape Shaman
description: ## Ape Shaman ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/42› A shaman with this totem calls upon the mighty ape, a peaceful but powerful simian whose strength is beyond compare. An ape shaman is a friendly protector of the forest, but will crush those enemies who rouse her anger. ::ab[Nature Bond]{icon=info choice="An ape shaman who chooses an animal companion must select an ‹companion/ape› or related primate. If choosing a domain, the ape shaman must choose from the ‹domain/Animal›, ‹domain/Community› (Family subdomain), ‹domain/Destruction› (Rage subdomain), and ‹domain/Strength› domains." alter="Nature bond"} ::ab[Wild Empathy (Ex)]{icon=boost ability="An ape shaman can use *wild empathy* with apes and other primates as a @HLfull-round_action with a +4 bonus." alter="Wild empathy"} :::ab{title="Totem Transformation (Su)" icon=boost-magic l=2 action="Standard Action" imp7="This becomes a @HLmove_action." imp12="This becomes a @HLswift_action." useL=druid useUnit=minute useNC=1 special="This is a polymorph effect and cannot be used while the druid is using another polymorph effect, such as *wild shape.*" replace="Woodland stride"} An ape shaman may adopt an aspect of the ape while retaining her normal form. The druid gains one of the following sets of bonuses and abilities: - **Movement** (climb speed 20 ft., +4 racial bonus on Climb checks) - **Senses** (low-light vision, ‹umr/scent›) - **‹umr/Natural weapons›** (2 slams [1d6 for a Medium shaman], +2 on combat maneuver checks to ‹rule/grapple›) - **Toughness** (+2 natural armor bonus to AC, ‹feat/Endurance› feat) While using *totem transformation,* the ape shaman may speak normally and can cast ‹spell/speak with animals› (primates only) at will. ::: ::ab[Totemic Summons (Su)]{l=5 icon=boost-magic standard="An ape shaman may cast ‹spell/summon nature's ally› to summon primates, and these summoned creatures gain ‹rule/temporary hit points› equal to her druid level. She can apply the ‹template/young› template to any primate to reduce the level of the summoning spell required by one. She can also increase the level of summoning required by one in order to apply either the ‹template/advanced› or the ‹template/giant› template, or increase it by two to apply both the advanced and giant templates." replace="A thousand faces"} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{l=6 icon=down-boost ability="An ape shaman gains *wild shape,* but the ability functions at her druid level - 2. If she takes on the form of an ape, she instead uses her druid level + 2." alter="Wild shape"} ::ab[Bonus Feat]{l=9 icon=power ability="An ape shaman gains one of the following bonus feats: ‹feat/Diehard›, ‹feat/Endurance›, ‹feat/Great Fortitude›, ‹feat/Improved Bull Rush›, and ‹feat/Toughness›." special="She must meet the prerequisites for these bonus feats." imp13="The ape shaman gains another bonus feat from the list above." imp17="The ape shaman gains a third bonus feat from the list above." replace="Venom immunity"}

name: Aquatic Druid
description: ## Aquatic Druid ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/98› Shepherds of the lakes and seas, aquatic druids guard ecosystems ranging from shallows streams to deep ocean trenches, ministering to their residents and communing with the tides. ::ab[Wild Empathy (Ex)]{icon=down-boost ability="An aquatic druid's *wild empathy* functions only on creatures that have a swim speed or the aquatic or water subtype; however, she can improve the attitude of any such creature with Intelligence 2 or less regardless of type, including mindless creatures." alter="Wild empathy"} ::ab[Aquatic Adaptation (Ex)]{l=2 icon=boost-power passive="An aquatic druid gains an insight bonus on Initiative checks and Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, Survival, and Swim checks equal to ‹misc/half› her druid level in aquatic terrain, and she cannot be tracked such environments." replace="Woodland stride"} ::ab[Natural Swimmer (Ex)]{icon=power l=3 ability="An aquatic druid gains a swim speed equal to half her land speed." replace="Trackless step"} ::ab[Resist Ocean's Fury (Ex)]{l=4 icon=def passive="An aquatic druid gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against spells of the water type or the exceptional or supernatural abilities of creatures with the aquatic or water subtype." replace="Resist nature's lure"} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{l=6 icon=down ability="An aquatic druid gains *wild shape,* except that her effective druid level for the ability is equal to her druid level - 2." alter="Wild shape"} ::ab[Seaborn (Ex)]{icon=power-def l=9 passive="An aquatic druid gains the ‹subtype/aquatic› subtype, the ‹umr/amphibious› trait, and a swim speed equal to her land speed. She also can endure cold climate effects as if using ‹spell/endure elements›." replace="Venom immunity"} ::ab[Deep Diver (Ex)]{icon=def l=13 passive="A aquatic druid gains DR/slashing or piercing equal to 1/2 her level. This damage reduction also applies against spells and spell-like abilities that inflict damage by grappling or crushing (e.g., ‹spell/black tentacles›, ‹spell/crushing hand›). She never takes ‹rule/pressure damage› from deep water." replace="A thousand faces"}

name: Arctic Druid
description: ## Arctic Druid ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/98› An arctic druid watches over the stark landscape of the far frozen reaches of the world, tending the stunted and rugged life that ekes out its survival in the least habitable climes. ::ab[Arctic Native (Ex)]{l=2 icon=boost-power passive="An arctic druid gains a bonus on Initiative checks and Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks equal to ‹misc/half› her druid level in cold or icy terrain, and she cannot be tracked in cold or icy terrain." replace="Woodland stride"} ::ab[Icewalking (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost passive="An arctic druid suffers no penalty to speed or on Acrobatics, Climb, or Stealth checks in snowy or icy terrain or weather conditions and can walk across snow crusts or thin ice without breaking through." replace="Trackless step"} ::ab[Arctic Endurance (Ex)]{icon=def l=4 passive="An arctic druid ignores the effects of a cold climate as if using ‹spell/endure elements›. She is also immune to being dazzled." replace="Resist nature's lure"} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{icon=down l=6 ability="An arctic druid gains *wild shape,* except that her effective druid level for this ability is equal to her druid level - 2." alter="Wild shape"} ::ab[Snowcaster (Su)]{icon=power-magic l=9 ability="An arctic druid can see normally in ice storm, sleet storm, or similar natural snowstorms. In addition, she can prepare any druid spell with the fire subtype as a cold spell, with an identical effect but inflicting cold damage instead of fire damage." replace="Venom immunity"} ::ab[Flurry Form (Ex)]{l=13 icon=power-boost-magic ability="An arctic druid can assume the form of a swirling column of snow equivalent to ‹spell/gaseous form› at will. While in this form, she gains a circumstance bonus on Stealth checks made in cold terrain equal to her druid level." replace="A thousand faces"}

name: Bat Shaman
description: ## Bat Shaman ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/42› The bat shaman's totem is the agile bat, flitting and turning with incredible speed through even the most convoluted mazes. Her enemies do not know when she will appear, and when she does, she strikes fast and hard before disappearing into the night. ::ab[Nature Bond]{icon=info choice="A bat shaman who chooses an animal companion must select a ‹companion/dire_>bat›. If choosing a domain, the bat shaman must choose from ‹domain/Air›, ‹domain/Animal›, ‹domain/Darkness› (Night subdomain), and ‹domain/Trickery› (Deception subdomain)." alter="Nature bond"} ::ab[Wild Empathy (Ex)]{icon=boost ability="A bat shaman can use *wild empathy* with bats as a @HLfull-round_action with a +4 bonus." alter="Wild empathy"} :::ab{title="Totem Transformation (Su)" icon=boost-magic l=2 action="Standard Action" imp5="The druid may select a new option: **Movement** (fly speed 30 ft. &#91&average&#93&)" imp7="This becomes a @HLmove_action." imp12="This becomes a @HLswift_action." useL=druid useUnit=minute useNC=1 special="This is a polymorph effect and cannot be used while the druid is using another polymorph effect, such as *wild shape.*" replace="Woodland stride"} A bat shaman may adopt an aspect of the bat while retaining her normal form. The druid may select from the following sets of bonuses and abilities: - **‹umr/Natural weapons›** (bite [1d4 for a Medium shaman]) - **Senses** (‹umr/blindsense› 20 ft.) While using *totem transformation,* the bat shaman may speak normally and can cast ‹spell/speak with animals› (bats only) at will. ::: ::ab[Totemic Summons (Su)]{l=5 icon=boost standard="A bat shaman may cast ‹spell/summon nature's ally› to summon bats, and these summoned creatures gain ‹rule/temporary hit points› equal to her druid level. She can apply the ‹template/young› template to any bat to reduce the level of the summoning spell required by one. She can also increase the level of summoning required by one in order to apply either the ‹template/advanced› or the ‹template/giant› template, or increase it by two to apply both the advanced and giant templates."} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{l=6 icon=down-boost ability="A bat shaman gains *wild shape,* but the ability functions at her druid level - 2. If she takes on the form of a bat, she instead uses her druid level + 2." replace="Wild shape"} ::ab[Bonus Feat]{l=9 icon=power ability="A bat shaman gains one of the following bonus feats: ‹feat/Acrobatic›, ‹feat/Agile Maneuvers›, ‹feat/Improved Initiative›, ‹feat/Lightning Reflexes›, or ‹feat/Skill Focus› (Perception)." imp13="The druid gains another bonus feat from the list above." imp17="The druid gains a third bonus feat from the list above." special="She must meet the prerequisites for these bonus feats." replace="Venom immunity"}

name: Bear Shaman
description: ## Bear Shaman ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/102› A shaman with this focus calls upon the mighty bear, titan of the woodlands and mountains, a paragon of strength and ferocity, and yet also a quiet protector rich in wisdom. ::ab[Nature Bond]{icon=info choice="A bear shaman who chooses an animal companion must select a ‹companion/bear›. She gains one of the following bonuses: - **Movement** (+10 enhancement bonus to land speed, +4 racial bonus on Swim checks) - **Senses** (low-light vision, ‹umr/scent›) - **Toughness** (+2 natural armor bonus to AC, ‹feat/Endurance› feat) - **‹umr/Natural weapons›** (bite [1d6] and 2 claws [1d4] for a Medium shaman, +2 to CMB on grapple checks). While using *totem transformation,* the bear shaman may speak normally and can cast ‹spell/speak with animals› (mammals only) at will. ::: ::ab[Totemic Summons (Su)]{l=5 icon=boost standard="A bear shaman may cast ‹spell/summon nature's ally› to summon bears, and summoned bears gain ‹rule/temporary hit points› equal to her druid level. She can apply the ‹template/young› template to any bear to reduce the level of the summoning spell required by one. She can also increase the level of summoning required by one in order to apply either the ‹template/advanced› or the ‹template/giant› template, or increase it by two to apply both the advanced and giant templates." replace="A thousand faces"} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{l=6 icon=down-boost ability="A bear shaman gains *wild shape,* but the ability functions at her druid level - 2. If she takes on the form of a bear, she instead uses her druid level + 2." replace="Wild shape"} ::ab[Bonus Feat]{l=9 icon=power ability="A bear shaman gains one of the following bonus feats: ‹feat/Diehard›, Endurance, ‹feat/Great Fortitude›, ‹feat/Improved Great Fortitude›, ‹feat/Toughness›." imp13="The druid gains another feat from the list above." imp17="The druid gains a third bonus feat from the list above." special="She must meet the prerequisites for these bonus feats." replace="Venom immunity"}

name: Blight Druid
description: ## Blight Druid ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/98› The devoted servants of nature corrupted, ruined, and destroyed, blight druids are the caretakers of lands ravaged by natural disaster. While some are devoted to reforming and reclaiming lands despoiled by the ravages of civilization, others seek out the more rapacious violence inherent in nature and feed the creeping rot and decay that brings an end to all things. ::ab[Nature Bond (Ex)]{icon=down-power choice="A blight druid may not bond with an animal companion, but may either call a ‹sidekick/familiar› as a ‹class/wizard› of her druid level or select from the ‹domain/Darkness›, ‹domain/Death›, and ‹domain/Destruction› domains in addition to those normally available." alter="Nature bond"} ::ab[Vermin Empathy (Su)]{icon=power ability="A blight druid can improve the attitude of vermin as a normal druid can with animals. Vermin have a starting attitude of unfriendly. The blight druid can also improve the attitude of animals and mindless undead creatures that were formerly animals, but she takes a -4 penalty on the check unless the animal or undead has a disease special attack." replace="Wild empathy"} ::ab[Miasma (Ex)]{l=5 icon=lower passive="If a blight druid is adjacent to a creature at the beginning of its turn, the creature must succeed at a Fortitude save with a DC of 10 + ‹misc/half› the druid's level + the druid's Wisdom modifier or become ‹misc/sickened› for 1 round. A creature of the animal, fey, or plant type that fails its save is ‹misc/nauseated› for 1 round and sickened for 1 minute thereafter. If the creature makes its save, it is immune to this effect for 24 hours, as are creatures immune to disease." replace="Trackless step~resist nature's lure"} ::ab[Blightblooded (Ex)]{l=9 icon=def passive="A blight druid gains immunity to all diseases, including natural and supernatural diseases. She also becomes immune to effects that would cause her to become sickened or nauseated." replace="Venom immunity"} ::ab[Plaguebearer (Su)]{icon=lower l=13 passive="Any creature that strikes a blight druid with a touch attack, unarmed strike, or natural weapon must succeed at a Fortitude save with a DC of 10 + 1/2 the druid's level + the druid's Wisdom modifier or contract a disease, as the ‹spell/contagion› spell. If the creature makes its save, it is immune to this effect for 24 hours." replace="A thousand faces"}

name: Boar Shaman
description: ## Boar Shaman ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/43› A boar shaman chooses the stolid and ferocious boar as her totem. Content to be left alone, she becomes one of the most dangerous creatures of the wild when provoked. ::ab[Nature Bond]{icon=info choice="A boar shaman who chooses an animal companion must select a ‹companion/boar›. If choosing a domain, the boar shaman must choose from the ‹domain/Animal›, ‹domain/Destruction› (Rage), ‹domain/Protection›, and ‹domain/Strength› domains." alter="Nature bond"} ::ab[Wild Empathy (Ex)]{icon=boost ability="A boar shaman can use *wild empathy* with porcine creatures as a @HLfull-round_action with a +4 bonus." alter="Wild empathy"} :::ab{title="Totem Transformation (Su)" icon=boost-magic l=2 action="Standard Action" imp7="This becomes a @HLmove_action." imp12="This becomes a @HLswift_action." useL=druid useUnit=minute useNC=1 special="This is a polymorph effect and cannot be used while the druid is using another polymorph effect, such as *wild shape.*" replace="Woodland stride"} A boar shaman may adopt an aspect of the boar while retaining her normal form. The druid may select from the following sets of bonuses and abilities: - **Movement** (+10 enhancement bonus to land speed) - **Senses** (low-light vision, ‹umr/scent›) - **‹umr/Natural weapons›** (gore [1d8 for a Medium druid], +2 on combat maneuver checks to overrun) - **Toughness** (+2 natural armor bonus to AC, ‹feat/Endurance› feat). While using *totem transformation,* the boar shaman may speak normally and can cast ‹spell/speak with animals› (boars and related animals only) at will. ::: ::ab[Totemic Summons (Su)]{l=5 icon=boost standard="A boar shaman may cast ‹spell/summon nature's ally› to summon ‹monster/boar«s› or other porcine creatures, and these summoned creatures gain ‹rule/temporary hit points› equal to her druid level. She can apply the ‹template/young› template to any porcine summon to reduce the level of the summoning spell required by one. She can also increase the level of summoning required by one in order to apply either the ‹template/advanced› or the ‹template/giant› template, or increase it by two to apply both the advanced and giant templates."} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{l=6 icon=down-boost passive="A boar shaman gains *wild shape,* but the ability functions at her druid level - 2. If she takes on the form of a boar, she instead uses her druid level +2." replace="Wild shape"} ::ab[Bonus Feat]{l=9 icon=power ability="A boar shaman gains one of the following bonus feats: ‹feat/Bleeding Critical›, ‹feat/Blind-Fight›, ‹feat/Diehard›, or ‹feat/Improved Overrun›." imp13="The druid gains another feat from the list above." imp17="The druid gains a third bonus feat from the list above." special="She must meet the prerequisites for these bonus feats." replace="Venom immunity"}

name: Cave Druid
description: ## Cave Druid ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/99› Far from the green fields of the world above lies a lightless expanse beneath the surface. This darkling fairyland is not without beauty and natural wonders of its own, and a few druids seek to preserve this hidden realm and purge it of the fell horrors that creep up from below. ::ab[Cavesense (Ex)]{icon=skill-boost passive="A cave druid adds ‹skill/Knowledge (dungeoneering)› (INT) rather than Knowledge (geography) as a class skill and gains a +2 bonus on Knowledge (dungeoneering) and Survival skill checks." replace="Nature sense"} ::ab[Nature Bond]{icon=boost-down choice="A cave druid may select the ‹domain/Darkness› domain in addition to the choices normally allowed, but may not select the Air or Weather domains." alter="Nature bond"} ::ab[Wild Empathy (Ex)]{icon=power ability="A cave druid can influence oozes, rather than magical beasts, with a -4 penalty on her *wild empathy* check." alter="Wild empathy"} ::ab[Tunnelrunner (Ex)]{l=2 icon=boost passive="A cave druid can move through areas of rubble or narrow passages that require ‹misc/squeezing› at her normal movement rate and without penalty." replace="Woodland stride"} ::ab[Lightfoot (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost passive="A cave druid cannot be detected with ‹umr/tremorsense›." replace="Trackless step"} ::ab[Resist Subterranean Corruption (Ex)]{l=4 icon=def passive="A cave druid gains a +2 bonus on saves against exceptional, supernatural, and spell-like abilities of oozes and aberrations." replace="Resist nature's lure"} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{icon=down-boost l=6 ability="A cave druid gains *wild shape,* except that her effective druid level for this ability is equal to her druid level - 2. She cannot use *wild shape* to adopt a plant form." alter="Wild shape" imp10="The cave druid can assume the form of a Small or Medium ooze as if using ‹spell/beast shape III›." imp12="The druid can assume the form of a Tiny or Large ooze as if using ‹spell/beast shape IV› (treating the ooze as if it were a magical beast without a natural armor bonus)." special="When in ooze form, the cave druid has no discernible anatomy and is immune to poison, sneak attacks, and critical hits."}

name: Desert Druid
description: ## Desert Druid ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/99› Not all climates are verdant paradises, but even in the sere deserts there is life - though often hidden from the sun and rarely friendly - and raw, desolate beauty. Here desert druids come to pay homage, protect and maintain the few habitable locales, and witness nature's majesty in all its burning, merciless glory. ::ab[Desert Native (Ex)]{l=2 icon=boost-power passive="A desert druid gains a bonus on Initiative checks and Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks equal to ‹misc/half› her druid level in desert terrain, and she cannot be tracked in such environments." replace="Woodland stride"} ::ab[Sandwalker (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost passive="A desert druid suffers no penalty to speed or on Acrobatics or Stealth checks when moving through sandy or desert terrain." replace="Trackless step"} ::ab[Desert Endurance (Ex)]{l=4 icon=def-boost passive="A desert druid ignores the effects of a hot climate as if using ‹spell/endure elements›. She also has a reduced need to eat and drink, as if wearing a ‹magic-ring/ring of sustenance› (though normal sleep is still required)." replace="Resist nature's lure"} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{icon=down l=6 ability="A desert druid gains *wild shape,* except that her effective druid level for this ability is equal to her druid level - 2. A desert druid cannot use *wild shape* to adopt a plant form." alter="Wild shape" imp10="She can assume the form of a Small or Medium vermin." imp12="She can take the form of a Tiny or Large vermin." imp14="She can assume the form of a Diminutive or Huge vermin." special="Starting at 10th level, this effect functions as ‹spell/beast shape IV› (treating the vermin as an animal to determine its ability and natural armor modifiers)."} ::ab[Shaded Vision (Ex)]{l=9 icon=def passive="A desert druid becomes immune to blinding and dazzling effects and gains a +2 bonus on saving throws against ‹umr/gaze› attacks and illusions of the figment and pattern subschools." replace="Venom immunity"} ::ab[Dunemeld (Ex)]{l=13 icon=power-boost-magic ability="A desert druid can assume the form of a swirling mass of sand at will. This is equivalent to ‹spell/gaseous form›, but the druid gains a land and burrow speed of 10 feet rather than a fly speed. While in this form, the druid gains a circumstance bonus on Stealth checks made in desert terrain equal to her druid level." replace="A thousand faces"}

name: Dinosaur Druid
description: ## Dinosaur Druid ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/47› A dinosaur druid speaks for the spirit of prehistoric nature, even taking the form of great beasts of legend. ;;;ab{title="Summon Dinosaur (Sp)" action=Ability icon=magic alter="Spontaneous casting"} A dinosaur druid can summon a wide range of dinosaurs and related prehistoric beasts using ‹spell/summon nature's ally› spells. She adds the following options to these spells when using *spontaneous casting* to cast such a spell. :::div{className=hanging} ::list[Summon Nature's Ally I]{all=Compsognathus link=monster hl em} ::list[Summon Nature's Ally II]{all=Dimorphodon~troodon link=monster hl em} ::list[Summon Nature's Ally III]{all=Plesiosaurus~velociraptor link=monster hl em} ::list[Summon Nature's Ally IV]{all=Dimetrodon~pachycephalosaurus~parasaurolophus link=monster hl em} ::list[Summon Nature's Ally V]{all=Amargasaurus~ceratosaurus~iguanodon~kentrosaurus~styracosaurus link=monster hl em} ::list[Summon Nature's Ally VI]{all=Allosaurus~quetzalcoatlus~tylosaurus link=monster hl em} ::list[Summon Nature's Ally VII]{all=Therizinosaurus link=monster hl em} ::list[Summon Nature's Ally VIII]{all=Diplodocus~spinosaurus link=monster hl em} ::list[Summon Nature's Ally IX]{all=Giganotosaurus link=monster hl em} ::: ;;; ::ab[Dinosaur Bond (Ex)]{icon=info choice="A dinosaur druid must choose an animal companion as her *nature's bond,* and the animal companion must be a ‹family/dinosaur›." alter="Nature's bond"} ::ab[Dinosaur Shape (Su)]{icon=boost-down flavor="A dinosaur druid specializes in assuming the form of dinosaurs when using *wild shape.*" ability="When she assumes the form of a dinosaur via *wild shape,* she gains a +2 size bonus to her Constitution in addition to the other modifiers granted by *beast shape.* When she uses *wild shape* to assume the form of a creature other than a dinosaur, the *wild shape* effect lasts for only 1 minute per level, rather than 1 hour per level." alter="Wild shape"} ::ab[Primeval Voice (Su)]{l=4 icon=power ability="A dinosaur druid gains the ability to speak with dinosaurs (as per ‹spell/speak with animals›) at all times." replace="Resist nature's lure"}

name: Dragon Shaman

She can apply the ‹template/young› template to any eagle or roc to reduce the level of the summoning spell required by one. She can also increase the level of summoning required by one in order to apply either the ‹template/advanced› or the ‹template/giant› template, or increase it by two to apply both the advanced and giant templates."} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{l=6 icon=down-boost passive="An eagle shaman gains *wild shape,* but the ability functions at her druid level - 2. If she takes on the form of an eagle or roc, she instead uses her druid level + 2." replace="Wild shape" special="‹‹From the FAQ/https://paizo.com/paizo/faq/v5748nruor1fn#v5748eaic9raj››: The lack of suitable giant bird stat blocks in official Paizo products hinders the rules options for this archetype.~~~To remedy this problem, an eagle shaman druid can use *wild shape* to take the form of a Medium eagle (as if applying the giant creature simple template to a Small eagle), and can use *wild shape* to take the form of a Huge roc (as if applying the young creature simple template to a Gargantuan roc). Abilities of the assumed form are determined by which *beast shape* spell the *wild shape* ability functions as, as determined by the eagle shaman's effective druid level."}

name: Feyspeaker

features.name: Wild Mischief (Ex)
features.replaces: The druid's proficiency with medium armor

description: ## Feyspeaker ‹SOURCE Ultimate Intrigue/26› Some druids hear the whispers of the natural world like fey creatures do, and learn to mimic those tantalizing murmurs in order to influence the minds of both wild beasts and civilized people. These feyspeakers are often touched by the fey in some way, such as mortals who dared to eat the food and drink the wine while in the hidden halls of the fey. ::ab[Fey Magic (Part One)]{l=1 icon=down-learn flavor="A feyspeaker allows the strange idylls of the fey to guide her magic." info="The feyspeaker uses her Charisma score instead of her Wisdom score as her key spellcasting ability score (to determine her spell DCs, ‹rule/bonus spells› per day, concentration checks, and so on). A feyspeaker loses the ability to spontaneously cast *summon nature's ally* spells." imp4="A feyspeaker adds one enchantment or illusion spell from the ‹main/spells_>sorcerer›/‹main/spells_>wizard› spell list to her druid spell list as a spell of 1 level higher (for instance, at 4th level, she could add ‹spell/color spray› as a 2nd-level druid spell). In order to select a spell, she must be of a level high enough (including the increased spell level) to cast it. Once selected, the spell cannot be changed." imp6="She adds another bonus spell, following the same rules and restrictions above." imp8="She adds a third such bonus spell." imp10="She gains a fourth bonus spell." imp12="She gains a fifth bonus spell." imp14="She gains a sixth bonus spell." imp16="She gains a seventh bonus spell." imp18="She gains an eighth bonus spell." alter=Spellcasting} ::ab[Fey Speech (Ex)]{l=1 icon=skill-power-boost-down flavor="A feyspeaker's words carry a tiny fragment of the otherworldly power of the fey's voices." passive="She gains ‹skill/Bluff› (CHA), ‹skill/Diplomacy› (CHA), ‹skill/Disguise› (CHA), and ‹skill/Sense Motive› (WIS) as class skills. A feyspeaker also learns Sylvan as a bonus language. In addition, the feyspeaker gains a number of skill ranks at each level equal to 6 + her Intelligence modifier, instead of 4 + her Intelligence modifier." order=pn info="The feyspeaker's base attack bonus from her druid levels is equal to ‹misc/half› her druid level (much like a sorcerer's base attack bonus is calculated), rather than the usual druid base attack bonus." replace="Nature sense" alter="Base attack bonus~class skills~skills ranks per level"} ::ab[Wild Mischief (Ex)]{l=1 icon=power ability="A feyspeaker can fool an animal into thinking there is food, a potential mate, or a predator nearby. This ability functions just like a Bluff check to deceive a character. To determine the result of the *wild mischief* check, the feyspeaker rolls 1d20 and adds her druid level and her Charisma modifier. As with Bluff checks, *wild mischief* checks are modified depending on the believability of the false information. A typical domestic animal is not particularly suspicious of the feyspeaker (no circumstance modifier), whereas wild animals are usually suspicious (-5 penalty on the check). To use *wild mischief,* the feyspeaker and the animal must be able to study each other, which means they must be within 30 feet of one another under normal conditions. Generally, influencing an animal in this way takes 1 minute, but as when influencing people, it could take more or less time." special="A feyspeaker can also use this ability to influence a magical beast with an Intelligence score of 1 or 2, but she takes a -4 penalty on the check." replace="The druid's proficiency with medium armor"} ::ab[Fey Magic (Part Two)]{l=6 icon=magic-down flavor="A feyspeaker allows the strange idylls of the fey to guide her magic." info="The feyspeaker gains the *wild shape* ability and gains all benefits related to *wild shape* 2 druid levels later than usual. She can never use *wild shape* to transform into an elemental." alter="Wild shape"}

name: Green Faith Initiate

features.name: Zephyr Message (Sp)
features.replaces: Daily use of *wild shape* gained at 6th level

features.name: Secrets across Lifetimes (Sp)
features.replaces: Daily use of *wild shape* gained at 10th level

description: ## Green Faith Initiate ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/141;Faiths and Philosophies/10› Druids who are initiated into the magic of nature as strict students of the ‹faith/Green Faith«'s› traditions sometimes demonstrate abilities unique to their organization. ::ab[Mediator's Ear (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost passive="A Green Faith initiate is respected for her neutrality and even-handed attitude toward all people as well as other living things. She quickly develops a sense of other peoples' attitudes, much as she does with animals. A Green Faith initiate gains a bonus on Diplomacy and Sense Motive checks equal to ‹misc/half› her druid level." replace="Trackless step"} ::ab[Zephyr Message (Sp)]{l=6 icon=magic ability="Once per day, a Green Faith initiate can cast ‹spell/whispering wind› as a spell-like ability, treating her druid level as her caster level." replace="Daily use of *wild shape* gained at 6th level"} ::ab[Path to Refuge (Sp)]{l=9 icon=magic ability="Once per day, a Green Faith initiate can travel as if with ‹spell/transport via plants› to any major Green Faith druid circle or important holy site. Each of these sites is marked with special standing stones that allow all Green Faith followers within range using *transport via plants* or ‹spell/tree stride› to sense their distance from it and the direction to it." imp14="She can use this ability twice a day." imp19="She can use this ability three times a day." replace="Venom immunity"} ::ab[Secrets across Lifetimes (Sp)]{l=10 icon=magic ability="A Green Faith initiate can use ‹spell/legend lore› once per week as a spell-like ability, drawing upon the knowledge of Green Faith archdruids recorded in secret across the generations in places where magic such as this can retrieve it. This ability does not require material components." replace="Daily use of *wild shape* gained at 10th level"} ::ab[A Thousand Voices (Su)]{l=13 icon=power ability="A Green Faith initiate can communicate with any creature that has a language or with any stone, as if using ‹spell/tongues› or ‹spell/stone tell›, respectively." useL=druid useUnit=minute useNC=1 replace="A thousand faces"}

name: Jungle Druid
description: ## Jungle Druid ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/100› The fecund jungles of the equatorial regions are rich in life and ancient tradition; druidical guardians of sacred pools, elder trees, and trembling volcanoes watch over crumbling temples and the inevitable reclamation of lost civilizations by the beating heart of nature untamed. ::ab[Jungle Guardian (Ex)]{l=2 icon=boost-power passive="A jungle druid gains a bonus on Initiative checks and Climb, Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks equal to ‹misc/half› her druid level in jungle terrain, and she cannot be tracked in such environments." replace="Woodland stride"} ::ab[Woodland Stride (Ex)]{l=3 icon=power ability="A jungle druid gains *woodland stride* at this level." replace="Trackless step"} ::ab[Torrid Endurance (Ex)]{l=4 icon=def passive="A jungle druid ignores the effects of a hot climate as if under the effects of ‹spell/endure elements›. She also gains a +4 bonus on saves against disease and the exceptional abilities of animals and magical beasts." replace="Resist nature's lure"} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{icon=down l=6 ability="A jungle druid gains *wild shape,* except that her effective druid level for this ability is equal to her druid level - 2." alter="Wild shape"} ::ab[Verdant Sentinel (Ex)]{l=13 icon=power-magic ability="A jungle druid can cast ‹spell/tree shape› at will." replace="A thousand faces"}

name: Leshy Warden
description: ## Leshy Warden ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/47;Familiar Folio/7› The natural world is full of bodiless nature spirits connected to the forces of glades, springs, and individual plants. Some druids hear their call keenly and are able to effortlessly incarnate them as the miniature creatures known as leshys. The leshy warden serves as these spirits' ally, defender, and voice. ::ab[Leshy Familiar (Ex)]{icon=power ability="A leshy warden forms an intimate bond with a nature spirit, incarnating the spirit as a ‹monster/leaf leshy›. She gains a leaf leshy as a ‹sidekick/familiar› and treats her druid level as her effective ‹class/wizard› level for the purpose of this ability. If the leshy dies, the leshy warden can incarnate the same spirit again by paying the normal cost to replace a familiar. So long as the leshy lives, the leshy warden gains access to the ‹domain/Plant› domain as if through a druid's *nature bond* class feature, but she can't choose the Decay subdomain." replace="Nature bond"} ::ab[Green Empathy (Ex)]{icon=power ability="A leshy warden can improve the attitude of a plant creature as if using *wild empathy.* The typical wild plant creature has a starting attitude of indifferent. If the plant creature is mindless, the leshy warden imparts a modicum of intellect to the plant so that it can be interacted with as if it were an animal. A leshy warden can also use this ability to influence an animal, but she takes a -4 penalty on the check to do so." replace="Wild empathy"} ::ab[Leshy Summoner (Ex)]{icon=power ability="A leshy warden is an expert at summoning and growing ‹family/leshy«s›. She counts as a plant creature for the purpose of growing leshys. She adds leaf leshys, ‹monster/gourd leshy«s›, ‹monster/fungus leshy«s›, ‹monster/seaweed leshy«s›, and ‹monster/lotus leshy«s› to her list of creatures she can summon with ‹spell/summon nature's ally I«, II, III, IV, and V›, respectively." alter="Spontaneous casting"} ::ab[Leshy Tender (Ex)]{icon=boost-magic l4="A leshy warden can either grant her leaf leshy a +2 increase to Strength and Dexterity or transform it into a gourd leshy." l8="The leshy warden can either grant her current leshy a +2 increase to Strength and Dexterity or transform it into a fungus leshy." l12="She can either grant her current leshy a final +2 increase to Strength and Dexterity or transform it into a seaweed leshy." special="If the leshy is transformed, it gains the normal ability scores of its new form; ability score increases granted by this ability don't carry over to its new form." replace="Resist nature's lure"} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{l=6 icon=down-boost passive="A leshy warden gains *wild shape,* except her effective druid level for the ability is equal to her druid level - 2 for the purpose of determining the number of times per day she can use it. The leshy warden can assume the form of only Small or Medium plant creatures, as per ‹spell/plant shape I›." imp8="She can take the form of a Large plant creature, as per ‹spell/plant shape II›." imp10="She can take the form of a Huge plant creature, as per ‹spell/plant shape III›." alter="Wild shape"} ::ab[Plant Whisperer (Su)]{l=13 icon=power flavor="A leshy warden's connection to the spirits of nature becomes strong enough that she can always hear them whispering." passive="She is treated as if constantly under the effects of ‹spell/speak with plants›." ability="Once per day, she can spend 10 minutes in communion with the spirits to learn the answers to her questions, as ‹spell/commune with nature›." order=pa replace="A thousand faces"}

name: Lion Shaman
description: ## Lion Shaman ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/103› A shaman with this totem calls upon the proud lion, imposing and majestic, the mighty leader of deadly hunters. ::ab[Nature Bond]{icon=info choice="A lion shaman who chooses an animal companion must select a ‹companion/lion›. If choosing a domain, the lion shaman must choose from the ‹domain/Animal›, ‹domain/Glory›, ‹domain/Nobility›, and ‹domain/Sun› domains." alter="Nature bond"} ::ab[Wild Empathy (Ex)]{icon=boost ability="A lion shaman can use *wild empathy* with felines as a @HLfull-round_action with a +4 bonus." alter="Wild empathy"} :::ab{title="Totem Transformation (Su)" icon=boost-magic l=2 action="Standard Action" imp7="This becomes a @HLmove_action." imp12="This becomes a @HLswift_action." useL=druid useUnit=minute useNC=1 special="This is a polymorph effect and cannot be used while the druid is using another polymorph effect, such as *wild shape.*" replace="Woodland stride"} A lion shaman may adopt an aspect of the lion while retaining her normal form. The druid may select from the following bonuses: - **Movement** (+20 enhancement bonus to land speed) - **Senses** (low-light vision, ‹umr/scent›) - **‹umr/Natural weapons›** (bite [1d4], 2 claws [1d4] for a Medium druid, rake, +2 CMB to grapple) While using *totem transformation,* the lion shaman may speak normally and can cast ‹spell/speak with animals› (felines only) at will. ::: ::ab[Totemic Summons (Su)]{l=5 icon=boost standard="A lion shaman may cast ‹spell/summon nature's ally› to summon felines, and these summoned creatures gain ‹rule/temporary hit points› equal to her druid level. She can apply the ‹template/young› template to any feline to reduce the level of the summoning spell required by one. She can also increase the level of summoning required by one in order to apply either the ‹template/advanced› or the ‹template/giant› template, or increase it by two to apply both the advanced and giant templates."} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{l=6 icon=down-boost passive="A lion shaman gains *wild shape,* but the ability functions at her druid level - 2. If she takes on the form of a feline, she instead uses her druid level + 2." replace="Wild shape"} ::ab[Bonus Feat]{l=9 icon=power ability="A lion shaman gains one of the following bonus feats: ‹feat/Dodge›, ‹feat/Lunge›, ‹feat/Improved Iron Will›, ‹feat/Iron Will›, or ‹feat/Skill Focus› (Acrobatics)." imp13="The druid gains another feat from the list above." imp17="The druid gains a third bonus feat from the list above." special="She must meet the prerequisites for these bonus feats." replace="Venom immunity"}

name: Menhir Savant
description: ## Menhir Savant ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/38› Some druids study the paths of nature's power through the nodes and ley lines that connect standing stones and megalithic circles, learning to tap into their energies. ::ab[Spirit Sense (Sp)]{l=1 icon=power ability="A menhir savant can detect the presence of undead; fey; outsiders; and astral, ethereal, or incorporeal creatures. This ability functions like ‹spell/detect undead›, and the druid detects all of these creatures rather than trying to detect one kind." replace="Nature sense~wild empathy"} ::ab[Place Magic (Su)]{l=2 icon=boost flavor="A menhir savant learns to identify and tap into ley lines in different types of terrain." free="She can tap into the magic of a nearby ley line and increase her caster level by +1 for 1 round." useMod=Wis3 replace="Woodland stride~trackless step"} ::ab[Walk the Lines (Su)]{l=9 icon=magic ability="A menhir savant can use her connection to ley lines to cast ‹spell/transport via plants›." useMod=Wis} ::ab[Empty Body (Su)]{l=13 icon=magic standard="A menhir savant can become ethereal, as if using ‹spell/ethereal jaunt›." useL=druid useNC useUnit=round replace="A thousand faces"}

name: Mooncaller
description: ## Mooncaller ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/38› A mooncaller is bound to the subtle influences of the ever-changing moon and its endless cycles from light to dark and back again. ::ab[Night Sight (Ex)]{l=2 icon=power ability="A mooncaller gains low-light vision. If she already has low-light vision, she gains darkvision with a range of 30 feet. If she already has darkvision, the range of her darkvision is increased by 30 feet." replace="Woodland stride"} ::ab[Resist Call of the Wild (Ex)]{l=4 icon=def passive="A mooncaller gains a +4 bonus on saving throws to avoid confusion, daze, feeblemind, and insanity effects. She also gains a +4 bonus against the exceptional, spell-like, and supernatural abilities of creatures with the shapechanger subtype." replace="Resist nature's lure"} ::ab[Purity of Body (Ex)]{l=9 icon=def passive="A mooncaller gains immunity to all diseases, including supernatural and magical diseases." replace="Venom immunity"} ::ab[Wolfsbane (Su)]{icon=def l13="A mooncaller gains DR 3/silver." l16="This becomes DR 4/silver." l19="This becomes DR 5/silver." replace="A thousand faces"}

name: Mountain Druid
description: ## Mountain Druid ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/100› As more and more of the soft, easy lands become cultivated and civilized, many druids look for refuge and solitude among the eternal peaks of the highest mountains. ::ab[Mountaineer (Ex)]{l=2 icon=boost-power passive="A mountain druid gains a bonus on Initiative checks and Climb, Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks equal to ‹misc/half› her druid level in mountainous terrain, and she cannot be tracked in such an environment." replace="Woodland stride"} ::ab[Sure-Footed (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost passive="A mountain druid suffers no penalty to speed or on Acrobatics or Stealth checks when walking across steep slopes, rubble, or scree." replace="Trackless step"} ::ab[Spire Walker (Ex)]{l=4 icon=boost-def passive="A mountain druid does not lose her Dexterity bonus when climbing. A mountain druid is immune to ‹rule/altitude sickness› and ignores the effects of a cold climate as if under the effects of ‹spell/endure elements›." replace="Resist nature's lure"} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{icon=down-boost l=6 ability="A mountain druid gains *wild shape,* except that her effective druid level for this ability is equal to her druid level - 2. A mountain druid cannot use *wild shape* to adopt a plant form." alter="Wild shape" imp12="She can assume the form of a Large giant as if using ‹spell/giant form I›." imp16="She may assume the form of a Huge giant as if using ‹spell/giant form II›."} ::ab[Mountain Stance (Ex)]{l=9 icon=def passive="A mountain druid gains immunity to petrification and receives a +4 bonus on saving throws or to CMD to resist any attempt to push, pull, bull rush, or drag her, or to resist any other effect that would physically move her from her position (e.g., ‹spell/repel wood›, ‹spell/reverse gravity›, or being blown away by high winds). This does not protect her against being tripped, grappled, or overrun." replace="Venom immunity"} ::ab[Mountain Stone (Ex)]{l=13 icon=power-magic ability="A mountain druid can transform her body into a weathered stone outcrop and back at will. This effect functions as ‹spell/statue›." replace="A thousand faces"}

name: Pack Lord
description: ## Pack Lord ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/38› Some druids bond with many animal companions rather than just one, achieving a level of communion rare even in druidic circles and leading their pack brothers and pack sisters with total authority. :::ab{icon=down action=Special choice="A pack lord druid may not select a domain and must choose an animal companion." passive="The druid gains a +2 bonus on *wild empathy* and Handle Animal checks made regarding her animal companion." title="Pack Bond (Ex)" replace="Nature bond" order=cpC} The pack lord may have more than one animal companion, but she must divide up her effective druid level between her companions to determine the abilities of each companion. For example, a 4th-level pack lord can have one 4th-level companion, two 2nd-level companions, or one 1st-level and one 3rd-level companion. Each time a pack lord's druid level increases, she must decide how to allocate the increase among her animal companions (including the option of adding a new 1st-level companion). Once a druid level is allocated to a particular companion, it cannot be redistributed while that companion is in the pack lord's service (she must release the companion or wait until the companion dies to allocate its levels to another companion, which she can do the next time she prepares spells). The *share spells* animal companion ability only applies to one animal companion at a time - the pack lord cannot use it to cast a one-target spell and have it affect all of her animal companions. ::: ::ab[Improved Empathic Link (Su)]{icon=power ability="The pack lord gains an *empathic link* with all of her animal companions. This functions like an empathic link with a ‹sidekick/familiar›." order=aw swift="The pack lord can shift her perception to one of her companions, allowing her to experience what it sees, hears, and so on. She can maintain this connection as long as she likes (as long as the companion is within 1 mile) and end it as a @HLfree_action. The druid can only use this ability on one companion at a time, and cannot see, hear, or smell with her own body while maintaining this connection." replace="The 6th-level additional use of *wild shape*"}

name: Plains Druid
description: ## Plains Druid ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/100› Out upon the wide and rolling prairies and savannahs, plains druids stand guard over the grasslands. These druids range far and wide, watching over nomadic tribes and wandering herds and preserving the sometimes fragile ecosystem of the wide open spaces. ::ab[Plains Traveler (Ex)]{l=2 icon=boost-power passive="A plains druid gains a bonus on initiative checks and Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks equal to ‹misc/half› her druid level in plains terrain, and she cannot be tracked in such an environment." replace="Woodland stride"} ::ab[Run Like the Wind (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost-power order=pa passive="A plains druid gains +10 feet to her land speed when wearing light or no armor and carrying a light load." ability="Once per hour, she may ‹rule/run› or ‹rule/charge› at double the normal speed for 1 round." special="If riding her animal companion, it gains this ability instead." replace="Trackless step"} ::ab[Savanna Ambush (Ex)]{l=4 icon=boost passive="A plains druid gains ‹rule/concealment› whenever she is ‹rule/prone› in natural surroundings, and can make Stealth checks at no penalty when prone and not moving or at -5 when crawling." order=pi immediate="A plains druid can stand up from prone during a surprise round." replace="Resist nature's lure"} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{icon=down l=6 ability="A plains druid gains *wild shape,* except that her effective druid level for this ability is equal to her druid level - 2." alter="Wild shape"} ::ab[Canny Charger (Ex)]{l=9 icon=power-def-boost ability="A plains druid can charge through allies' squares without difficulty (whether mounted or afoot) and can turn up to 90 degrees once during a charge, provided the last 10 feet toward the target are in a straight line." order=ap passive="She also gains a +4 dodge bonus to AC against enemy charge attacks and a +4 bonus to damage with a ‹rule/readied action› against a charging foe." replace="Venom immunity"} ::ab[Evasion (Ex)]{l=13 icon=def passive="A plains druid gains ‹ability/evasion› when wearing light or no armor and carrying a light load. This functions as the ‹class/rogue› ability of the same name." replace="A thousand faces"}

name: Reincarnated Druid

features.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon (Ex)

description: ## Reincarnated Druid ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/39› Spun off into the endless circle of life, an incarnate druid is an embodiment of nature's eternal renewal. She lives many lives and wanders the world devoid of attachments, a stranger to all yet one with all life. ::ab[Mysterious Stranger (Ex)]{l=2 icon=def passive="A reincarnated druids adds ‹misc/half› her druid level to the DC of Sense Motive, Diplomacy, and Knowledge checks to learn about her." replace="Woodland stride"} ::ab[Resist Death's Touch (Ex)]{l=4 icon=def passive="A reincarnated druid gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against death effects, energy drain, and necromancy effects, and on stabilization checks when dying." replace="Resist nature's lure"} ::ab[Many Lives (Ex)]{l=5 icon=magic ability="If a reincarnated druid is killed, she may automatically ‹spell/reincarnate› (as the spell) 1 day later. The reincarnated druid appears in a safe location within 1 mile of her previous body. At will for the next 7 days, she can sense the presence of her remains as if using ‹spell/locate object› as a spell-like ability. If she is killed during these 7 days, she remains dead and does not reincarnate." special="The many lives ability does not function if the reincarnated druid is slain by a death effect. A reincarnated druid cannot be ‹spell/raise«d from the» dead› or ‹spell/resurrect«ed<ion›, though she can be reincarnated."} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{l=6 icon=down ability="A reincarnated druid gains *wild shape,* but it functions at her druid level - 2." replace="Wild shape"} ::ab[Cheat Death (Ex)]{l=9 icon=roll ability="Once per day, a reincarnated druid may reroll a save against a death effect, energy drain, or necromancy effect before the result of the roll is revealed, or reroll a failed stabilization check while dying. She must take the result of the second roll, even if it is worse than the original roll." replace="Venom immunity"} ::ab[Tongue of the Sun and Moon (Ex)]{l=15 icon=power ability="A reincarnated druid can speak with any living creature." replace="Timeless body"}

name: River Druid
sourceBook: Ultimate Wilderness, People of the River

features.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon (Ex)

description: ## River Druid ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/48;People of the River/14› These druids are the guardians of rivers and the creatures that depend on them. Just as rivers pour from mountains to seas, river druids adapt to many environments and cultures. They can be found wherever water flows, even among underground rivers or sewer systems. ::ab[Ferrier (Ex)]{icon=skill-boost info="A river druid adds ‹skill/Diplomacy› (CHA) to her list of class skills and gains a +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Knowledge (nature) skill checks." alter="Class skills" replace="Nature sense"} ::ab[Read the Currents (Ex)]{l=2 icon=boost passive="A river druid gains a bonus equal to ‹misc/half› her druid level on initiative checks and Acrobatics, Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, Survival, and Swim checks when she is in, on, or adjacent to flowing water." replace="Woodland stride"} ::ab[Countercurrent (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost passive="A river druid takes no penalty to speed or on Acrobatics or Stealth checks in shallow water up to 2 feet deep (1 foot deep for Small characters) such as shallow bogs, shorelines, streams, and partially flooded areas. A river druid (and any vehicle she pilots) isn't moved by flowing water unless she allows it. Water that has been magically manipulated to impede or boost motion still affects her." replace="Trackless step"} ::ab[Deep Breath (Ex)]{l=4 icon=power ability="A river druid can ‹misc/hold her breath› for a number of minutes equal to her Constitution score (after this, she must begin attempting Constitution checks to avoid suffocation as normal)." replace="Resist nature's lure"} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{l=6 icon=down ability="A river druid gains *wild shape,* except her effective druid level for the ability is equal to her druid level - 2." alter="Wild shape"} ::ab[Tongue of the Sun and Moon (Ex)]{l=15 icon=power passive="A river druid can speak with any living creature." replace="Timeless body"}

name: Road Keeper
description: ## Road Keeper ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/48› Guardians of the lonely paths between cities, road keepers protect the wild from travelers, and travelers from the wild. ::ab[One with the Road (Su)]{icon=boost info="A road keeper casts the following spells as though her caster level were 1 higher." s1=Longstrider s2="Scent trail" s3="Nature's exile" s4="Freedom of movement" s5="Tree stride" s6="Find the path" s7="Wind walk" s8="Word of recall" s9="World wave" imp9="The bonus to her caster level for these spells increases to +2." replace="Spontaneous casting"} ::ab[Road Bond (Ex)]{icon=info choice="If the road keeper chooses a cleric domain as her nature bond, she must choose from the ‹domain/Community›, ‹domain/Liberation›, ‹domain/Protection›, ‹domain/Travel›, or ‹domain/Weather› domains. The road keeper can also choose any subdomain associated with these domains." alter="Nature bond" replace="Wild empathy"} ::ab[Take the High Road (Ex)]{l=2 icon=boost ability="A road keeper travels over roads and paths at an accelerated rate. She and her allies can ‹rule/hustle› for 2 hours without taking nonlethal damage, instead of 1, provided they travel along a road or path. Additionally, as long as they travel on a road or path, the road keeper and her allies count as traveling along a highway regardless of the quality of the road or path on which they travel. Allies must remain within 30 feet of the road keeper to benefit from this ability." replace="Woodland stride"} ::ab[Trodden Path (Ex)]{l=4 icon=boost-def passive="A road keeper gains a +4 bonus on Survival checks to follow or identify tracks. She also gains this bonus on saving throws against severe weather effects." replace="Resist nature's lure"} ::ab[Road Less Traveled (Su)]{l=4 icon=lower flavor="A road keeper can discourage creatures from entering or exiting the wild." standard="Once per day, she can target a creature within 30 feet and curse it with clumsiness and disorientation. The road keeper chooses whether to punish her target for entering the wild from a road or building, or vice versa. If her target is entering the wild, it treats every square of wilderness not on a road or in a building as ‹rule/difficult terrain›. If her target is exiting the wild, it treats every square on a road or inside a building as difficult terrain. In either case, the ground feels uneven and the target suffers extreme vertigo during movement. The victim of this curse can attempt a Will saving throw (DC = 10 + ‹misc/half› the road keeper's level + her Wisdom modifier) at the beginning of its turn each round to end the effect. The effect lasts until the target successfully saves or for a number of minutes equal to the road keeper's level." special="If she targets more than one creature at one time, each target must be within 30 feet of the road keeper. A creature's movement isn't affected if it is burrowing, climbing, earth gliding, flying, or swimming. This is a mind-affecting curse effect." imp6="The road keeper can target 2 creatures per day with this ability. She can target more than one creature with a single use of this ability or the same target more than once in the same day (though its effects do not stack), but her total number of targets per day cannot exceed this daily maximum." incrementUse="The road keeper can~6~2~3~1" incrementDesc=target incrementEnd=" creatures per day." replace="Wild shape"}

name: Rot Warden
description: ## Rot Warden ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/49› Harbingers of decay, rot wardens live in damp lands where insects and rot break down the dead to feed the living. They see in the process of rot the beauty of nature's capacity to recycle and repurpose material into something wondrous and new. ::ab[Invoke Decay (Su)]{icon=magic ability="A rot warden can channel stored spell energy into specific spells he hasn't prepared ahead of time. He can &quot&lose&quot& a prepared spell in order to cast the following spells at the indicated spell levels." s1="Decompose corpse" s2="Warp wood" s3="Fungal infestation" s4="Explosion of rot" s5="Insect plague" s6="Swarm skin" s7="Creeping doom" s8="Horrid wilting" s9=Massacre alter="Spontaneous casting"} ::ab[Nature Bond]{icon=info choice="A rot warden who chooses a cleric domain as his nature bond must choose from the ‹domain/Destruction›, ‹druiddomain/Erosion›, ‹domain/Repose›, or ‹druiddomain/Vermin› domains." alter="Nature bond"} ::ab[Vermin Empathy (Su)]{icon=power ability="A rot warden can improve the attitude of vermin as a normal druid can with animals. Vermin have a starting attitude of unfriendly. The rot warden can also improve the attitude of vermin swarms, but he takes a -4 penalty on the check unless the swarm consists of the same kind of vermin as his vermin companion or his current *wild shape.*" replace="Wild empathy"} ::ab[Swarmcaller (Sp)]{l=3 icon=magic standard="A rot warden can summon a swarm of vermin once per day. This functions like ‹spell/summon swarm›, except the swarm the rot warden summons must be a ‹monster/cockroach<_swarm›, ‹monster/locust<_swarm›, or ‹monster/spider swarm›. If he uses this ability during the surprise round of combat, nearby animals and vermin become hushed until the first round of combat ends; during this surprise round and first round of combat, ‹rule/flat-footed› creatures also gain the ‹misc/shaken› condition (this doesn't stack with other fear effects)." imp9="He adds ‹monster/army ant<_swarm›, ‹monster/centipede<_swarm›, and ‹monster/wasp swarm«s› to the list of swarms he can call with this ability." replace="Trackless step~venom immunity"} ::ab[Enduring Druid (Su)]{l=4 icon=def passive="A rot warden gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against attacks and special abilities of vermin and swarms with the vermin type. This bonus also applies on saving throws against effects that would age or decay the rot warden or his equipment." replace="Resist nature's lure"} ::ab[Wild Shape]{l=6 icon=down-boost ability="A rot warden gains *wild shape,* except his effective druid level is his druid level - 2. He cannot take the form of an elemental." imp8="A rot warden can assume the form of a Small or Medium vermin as if using ‹spell/vermin shape I›." imp10="The rot warden can assume the shape of a Tiny or Large vermin as if using ‹spell/vermin shape II›." imp12="He can take the form of a Huge vermin as if using vermin shape III.@FN1" replace="Wild shape"} :::fakeFootnotes @FN[No such spell was ever published. A similar spell could be made based on ‹spell/beast shape III› and *vermin shape II* - consult your GM.]{from=1} :::

name: Saurian Shaman
description: ## Saurian Shaman ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/39› A shaman with this focus calls upon the primeval dinosaur, the archaic terror that lingers as a hungering, atavistic stranger at the fringes of the ecosystem, a destroyer and despoiler whose coming other animals dread. ::ab[Nature Bond]{icon=info choice="A saurian shaman who chooses an animal companion must select a dinosaur. If choosing a domain, a saurian shaman must choose from the ‹domain/Animal›, ‹domain/Destruction›, ‹domain/Strength›, and ‹domain/War› domains." alter="Nature bond"} ::ab[Wild Empathy (Ex)]{icon=boost ability="A saurian shaman can use *wild empathy* with dinosaurs and reptiles as a @HLfull-round_action with a +4 bonus." alter="Wild empathy"} :::ab{title="Totem Transformation (Su)" icon=boost-magic l=2 action="Standard Action" imp7="This becomes a @HLmove_action." imp12="This becomes a @HLswift_action." useL=druid useUnit=minute useNC=1 special="This is a polymorph effect and cannot be used while the druid is using another polymorph effect, such as *wild shape.*" replace="Woodland stride"} A saurian shaman may adopt an aspect of the saurian while retaining her normal form. The druid may select from the following bonuses: - **Movement** (+10 enhancement bonus to land speed) - **Scales** (+2 natural armor bonus to AC) - **Senses** (low-light vision, ‹umr/scent›) - **‹umr/Natural weapons›** (bite [1d6], 2 claws [1d4] for a Medium druid, rake, +2 CMB to grapple) While using *totem transformation,* a saurian shaman may speak normally and can cast ‹spell/speak with animals› (reptiles and dinosaurs only) at will. ::: ::ab[Totemic Summons (Su)]{l=5 icon=boost standard="A saurian shaman may cast ‹spell/summon nature's ally› to summon reptiles and dinosaurs, and these summoned creatures gain ‹rule/temporary hit points› equal to her druid level. She can apply the ‹template/young› template to such summons to reduce the level of the summoning spell required by one. She can also increase the level of summoning required by one in order to apply either the ‹template/advanced› or the ‹template/giant› template, or increase it by two to apply both the advanced and giant templates."} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{l=6 icon=down-boost ability="A saurian shaman gains *wild shape,* but the ability functions at her druid level - 2. If she takes on the form of a reptile or a dinosaur, she instead uses her druid level +2." replace="Wild shape"} ::ab[Bonus Feat]{l=9 icon=power ability="A saurian shaman gains one of the following bonus feats: ‹feat/Improved Overrun›, ‹feat/Nimble Moves›, ‹feat/Power Attack›, ‹feat/Skill Focus› (Intimidate), or ‹feat/Vital Strike›." imp13="The druid gains another feat from the list above." imp17="The druid gains a third bonus feat from the list above." special="She must meet the prerequisites for these bonus feats." replace="Venom immunity"}

name: Season Sage
description: ## Season Sage ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/11› Season sages wander as the seasons change, turning the leaves and transforming nature as they pass and taking pleasure in the transition between seasons. ::prereq{r=Gathlain} ::ab[Season's Touch (Su)]{head l=4 icon=touch ability="A season sage can infuse living things with the essence of a season with a touch, causing them to manifest the changes associated with that season - for example, a touch of winter can make some animals grow a thick winter coat, while a touch of summer can make them shed. A touch of autumn would make a deciduous tree's leaves change colors, a touch of winter would make its leaves fall, and a touch of spring would make it put forth new leaves." order=an info="In addition, a season sage can use the following abilities (in any combination) a total number of times per day equal to 1 + his Wisdom modifier." replace="Wild shape"} ::ab[Vernal Growth]{next icon=boost ability="A touched living creature gains the effects of ‹spell/enlarge person› (even if it is not a humanoid) for 1 minute per druid level. A touched non-creature plant likewise doubles in all dimensions for the same duration."} ::ab[Summer Might]{next icon=boost ability="A touched creature gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Constitution for 1 minute per druid level."} ::ab[Autumn Rot]{next icon=touch ability="A touched creature or object made of plant matter takes 1d6 points of acid damage per 2 druid levels."} ::ab[Winter Frost]{next icon=touch ability="A touched creature or object takes 1d6 points of cold damage per 2 druid levels."} ::ab[Season's Veil (Su)]{head icon=aura l=6 standard="A season sage can radiate an aura of seasonal power. This affects a 20-foot-radius ‹misc/burst› centered on the season sage and lasts in that area for 10 minutes, regardless of where the season sage moves afterward." useInc=druid~2~6 useF="6~1~2" imp10="The radius increases to 40 feet."} ::ab[Vernal Bloom]{next icon=magic ability="The area surges with life. Plants form vibrant, ‹rule/heavy undergrowth»<forest_terrain› while in the aura. If the area can support plants, a circle of minor plants lingers afterward." imp8="The season sage can affect the area with ‹spell/plant growth› as a @HLswift_action at will, which can linger after the aura passes."} ::ab[Summer Heat]{next icon=magic ability="The area of effect is treated as if it were under the effects of ‹rule/extreme heat»<heat_dangers›." imp8="As a @HLswift_action the season sage can have the area deal 1d6 points of fire damage each round to other creatures in the area."} ::ab[Autumn Squall]{next icon=magic ability="The area is filled with fog, rain, and blown leaves. All creatures in the area gain ‹rule/concealment› (abilities to specifically see through fog or rain don't apply)." imp8="The season sage can affect the area with ‹spell/diminish plants› as a @HLswift_action at will, which also lingers after the aura passes."} ::ab[Winter Chill]{next icon=magic ability="The area of effect is treated as if it were under the effects of ‹rule/extreme cold»<cold_dangers›." imp8="As a @HLswift_action the season sage can have the area deal 1d6 points of cold damage each round to other creatures in the area."} ::ab[Season Mastery (Sp)]{l=12 icon=magic ability="A season sage can cast ‹spell/control weather› as a spell-like ability once per day; his choice of effects is not limited by the season."}

name: Serpent Shaman
description: ## Serpent Shaman ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/103› A shaman with this totem calls upon the cunning serpent, the stealthy deceiver who draws the weak minded in and strikes while they are unaware. Some hate its treacherous nature, while others praise its thoughtful pragmatism. ::ab[Nature Bond]{icon=info choice="A serpent shaman who chooses an animal companion must select a snake. If choosing a domain, the serpent shaman must choose from the ‹domain/Animal›, ‹domain/Charm›, ‹domain/Trickery›, and ‹domain/Water› domains." alter="Nature bond"} ::ab[Wild Empathy (Ex)]{icon=boost ability="A serpent shaman can use *wild empathy* with reptiles as a @HLfull-round_action with a +4 bonus." alter="Wild empathy"} :::ab{title="Totem Transformation (Su)" icon=boost-magic l=2 action="Standard Action" imp7="This becomes a @HLmove_action." imp12="This becomes a @HLswift_action." useL=druid useUnit=minute useNC=1 special="This is a polymorph effect and cannot be used while the druid is using another polymorph effect, such as *wild shape.*" replace="Woodland stride"} A serpent shaman may adopt an aspect of the snake while retaining her normal form. The druid may select from the following bonuses: - **Movement** (climb speed 20 feet, swim speed 20 feet) - **Scales** (+2 natural armor bonus to AC) - **Senses** (low-light vision, ‹umr/scent›) - **‹umr/Natural weapons›** (bite [1d4] and poison for a Medium druid, +2 CMB to grapple) ::aff[Serpent Shaman Venom]{iconP poison freqR=6 effCon=1 cure1 dcF dcLev=druid dcMod=Con dcIt=her} While using *totem transformation,* the serpent shaman may speak normally and can cast ‹spell/speak with animals› (reptiles only) at will. ::: ::ab[Totemic Summons (Su)]{l=5 icon=boost standard="A serpent shaman may cast ‹spell/summon nature's ally› to summon snakes, and these summoned creatures gain ‹rule/temporary hit points› equal to her druid level. She can apply the ‹template/young› template to any snake to reduce the level of the summoning spell required by one. She can also increase the level of summoning required by one in order to apply either the ‹template/advanced› or the ‹template/giant› template, or increase it by two to apply both the advanced and giant templates."} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{l=6 icon=down-boost passive="A serpent shaman gains *wild shape,* but the ability functions at her druid level - 2. If she takes on the form of a snake, she instead uses her druid level + 2." replace="Wild shape"} ::ab[Bonus Feat]{l=9 icon=power ability="A serpent shaman gains one of the following bonus feats: ‹feat/Combat Expertise›, ‹feat/Improved Feint›, ‹feat/Skill Focus› (Bluff), ‹feat/Stealthy›, or ‹feat/Strike Back›." imp13="The druid gains another feat from the list above." imp17="The druid gains a third bonus feat from the list above." special="She must meet the prerequisites for these bonus feats." replace="Venom immunity"}

name: Shark Shaman
description: ## Shark Shaman ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/40› Some druids emulate the deadly shark, a remorseless hunter that marine dwellers dread. Like a true shark, a shark shaman leaves blood and fear in her wake. ::ab[Nature Bond]{icon=info choice="A shark shaman who chooses an animal companion must select a ‹companion/shark›. If choosing a domain, a shark shaman may choose the ‹domain/Animal›, ‹domain/Death›, ‹domain/War›, or ‹domain/Water› domain." alter="Nature bond"} ::ab[Wild Empathy (Ex)]{icon=boost ability="A shark shaman can use *wild empathy* with fish as a @HLfull-round_action with a +4 bonus." alter="Wild empathy"} :::ab{title="Totem Transformation (Su)" icon=boost-magic l=2 action="Standard Action" imp7="This becomes a @HLmove_action." imp12="This becomes a @HLswift_action." useL=druid useUnit=minute useNC=1 special="This is a polymorph effect and cannot be used while the druid is using another polymorph effect, such as *wild shape.*" replace="Woodland stride"} A shark shaman may adopt an aspect of the shark while retaining her normal form. The druid may select from the following bonuses: - **Movement** (can breathe water, swim speed 30 feet) - **Senses** (‹umr/scent› 30 feet, scent 90 feet in water) - **‹umr/Natural weapons›** (bite 1d6 for a Medium shaman) - **Shark skin** (+2 natural armor, creatures grappling the shaman take 1 point of slashing damage per round of grapple) While using *totem transformation,* the shark shaman may speak normally and can cast ‹spell/speak with animals› (fish only) at will. ::: ::ab[Totemic Summons (Su)]{l=5 icon=boost standard="A shark shaman may cast ‹spell/summon nature's ally I› to summon a ‹monster/stingray› and ‹spell/summon nature's ally II› to summon a ‹monster/manta ray›. Summoned rays and sharks gain a number of ‹rule/temporary hit points› equal to her druid level. She can apply the ‹template/young› template to any such summon to reduce the level of the summoning spell required by one. She can also increase the level of summoning required by one in order to apply either the ‹template/advanced› or the ‹template/giant› template, or increase it by two to apply both the advanced and giant templates."} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{l=6 icon=down-boost passive="A shark shaman gains *wild shape,* but the ability functions at her druid level - 2. If she takes on the form of a shark, she instead uses her druid level +2." replace="Wild shape"} ::ab[Bonus Feat]{l=9 icon=power ability="A shark shaman gains one of the following bonus feats: ‹feat/Bleeding Critical›, ‹feat/Improved Initiative›, ‹feat/Lightning Reflexes›, ‹feat/Self-Sufficient›, or ‹feat/Skill Focus› (Swim)." imp13="The druid gains another feat from the list above." imp17="The druid gains a third bonus feat from the list above." special="She must meet prerequisites for these bonus feats." replace="Venom immunity"}

name: Skinshaper
description: ## Skinshaper ‹SOURCE Ultimate Intrigue/26› Using the same primal energy with which other druids assume animal forms, skinshapers can imitate some of the most dangerous beasts of all: humans and other humanoids. Rather than merely copying humanoids' shapes and abilities, skinshapers unlock brutal energies that push their borrowed bodies far beyond the capabilities of normal humanoid creatures. Their connection to humanoids bring skinshapers into settlements more often than typical druids, and their penchant for disguise allows them to excel at intrigue. ::cskill{gain=dis lose=ride} ::ab[Skinshaping (Su)]{l=4 head icon=magic ability="A skinshaper gains the ability to turn herself into any Small or Medium humanoid and back again once per day. This ability functions as per ‹spell/alter self›, except as noted here. The effect lasts for 1 hour per druid level, or until the skinshaper changes back. Changing form is a @HLstandard_action and doesn't provoke an attack of opportunity. The skinshaper must be familiar with the form she has chosen." special="She also gains other benefits while *skinshaping,* as described below." useInc=druid~2~4 useF="4~1~2" imp20="She can use *skinshaping* at will." replace="Wild shape"} ::ab[Unarmed Strike]{next head icon=melee l4="The skinshaper learns to intuitively use her body as a weapon. While *skinshaping,* she gains the benefit of the ‹feat/Improved Unarmed Strike› feat, and her unarmed strike deals damage as if she were a ‹class/monk› with a monk level equal to her druid level - 3."} ::ab[Unarmed Strike]{next flavor="Relevant text from the monk class ability." icon=melee l1="Your unarmed strike deals 1d4 (Small), 1d6 (Medium), or 1d8 (Large) damage." imp4="Your unarmed strike now deals 1d6 (Small), 1d8 (Medium), or 2d6 (Large) damage." imp8="Your unarmed strike now deals 1d8 (Small), 1d10 (Medium), or 2d8 (Large) damage." imp12="Your unarmed strike now deals 1d10 (Small), 2d6 (Medium), or 3d6 (Large) damage." imp16="Your unarmed strike now deals 2d6 (Small), 2d8 (Medium), or 3d8 (Large) damage."} ::ab[Enhancement Bonus]{next icon=boost l6="A skinshaper gains the ability to channel the versatile nature of humanoids to enhance her body and mind. Whenever she uses *skinshaping* to assume a humanoid shape other than her own, she gains a +2 enhancement bonus to any one ability score. The bonus persists as long as she remains in that form." imp10="She gains an additional +2 enhancement bonus to one ability score, or can stack them as a +4 bonus to one score." imp14="She gains a third +2 enhancement bonus to one ability score. She can distribute these bonuses as she wishes in increments of +2, but the enhancement bonus on any single ability score cannot exceed +4." imp18="She gains a fourth +2 enhancement bonus to one ability score, with the same restrictions as above."} ::ab[Advanced Form]{next icon=power l8="A skinshaper can imitate humanoid creatures even more accurately. She gains any of the following abilities that the form she assumes has: darkvision 90 feet, low-light vision, ‹umr/scent›, climb 60 feet, fly 60 feet (good maneuverability), swim 60 feet, ‹umr/ferocity›, ‹race/half_>orc« ferocity›, and ‹umr/hold breath›. If the form she assumes has the ‹subtype/aquatic› subtype, she gains the aquatic subtype and the ‹umr/amphibious› special quality."} ::ab[Racial Memory]{next icon=power l12="A skinshaper can access the racial memory of the humanoid she is imitating. If the form she assumes has any of the following racial abilities, she gains those abilities: defensive training, hatred, ‹ability/poison use›, ‹ability/sneak attack› +2d6, stability, and weapon familiarity. Additionally, she can speak any racial languages of the chosen form."} ::ab[Skill Bonuses]{next icon=boost l16="A skinshaper gains the racial skill bonuses of the imitated humanoid, to a maximum of a +4 bonus on a given skill. The skinshaper cannot benefit from any variable racial skill bonuses associated with the chosen form (such as gnomes' racial bonus on any one Craft or Profession skill)."} ::ab[Flashmorph (Su)]{l=13 icon=boost info="A skinshaper learns to change her shape extremely quickly. She can use skinshaping as a @HLswift_action." replace="A thousand faces"}

name: Storm Druid
description: ## Storm Druid ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/40› While most druids focus their attention upon the rich earth and the bounty of nature that springs forth from it, the storm druid's eyes have ever been cast to the skies and the endless expanse of blue, channeling the most raw and untamed aspects of nature. ::ab[Spontaneous Domain Casting]{icon=magic ability="A storm druid can channel stored spell energy into domain spells that she has not prepared ahead of time. She can &quot&lose&quot& a prepared spell in order to cast any domain spell of the same level or lower." replace="Spontaneous casting"} ::ab[Nature Bond (Ex)]{icon=down choice="A storm druid may not choose an animal companion. A storm druid must choose the ‹domain/Air› or ‹domain/Weather› domain, or the Cloud, Storm, or Wind subdomain."} ::ab[Windwalker (Ex)]{l=2 icon=def passive="The penalties from natural or magical wind effects are treated as one step less severe for a storm druid." replace="Woodland stride"} ::ab[Stormvoice (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost passive="A storm druid's voice can magically carry over howling winds and peals of thunder. Whenever a Perception check is needed to hear the druid's voice, the DC is reduced by an amount equal to the druid's level." replace="Trackless step"} ::ab[Eyes of the Storm (Ex)]{l=4 icon=power ability="A storm druid can see through 10 feet of magical fog, mist, gas, wind, rain, or similar inclement weather conditions, ignoring any concealment it might grant." incrementPlain="Her sight~4~4~15~5" incrementDesc="can penetrate~increases to" incrementEnd=" feet." replace="Resist nature's lure"} ::ab[Windlord]{l=9 icon=power choice="A storm druid can select another domain or subdomain from those available to her through her nature bond." replace="Venom immunity"} ::ab[Storm Lord (Ex)]{l=13 icon=def passive="A storm druid is unaffected by natural and magical wind effects. She also becomes immune to deafness and gains +2 bonus on saving throws against sonic effects." replace="A thousand faces"}

name: Swamp Druid
