description: ## Swamp Druid ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/100› Some druids eschew pleasant glades and groves and instead seek out dank marshes, misty bogs and heaths, and trackless swamps as the place they call home and watch over with care, finding beauty and life in abundance in places few others would willingly enter. ::ab[Marshwight (Ex)]{l=2 icon=boost-power passive="A swamp druid gains a bonus on Initiative checks and Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, Swim, and Survival checks equal to ‹misc/half› her druid level in swamp terrain, and she cannot be tracked in such an environment." replace="Woodland stride"} ::ab[Swamp Strider (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost passive="A swamp druid suffers no penalty to speed or on Acrobatics or Stealth checks in bogs and undergrowth." replace="Trackless step"} ::ab[Pond Scum (Ex)]{l=4 icon=def passive="A swamp druid gains a +4 bonus on saves against disease and the exceptional, supernatural, and spell-like abilities of monstrous humanoids. A swamp druid also gains DR/- equal to half her druid level against attacks by swarms. If this damage resistance prevents damage, the druid is unaffected by distraction or other special attacks of the swarm." replace="Resist nature's lure"} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{l=6 icon=down ability="A swamp druid gains *wild shape,* except that her effective druid level for this ability is equal to her druid level - 2." alter="Wild shape"} ::ab[Slippery (Ex)]{l=13 icon=def-boost passive="A swamp druid gains continuous ‹spell/freedom of movement›." replace="A thousand faces"}

name: Urban Druid
description: ## Urban Druid ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/101› While many druids keep to the wilderness, some make their way within settlements, communing with the animals and vermin who live there and speaking for the nature that runs rampant in civilization's very cradle. ::ab[Spontaneous Casting]{icon=power ability="An urban druid can channel stored spell energy into domain spells that she has not prepared ahead of time. She can &quot&lose&quot& a prepared spell in order to cast any domain spell of the same level or lower." replace="Spontaneous casting"} ::ab[Nature Bond (Ex)]{icon=down-boost choice="An urban druid may not select an animal companion. Instead, she must choose from the following domains, rather than those usually available to druids: ‹domain/Charm›, ‹domain/Community›, ‹domain/Knowledge›, ‹domain/Nobility›, ‹domain/Protection›, ‹domain/Repose›, ‹domain/Rune›, or ‹domain/Weather›."} ::ab[Lorekeeper (Ex)]{l=2 icon=skill-boost passive="An urban druid adds ‹skill/Diplomacy› (CHA), ‹skill/Knowledge (history)› (INT), ‹skill/Knowledge (local)› (INT), and ‹skill/Knowledge (nobility)› (INT) skills to her list of class skills. She also receives a +2 bonus on these skill checks." replace="Woodland stride~trackless step"} ::ab[Resist Temptation (Ex)]{l=4 icon=def passive="An urban druid gains a +2 bonus on saves vs. divinations and enchantments." replace="Resist nature's lure"} ::ab[A Thousand Faces (Su)]{l=6 icon=boost ability="An urban druid gains this ability now instead of at 13th level."} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{l=8 icon=down ability="An urban druid gains *wild shape,* except that her effective druid level for the ability is equal to her druid level - 4."} ::ab[Mental Strength (Ex)]{l=9 icon=def passive="An urban druid gains immunity to charm and compulsion effects." replace="Venom immunity"}

name: Urushiol
description: ## Urushiol ‹SOURCE Ultimate Intrigue/27› When an urushiol druid forms a bond with nature, it takes a vastly different form than for most druids. His body becomes increasingly toxic, allowing him to secrete a deadly poison through his pores. :::ab{l=1 title="Toxic Secretions (Su)" icon=power action=Ability imp1="An urushiol can secrete this poison as a numbing injury poison on a natural weapon, unarmed strike, or manufactured weapon by spending 1 of his daily doses as a @HLstandard_action. He must choose a natural weapon, unarmed strike, or manufactured weapon in his hand that deals piercing or slashing damage and that is not already poisoned or poisonous. The weapon remains poisoned until the urushiol scores a hit with it, the weapon leaves his possession for more than 1 round, or the poison is wiped away." imp4="An urushiol's body becomes so saturated with poison that even his flesh is poisonous. Whenever a creature damages the urushiol with a bite or ‹umr/swallow whole› attack, the urushiol can release ingested poison into the creature by spending 1 of his daily doses as an @HLimmediate_action." incrementUse="The urushiol~1~2" incrementDesc="can produce" incrementEnd=" doses of poison per day." imp7="He can spend 2 daily doses of his poison as a @HLstandard_action to secrete a contact poison and coat one of his limbs with the secreted poison. The urushiol can deliver the poison by making a successful touch attack as a @HLstandard_action, which can be part of the same standard action he used to secrete the poison. If the attack misses, the poison persists upon his limb throughout the subsequent rounds until he hits a target or touches something else with his poisoned limb." imp11="He can spend 3 daily doses of his poison as a @HLstandard_action to release a 20-foot-radius cloud of inhaled poison centered around him that lasts for 1 round." imp14="An urushiol's venom changes in frequency to **1/round for 4 rounds.** In addition, when using his urushiol venom, an urushiol can spend an extra dose of his poison to change the damage type of the poison to **Dexterity damage** or **Constitution damage.** He can use this alteration in combination with any of the other abilities. For example, he could spend a total of 3 doses to create a cloud of inhaled poison that deals Constitution damage." special="The urushiol's daily doses are replenished when he regains his spells, but any of his weapons that are still poisoned with urushiol venom count against his daily limit." replace="Nature bond~resist nature's lure"} An urushiol's body becomes capable of producing a single dose of poison per day. The urushiol is immune to his own poison and cannot accidentally poison himself when applying his own poison or attacking with a weapon coated with it. Regardless of the delivery method he chooses, his poison has the following base statistics. ::aff[Urushiol Venom]{iconP poison dcF dcLev=urushiol dcMod=Wis dcIt=his freqR=2 effStr="1d3" cure1} ::: ::ab[Venom Immunity (Ex)]{icon=boost l=4 ability="An urushiol gains *venom immunity* now, instead of at 9th level." alter="Venom immunity"}

name: Wolf Shaman
description: ## Wolf Shaman ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/103› A shaman with this totem calls upon the clever wolf, capable of roaming alone yet wise enough to run with a pack when facing dangers too great for one alone. ::ab[Nature Bond]{icon=info choice="A wolf shaman who chooses an animal companion must select a ‹companion/wolf›. If choosing a domain, the wolf shaman must choose from the ‹domain/Animal›, ‹domain/Community›, ‹domain/Liberation›, and ‹domain/Travel› domains." alter="Nature bond"} ::ab[Wild Empathy (Ex)]{icon=boost ability="A wolf shaman can use *wild empathy* with canines as a @HLfull-round_action with a +4 bonus." alter="Wild empathy"} :::ab{title="Totem Transformation (Su)" icon=boost-magic l=2 action="Standard Action" imp7="This becomes a @HLmove_action." imp12="This becomes a @HLswift_action." useL=druid useUnit=minute useNC=1 special="This is a polymorph effect and cannot be used while the druid is using another polymorph effect, such as *wild shape.*" replace="Woodland stride"} A wolf shaman may adopt an aspect of the wolf while retaining her normal form. The druid may select from the following bonuses: - **Movement** (+20 enhancement bonus to land speed) - **Senses** (low-light vision, ‹umr/scent›, +4 racial bonus to Survival when tracking by scent) - **‹umr/Natural weapons›** (bite [1d4 plus trip] for a Medium druid, +2 CMB to trip) While using *totem transformation,* the wolf shaman may speak normally and can cast ‹spell/speak with animals› (canines only) at will. ::: ::ab[Totemic Summons (Su)]{l=5 icon=boost-magic standard="A wolf shaman may cast ‹spell/summon nature's ally› to summon canines, and these summoned creatures gain ‹rule/temporary hit points› equal to her druid level. She can apply the ‹template/young› template to any canine to reduce the level of the summoning spell required by one. She can also increase the level of summoning required by one in order to apply either the ‹template/advanced› or the ‹template/giant› template, or increase it by two to apply both the advanced and giant templates."} ::ab[Wild Shape (Su)]{l=6 icon=down-boost passive="A wolf shaman gains *wild shape,* but the ability functions at her druid level - 2. If she takes on the form of a canine, she instead uses her druid level + 2." replace="Wild shape"} ::ab[Bonus Feat]{l=9 icon=power ability="A wolf shaman gains one of the following bonus feats: ‹feat/Greater Trip›, ‹feat/Improved Trip›, ‹feat/Mobility›, ‹feat/Skill Focus› (Stealth), or ‹feat/Spring Attack›." imp13="The druid gains another feat from the list above." imp17="The druid gains a third bonus feat from the list above." special="She must meet the prerequisites for these bonus feats." replace="Venom immunity"}

name: World Walker
description: ## World Walker ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/43› While all druids traverse the wilderness with ease, the world walkers take it upon themselves to travel the entire world. Some act as messengers and scouts for druidic circles, while others have a seemingly unquenchable wanderlust; each new land provides new mysteries to discover and new wisdom to be gained from mastering those mysteries. ::ab[Favored Terrain (Ex)]{l=3 icon=power ability="The world walker gains the ranger's ‹ability/favored terrain› ability. She treats her druid level as her ranger level for this ability. If she has levels in both classes, both class's levels stack for determining the effect of this ability." replace="Trackless step~resist nature's lure"} ::ab[Path of Trees (Su)]{l=9 icon=magic ability="Once a day, a wanderer can step within a tree and then teleport from that tree to another one in a manner similar to the ‹spell/tree stride› spell." imp12="She can do this twice a day." imp13="She can use this ability to teleport to any other tree of its type up to 100 miles away." imp15="She can do this three times a day." replace="Venom immunity~timeless body"}

name: Archer
description: ## Archer ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/104› The archer is dedicated to the careful mastery of the bow, perfecting his skills with years of practice honed day after day on ranges and hunting for game, or else on the battlefield, raining destruction down on the enemy lines. ::ab[Hawkeye (Ex)]{l=2 icon=boost passive="An archer gains a bonus on Perception checks equal to 1 + ‹misc/one-fourth› his fighter level. The range increment for any bow he uses increases by 5 feet, plus an additional 5 feet for every four fighter levels he has." replace=Bravery} ::ab[Trick Shot (Ex)]{l=3 icon=power choice="An archer can choose one of the following combat maneuvers or actions: ‹rule/disarm›, ‹rule/feint›, or ‹rule/sunder›. He can perform this action with a bow against any target within 30 feet, with a -4 penalty to his CMB." imp7="He can choose a second option to receive this same benefit." imp11="He can choose a third trick shot option. Those options expand to include ‹rule/bull rush›, ‹rule/grapple›, and ‹rule/trip›. A target grappled by an arrow can break free by destroying the archer's arrow (hardness 5, hit points 1, break DC 13) or with an Escape Artist or CMB check (against the archer's CMD -4)." imp15="He can choose a fourth trick shot." imp19="He can choose a fifth trick shot." replace="Armor training 1, 2, 3, and 4" special="These maneuvers use up arrows as normal."} ::ab[Expert Archer (Ex)]{l=5 icon=boost passive="An archer gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with bows." increment="This bonus~5~4" replace="Weapon training 1"} ::ab[Safe Shot (Ex)]{l=9 icon=def passive="An archer does not provoke attacks of opportunity when making ranged attacks with a bow." replace="Weapon training 2"} ::ab[Evasive Archer (Ex)]{l=13 icon=def passive="An archer gains a +2 dodge bonus to AC against ranged attacks." imp17="This bonus becomes +4." replace="Weapon training 3"} ::ab[Volley (Ex)]{l=17 icon=power fullround="An archer can make a single bow attack at his highest base attack bonus against any number of creatures in a 15-foot-radius ‹misc/burst›, making separate attack and damage rolls for each creature." replace="Weapon training 4"} ::ab[Ranged Defense (Ex)]{l=19 icon=def passive="An archer gains DR 5/- against ranged attacks." order=pi immediate="He can catch an arrow fired at him and shoot it any target he chooses, as if he had the ‹feat/Snatch Arrows› feat." replace="Armor mastery"} ::ab[Weapon Mastery (Ex)]{icon=info info="An archer must choose a type of bow." alter="Weapon mastery"}

name: Armor Master
description: ## Armor Master ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/44› All fighters have two main tools of their trade: weapons and armor. While many fighters hone their weapon skills to a point of inescapable grace and lethality, there are those who live under the maxim that a good offense can be accomplished though an impenetrable defense. To these fighters, proper use of armor and shields ensures that they can fight another day, and that the frustration of enemies who can't seem to crack an armor master's superior defenses is just the first symptom of his foes' eventual defeat. ::ab[Deflective Shield (Ex)]{l=2 icon=def flavor="An armor master specializes in using his shield to deflect attacks." passive="He gains a +1 bonus to his touch AC, and this bonus increases for every four levels beyond 2nd (+2 at 6th level, +3 at 10th level, +4 at 14th level, and finally +5 at 18th level); however, this bonus cannot exceed the sum of the armor and enhancement bonus to AC provided by the shield that the armor master is currently carrying." replace=Bravery} ::ab[Armored Defense (Ex)]{l=5 icon=def passive="An armor master gains DR 1/- when wearing light armor, DR 2/- when wearing medium armor, and DR 3/- when wearing heavy armor." imp19="This damage reduction increases to DR 4/- when wearing light armor, DR 8/- when wearing medium armor, and DR 12/- when wearing heavy armor." special="This damage reduction stacks with that provided by ‹eq-material/adamantine› armor, but not with other forms of damage reduction. This damage reduction does not apply if the armor master is stunned, unconscious, or helpless." replace="Weapon training 1 and 3~armor mastery"} ::ab[Fortification (Ex)]{l=9 icon=def flavor="An armor master can use his armor to shield critical areas from injury." passive="He treats any armor he wears as if it had the ‹magic-enh/light fortification› special ability." imp13="His armor gains the ‹magic-enh/moderate fortification› special ability." special="This fortification does not stack in any way with armor that has these special abilities. In these cases the armor master takes the better of the two fortifications." replace="Weapon training 2 and 4"} ::ab[Indestructible (Ex)]{l=20 icon=def passive="An armor master gains complete immunity to critical hits and sneak attacks while he is wearing armor. In addition, unless his armor has the ‹misc/fragile› armor quality, it cannot be ‹rule/sunder«ed› while he is wearing it." replace="Weapon mastery"}

name: Brawler
description: ## Brawler >***Note:** This is a fighter archetype, and has no relation to the ‹class/brawler› hybrid class.* ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/44› All melee is up close and personal, but some warriors bring it as close as they can get. Brawlers can be found anywhere, among all races and societies. A brawler could be hired muscle in a tavern, a local crime syndicate enforcer, or a hotheaded recruit among the ranks of a baron's guard. Often brawlers' in-your-face attitudes are as powerful as their tactics. ::ab[Close Control (Ex)]{l=2 icon=boost-def flavor="A brawler becomes skilled at forcefully moving his opponent around the battlefield." passive="The brawler gains a +1 bonus on ‹rule/bull rush›, ‹rule/drag›, and ‹rule/reposition› combat maneuver checks. The brawler also gains a +1 bonus to CMD when attacked with the bull rush, drag, and reposition maneuvers." increment="p!These bonuses~2~4" replace="Armor training 1"} ::ab[Close Combatant (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost passive="A brawler gains a +1 bonus on attack rolls and a +3 bonus on damage rolls with weapons in the close ‹ability/weapon group<s›." imp7="These bonuses increase to +2 and +4, respectively." imp11="The bonuses become +3 and +5." imp15="These bonuses increase to +4 and +6." imp19="The bonuses become +5 on attack rolls and +7 on damage rolls." replace="Weapon training 1 and 2"} ::ab[Menacing Stance (Ex)]{l=7 icon=lower flavor="A brawler constantly harries and distracts his enemies." passive="While adjacent to the brawler, enemies take a -1 penalty on attack rolls and a -4 penalty on ‹rule/concentration› checks." imp11="These penalties increase to -2 and -5, respectively." imp15="The penalties become -3 and -6." imp19="These penalties increase to -4 on attack rolls and -7 on concentration checks." special="Creatures do not take these penalties if the brawler is dazed, helpless, staggered, stunned, or unconscious." replace="Armor training 2, 3, and 4~armor mastery"} ::ab[No Escape (Ex)]{l=9 icon=power-lower passive="Taking ‹rule/a 5-foot step› out of the area of a brawler's *menacing stance* or moving out of the area of a brawler's *menacing stance* with a ‹rule/withdraw› action provokes an attack of opportunity from the brawler." replace="Weapon training 3 and 4"} ::ab[Stand Still]{l=13 icon=power-boost ability="A brawler gains ‹feat/Stand Still› as a bonus feat, even if he does not have the ‹feat/Combat Reflexes› feat. If the brawler already has the Stand Still feat, he can take any other ‹main/combat feat› instead." order=ap passive="He gains a bonus equal to ‹misc/half› his fighter level on combat maneuver checks when using the Stand Still feat."} ::ab[Weapon Mastery (Ex)]{icon=info choice="A brawler must select a close weapon for this ability." alter="Weapon mastery"}

name: Cad
description: ## Cad ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/45› In combat, most fighters have some sort of code of honor. Some believe that one should not kick enemies when they are down, or should limit use of other such dirty tricks to the most dire of circumstances. The cad places no such limitations on himself. Battles are for winning, and anything that gives the cad the upper hand against his enemies is a legitimate tactic. No trick is too treacherous if it leads to victory. ::ab[Weapon and Armor Proficiency]{icon=down info="A cad is not proficient with medium armor, heavy armor, or tower shields."} ::cskill{gain=acro~bluff~ea~soh~stl} ::ab[Dirty Maneuvers (Ex)]{l=2 icon=boost-def flavor="A cad becomes skilled at deceiving and discomfiting his opponents." passive="The cad gains a +1 bonus on ‹rule/disarm›, ‹rule/dirty trick›, and ‹rule/steal› combat maneuver checks. The cad also gains a +1 bonus to CMD when attacked with the disarm, dirty trick, and steal combat maneuvers." increment="p!These bonuses~2~4" replace=Bravery} ::ab[Catch Off-Guard]{l=3 icon=power ability="The cad gains the ‹feat/Catch Off-Guard› feat." replace="Armor training 1"} ::ab[Payback (Ex)]{l=5 icon=boost passive="A cad gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls against any creature that has attacked the cad since the beginning of his last turn." increment="This bonus~5~4" replace="Weapon training 1, 3, and 4"} ::ab[Deadly Surprise (Ex)]{l=7 icon=power ability="When a cad hits an opponent that is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC against him with a weapon or unarmed attack, he may attempt a dirty trick combat maneuver as an @HLimmediate_action as part of the attack." replace="Armor training 2"} ::ab[Razor-Sharp Chair Leg (Ex)]{l=9 icon=power-boost swift="A cad may alter the type of damage dealt by an ‹misc/improvised weapon› to bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage." order=wp passive="The cad has a critical threat range of 19-20/&times&2 with any improvised melee weapon." replace="Weapon training 2"} ::ab[Craven Combatant (Ex)]{l=11 icon=def passive="When ‹misc/fighting defensively› or using ‹feat/Combat Expertise› or ‹misc/total defense›, a cad cannot be ‹rule/flanked› except by a rogue or ninja whose level is four or more higher than the cad's fighter level." replace="Armor training 3"} ::ab[Sweeping Prank (Ex)]{l=13 icon=power standard="A cad can use a dirty trick maneuver against any two adjacent opponents that he can reach, making a separate combat maneuver check against each opponent. He must use the same dirty trick maneuver against each opponent." imp17="The cad can use this ability as a @HLfull-round_action to attempt a dirty trick maneuver against a number of enemies equal to 2 + his Dexterity bonus (if any)." replace="Weapon training 3 and 4"} ::ab[Treacherous Blow (Ex)]{l=15 icon=power immediate="When a cad confirms a critical hit, he can attempt a dirty trick combat maneuver as part of that attack." replace="Armor training 4"} ::ab[Ultimate Payback (Ex)]{l=20 icon=boost passive="Any critical threats a cad makes against an opponent that has attacked him since the beginning of his last turn are automatically confirmed." replace="Weapon mastery"}

name: Crossbowman
description: ## Crossbowman ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/104› The crossbowman has perfected the deadly use of the ‹eq-weapon/crossbow›, a simple but cruelly efficient weapon, as a craftsman mastering a lethal tool. ::ab[Deadshot (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost ability="When a crossbowman attacks with a crossbow as a ‹rule/readied action›, he may add ‹misc/half› his Dexterity bonus (minimum +1) on his damage roll." replace="Armor training 1"} ::ab[Crossbow Expert (Ex)]{l=5 icon=boost passive="A crossbowman gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with crossbows." increment="This bonus~5~4" replace="Weapon training 1"} ::ab[Improved Deadshot (Ex)]{l=7 icon=lower passive="When a crossbowman attacks with a crossbow as a readied action, his target is denied its Dexterity bonus to its AC." replace="Armor training 2"} ::ab[Quick Sniper (Ex)]{l=9 icon=boost passive="A crossbowman gains a bonus equal to 1/2 his fighter level on Stealth checks when ‹skill/sniping›." order=pi immediate="When he is hit with a ranged attack, he can shoot his crossbow at his attacker if it is loaded." replace="Weapon training 2"} ::ab[Greater Deadshot (Ex)]{l=11 icon=boost ability="When a crossbowman attacks with a crossbow as a readied action, he may add his Dexterity bonus (minimum +1) on his damage roll." replace="Armor training 3"} ::ab[Safe Shot (Ex)]{l=13 icon=def passive="A crossbowman does not provoke attacks of opportunity when making ranged attacks with a crossbow." replace="Weapon training 3"} ::ab[Pinpoint Targeting]{l=15 icon=power ability="A crossbowman gains ‹feat/Pinpoint Targeting› as a bonus feat." replace="Armor training 4"} ::ab[Meteor Shot (Ex)]{l=17 icon=ranged standard="A crossbowman can make one attack with a crossbow at a -4 penalty. If the attack hits, it inflicts damage normally and the target is subject to a ‹rule/bull rush› or a ‹rule/trip› maneuver using the attack roll as the combat maneuver check. The crossbowman must decide which maneuver to attempt before making his attack roll." replace="Weapon training 4"} ::ab[Penetrating Shot (Ex)]{l=19 icon=boost passive="When a crossbowman confirms a critical hit with a crossbow, the bolt pierces the target and can strike another creature in line behind it. The crossbowman must be able to trace a line starting at his space and passing through both targets to make this additional attack. The secondary attack is made at a -4 penalty, in addition to any modifiers for added range. If this attack is also a critical hit, the bolt can continue to hit another target, but the penalties stack." replace="Armor mastery"} ::ab[Weapon Mastery (Ex)]{icon=info info="A crossbowman must choose a type of crossbow when he receives *weapon mastery.*" alter="Weapon mastery"}

name: Dragoon
description: ## Dragoon ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/46› These gallant lancers serve in the vanguard of many armies or as knights-errant. They are born leaders and masters of the mounted charge. ::ab[Weapon and Armor Proficiency]{icon=down info="A dragoon is not proficient with tower shields."} ::ab[Skilled Rider (Ex)]{l=1 icon=power ability="A dragoon gains both the ‹feat/Mounted Combat› and ‹feat/Skill Focus› (Ride) feats as bonus feats." replace="The 1st-level fighter bonus combat feat"} ::ab[Spear Training (Ex)]{l=5 icon=info choice="A dragoon must select *weapon training* with the ‹ability/weapon>spear» group<s›." imp9="The dragoon's *weapon training* bonus with spears improves by +1 on attack rolls and +2 on damage rolls." imp13="The dragoon's *weapon training* bonus with spears improves by another +1 on attack rolls and another +2 on damage rolls." imp17="The dragoon's *weapon training* bonus with spears improves by yet another +1 on attack rolls and +2 on damage rolls." special="The dragoon does not gain *weapon training* in any other groups as he increases in level." alter="Weapon training"} ::ab[Spinning Lance (Ex)]{l=7 icon=melee ability="A dragoon may alternate attacks with the piercing head of his ‹eq-weapon/lance› with reach, or with the butt end (treat as a ‹eq-weapon/club›) against adjacent targets." special="Unlike a double weapon, the masterwork quality and magical special abilities apply to both ends of the lance, except for those weapon special abilities that apply only to edged weapons." replace="Armor training 2"} ::ab[Banner (Ex)]{l=9 icon=power ability="A dragoon may attach a banner to his lance. This is identical to the ‹class/cavalier› class feature." special="Cavalier levels stack with his dragoon level for determining the effect of his banner, and he can take the better banner progression." replace="Weapon training 2, 3, and 4" imp14="The bonuses provided by the dragoon's banner increase by +1." imp19="The bonuses provided by the dragoon's banner increase by +2."} ::ab[Piercing Lance (Ex)]{l=11 icon=melee-boost ability="As a @HLstandard_action or as part of a ‹rule/charge›, a dragoon attacking a mounted opponent can make two attacks, one against the mount and the other against the rider, using his highest base attack bonus. Furthermore, if the mount is hit and its rider attempts to negate the hit with the Mounted Combat feat, the dragoon's attack roll is considered 4 higher when calculating the DC of the Ride check to negate the hit." replace="Armor training 3"} ::ab[Leaping Lance (Ex)]{l=15 icon=boost passive="A dragoon and his mount suffer no armor check penalty on Acrobatics checks while mounted." order=pa ability="When charging, a dragoon may jump from his mount toward his target. If he jumps 10 feet, his charge modifiers on attack rolls and to AC are doubled and he is still considered mounted for lance damage, mounted combat feats, and so on." replace="Armor training 4" special="This ability qualifies you for the ‹feat/Rebounding Leap› feat."} ::ab[Weapon Mastery]{icon=info choice="The dragoon must select the lance for *weapon mastery.*" alter="Weapon mastery"}

name: Free Hand Fighter
description: ## Free Hand Fighter ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/105› The free hand fighter specializes in the delicate art of handling a single weapon in one hand while using his free hand to balance, block, tip, and distract his opponents. While not a brawler, his open hand is as much a weapon as a bow or blade. His fighting school benefits only apply when he is using a one-handed weapon and carrying nothing in his other hand. ::ab[Deceptive Strike (Ex)]{l=2 icon=boost passive="A free hand fighter gains a +1 bonus to CMB and CMD on ‹rule/disarm› checks and on Bluff checks to feint or create a diversion to hide." increment="This bonus~2~4" replace=Bravery} ::ab[Elusive (Ex)]{l=3 icon=def passive="A free hand fighter gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC." special="This bonus does not apply when wearing medium or heavy armor or carrying a medium or heavier load." increment="This bonus~2~4" replace="Armor training 1, 2, 3, and 4"} ::ab[Singleton (Ex)]{l=5 icon=boost passive="A free hand fighter gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls when wielding a melee weapon in one hand and leaving his other hand free." increment="This bonus~5~6" replace="Weapon training 1 and 4"} ::ab[Timely Tip (Ex)]{l=9 icon=melee-lower move="A free hand fighter can make a disarm combat maneuver against a target he threatens to push aside the target's shield. If successful, the target loses its shield bonus to AC against the free hand fighter's next attack." replace="Weapon training 2"} ::ab[Interference (Ex)]{l=13 icon=melee-lower move="A free hand fighter can make a disarm or ‹rule/trip› combat maneuver against a target he threatens to push his opponent off balance. If successful, the target becomes ‹rule/flat-footed›. This condition lasts until the target takes damage from a melee or ranged attack or until the beginning of the free hand fighter's next turn, whichever comes first." replace="Weapon training 3"} ::ab[Reversal (Ex)]{l=19 icon=melee-def immediate="A free hand fighter can make a disarm combat maneuver against a creature he threatens when he is the target of a melee attack from another creature. If successful, the attack changes to target the target of the free hand fighter's maneuver instead of the free hand fighter himself." replace="Armor mastery"}

name: Gladiator

features.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
features.replaces: Proficiency with heavy armor and tower shields

description: ## Gladiator ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/47› Most fighters battle out of necessity, with each battle a contest of life and death. Some, however, fight for glory and for the adulation of the crowd. The gladiator is both a cunning warrior and a consummate performer, knowing life and death are balanced not only on a sword's edge, but also on the cheers or jeers of the crowd. ::cskill{gain="‹skill/Perform« (act, comedy, and dance)› (CHA)"} ::ab[Weapon and Armor Proficiency]{icon=power-def ability="A gladiator gains the ‹feat/Performance Weapon Mastery› feat at 1st level as a bonus feat. This bonus feat is in addition to the bonus feat a fighter gains at 1st level. Furthermore, a gladiator using ‹rule/piecemeal armor› is considered to be wearing a suit of armor as long as he wearing two or three armor pieces, gaining the +1 to armor bonus but still taking the +5% chance of arcane spell failure if the pieces are mixed." replace="Proficiency with heavy armor and tower shields"} ::ab[Bonus Feats]{icon=power ability="A gladiator may choose to take ‹main/combat performance› feats as bonus feats."} ::ab[Fame (Ex)]{l=2 icon=boost passive="When a gladiator begins a ‹rule/performance combat›, he always starts with at least 1 victory point. If he already has victory points, he gains 1 extra victory point." imp10="The gladiator starts out with at least 2 victory points. If he already has victory points, he gains 2 extra victory points." replace=Bravery}

name: Mobile Fighter
description: ## Mobile Fighter ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/105› Where some fighters focus on strength and raw power, the mobile fighter relies on swiftness and mobility, gliding across the battlefield like a steel whirlwind and leaving destruction in his wake. ::ab[Agility (Ex)]{l=2 icon=def passive="A mobile fighter gains a +1 bonus on saving throws made against effects that cause him to become ‹rule/paralyzed›, ‹spell/slow«ed›, or ‹rule/entangled›." increment="This bonus~2~4" replace=Bravery} ::ab[Leaping Attack (Ex)]{l=5 icon=boost passive="When a mobile fighter moves at least 5 feet prior to attacking, he gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls." increment="This bonus~5~4" replace="Weapon training 1, 2, 3, and 4"} ::ab[Rapid Attack (Ex)]{l=11 icon=power ability="A mobile fighter can combine a ‹rule/full attack› action with a single move. He must forgo the attack at his highest bonus but may take the remaining attacks at any point during his movement. This movement provokes attacks of opportunity as normal." replace="Armor training 3"} ::ab[Fleet Footed (Ex)]{l=15 icon=boost-power ability="The mobile fighter's speed increases by 10 feet. He can ‹rule/take 10› on Acrobatics checks even while distracted or threatened, and can take 20 on an Acrobatics check three times per day." imp20="He can take 20 four times a day." replace="Armor training 4"} ::ab[Whirlwind Blitz (Ex)]{l=20 icon=power standard="A mobile fighter can make a full-attack action. He may also use the ‹feat/Whirlwind Attack› feat as a @HLstandard_action." replace="Weapon mastery"}

name: Phalanx Soldier
description: ## Phalanx Soldier ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/105› The phalanx soldier specializes in defensive tactics, using his shield to guard himself and his allies and forming a shield wall like an unbreakable anvil against which his enemies break. ::ab[Stand Firm (Ex)]{l=2 icon=def passive="A phalanx soldier gains a +1 bonus to CMD against ‹rule/bull rush›, ‹rule/overrun›, and ‹rule/trip› attempts. This bonus also applies on saves against ‹umr/trample› attacks." increment="The bonus~2~4" replace=Bravery} ::ab[Phalanx Fighting (Ex)]{l=3 icon=melee ability="When a phalanx soldier wields a shield, he can use any polearm or spear of his size as a one-handed weapon." replace="Armor training 1"} ::ab[Ready Pike (Ex)]{l=5 icon=melee-boost immediate="A phalanx soldier can ‹rule/ready› a weapon with the ‹misc/brace› property, gaining a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls." useInc=fighter~4~5 useF="5~1~4" increment="This bonus~5~4" special="He cannot use this ability when ‹rule/flat-footed›." replace="Weapon training 1"} ::ab[Deft Shield (Ex)]{l=7 icon=def-boost passive="The armor check penalty from a shield and the attack roll penalty are reduced by 1 for a phalanx soldier using a ‹eq-armor/tower shield›." imp11="These penalties are reduced by 2." replace="Armor training 2 and 3"} ::ab[Shield Ally (Ex)]{l=9 icon=def-protect move="When a phalanx fighter is using a heavy or tower shield, he can provide partial ‹rule/cover› (+2 cover bonus to AC, +1 bonus on Reflex saves) to himself and all adjacent allies until the beginning of his next turn." imp13="He can instead provide cover (+4 cover bonus to AC, +2 bonus on Reflex saves) and ‹ability/evasion› (as a ‹class/rogue›) to one adjacent ally until the beginning of his next turn. This cover does not allow Stealth checks." imp17="He can provide cover to himself and all adjacent allies, or he can provide improved cover (+8 cover bonus to AC, +4 bonus on Reflex saves, ‹ability/improved evasion›) to a single adjacent ally." replace="Weapon training 2, 3, and 4"} ::ab[Irresistible Advance (Ex)]{l=15 icon=boost passive="A phalanx fighter gains a bonus on bull rush and overrun CMB checks. This bonus depends on the type of shield used: +1 with a buckler, +2 with a light shield, +3 with a heavy shield, or +4 with a tower shield." replace="Armor training 4"} ::ab[Shielded Fortress (Ex)]{l=20 icon=def-protect passive="A phalanx fighter's shield cannot be ‹rule/disarm«ed› or ‹rule/sunder«ed›. He gains *evasion* (as a rogue) when using a shield (*improved evasion* when using a tower shield)." move="A phalanx fighter can provide *evasion* to all adjacent allies until the beginning of his next turn." immediate="He can provide *improved evasion* to an adjacent ally against one attack." order=pmi replace="Weapon mastery"}

name: Polearm Master
description: ## Polearm Master ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/106› The polearm master is schooled in the ancient wisdom that enemies are best faced at the end of long striking pole, lashing like a serpent before clumsy swords and axes can even be brought to bear. ::ab[Pole Fighting (Ex)]{l=2 icon=melee immediate="A polearm master can shorten the grip on his spear or polearm with reach and use it against adjacent targets. This action results in a -4 penalty on attack rolls with that weapon until he spends another immediate action to return to the normal grip." increment="The penalty on attack rolls~2~4~-3~-1" replace=Bravery} ::ab[Steadfast Pike (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost passive="A polearm master gains a +1 bonus on attack rolls with ‹rule/readied› attacks and attacks of opportunity made with a spear or polearm." increment="The bonus~3~4" replace="Armor training 1, 2, 3, and 4"} ::ab[Polearm Training (Ex)]{l=5 icon=boost passive="A polearm master gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with spears and polearms." increment="The bonus~5~4" replace="Weapon training 1"} ::ab[Flexible Flanker (Ex)]{l=9 icon=power ability="A polearm master may choose any square adjacent to him and treat that square as his location for determining who he is ‹rule/flanking›, even if that square is occupied by a creature, object, or solid barrier." replace="Weapon training 2"} ::ab[Sweeping Fend (Ex)]{l=13 icon=power ability="A polearm master can use any spear or polearm to make ‹rule/bull rush› maneuvers, though he takes a -4 penalty on combat maneuver checks when making such attempts. Weapons with the trip property do not incur this penalty on trip maneuvers." replace="Weapon training 3"} ::ab[Step Aside (Ex)]{l=17 icon=def immediate="When a creature threatened by a polearm master takes ‹rule/a 5-foot step› into a square adjacent to him, he can take a 5-foot step. He also gains a +2 dodge bonus to his AC against that opponent until the end of his next turn." replace="Weapon training 4"} ::ab[Polearm Parry (Ex)]{l=19 icon=protect-def immediate="When an opponent threatened by a polearm master makes a melee attack against an ally, he may grant his ally a +2 shield bonus to AC and DR 5/- against that attack." special="He may use this ability to protect himself, but only if the attacking creature is not adjacent to him." replace="Armor mastery"} ::ab[Weapon Mastery (Ex)]{icon=info info="A polearm master must choose a spear or polearm for *weapon mastery.*" alter="Weapon mastery"}

name: Roughrider
description: ## Roughrider ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/106› Roughriders study and practice the fine points of mounted combat, drilling endlessly with warbeasts - from noble thoroughbreds to trained monsters - to form a perfect synergy between rider and steed. ::ab[Steadfast Mount (Ex)]{l=2 icon=def passive="After a roughrider has spent 1 hour practicing with a mount, the mount gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC and a +1 morale bonus on saves, but only while the roughrider is mounted on it or adjacent to it." increment="This bonus~2~4" replace=Bravery} ::ab[Armored Charger (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost passive="A roughrider no longer suffers armor check penalties on Ride skill checks. His mount's speed is not reduced when carrying a medium load or wearing medium barding." replace="Armor training 1"} ::ab[Mounted Mettle (Ex)]{l=5 icon=boost passive="A roughrider and his mount gain a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls when he is mounted or adjacent to his mount." increment="This bonus~5~4" replace="Weapon training 1, 2, 3, and 4"} ::ab[Leap from the Saddle (Ex)]{l=7 icon=power ability="After a roughrider's mount takes a single move, he may attempt a fast dismount (DC 20 Ride check). If he succeeds, he can take a ‹rule/full attack› action." replace="Armor training 2"} ::ab[Relentless Steed (Ex)]{l=11 icon=power-roll passive="A roughrider's mount does not reduce its speed when wearing heavy barding or carrying a heavy load." ability="The roughrider may reroll a Ride skill check or a saving throw made by the mount, but must use the second roll even if it is worse." useInc=fighter~4~11 useF="11~1~4" order=pau replace="Armor training 3"} ::ab[Ride Them Down (Ex)]{l=15 icon=melee ability="A roughrider can spur his mount on while readying an attack. If a roughrider's mount takes a single move, the roughrider can make a full attack, taking his attacks at any point during his mount's movement. If he has the ‹feat/Trample› feat, he may substitute an ‹rule/overrun› combat maneuver for each of his attacks. This movement provokes attacks of opportunity against the roughrider but not his mount." replace="Armor training 4"} ::ab[Unavoidable Onslaught (Ex)]{l=15 icon=power passive="A roughrider's mounted charge is not blocked by friendly creatures or ‹rule/difficult terrain›." replace="Armor training 4"} ::ab[Indomitable Steed (Ex)]{l=19 icon=def passive="A roughrider and his steed gain DR 5/- when mounted." replace="Armor mastery"}

name: Savage Warrior
description: ## Savage Warrior ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/107› Warriors' might is not measured only by their skill with steel, but also by their ability to inflict death with fang and claw, horn and hoof, and every exotic appendage the natural and unnatural world has to offer. ::ab[Spark of Life (Ex)]{l=2 icon=def passive="A savage warrior gains a +1 bonus on saving throws made against energy drain and death effects." increment="The bonus~2~4" replace=Bravery} ::ab[Natural Savagery (Ex)]{l=5 icon=boost passive="A savage warrior gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with natural weapons. This bonus also applies to CMB and CMD for ‹rule/grappl«ing<e›." increment="This bonus~5~4" replace="Weapon training 1"} ::ab[Savage Charge (Ex)]{l=9 icon=boost-down passive="When a savage warrior attacks with a natural weapon at the end of a ‹rule/charge›, he gains a bonus on his natural weapon attack rolls equal to ‹misc/half› his fighter level, while suffering a penalty to his AC equal to ‹misc/half› his fighter level. These replace the normal attack roll bonus and AC penalty for charging. This bonus also applies to his CMB for a ‹rule/bull rush› or ‹rule/overrun› combat maneuvers made when charging." replace="Weapon training 2"} ::ab[Careful Claw (Ex)]{l=13 icon=def passive="When using a natural weapon to attack a creature using ‹spell/fire shield› or a similar effect that damages creatures attacking it (such as a ‹monster/barbed devil«'s› barbed defense), a savage warrior reduces the damage from such effects by an amount equal to 1/2 his fighter level." replace="Weapon training 3"} ::ab[Greater Savage Charge (Ex)]{l=17 icon=def-melee passive="When using *savage charge,* the AC penalty is reduced to 1/4 his fighter level instead of 1/2 his fighter level. In addition, a savage warrior can charge through friendly creatures and ‹rule/difficult terrain›." replace="Weapon training 4"} ::ab[Natural Weapon Mastery (Ex)]{l=20 icon=info info="A savage warrior must choose one natural weapon." replace="Weapon mastery"}

name: Shielded Fighter
description: ## Shielded Fighter ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/108› A shielded fighter focuses on both offense and defense, blending weapon and shield in perfect balance to impede his enemies while delivering deadly blows, and even turning the shield itself into a formidable weapon. These fighting school benefits apply when wielding a weapon and a shield simultaneously. ::ab[Active Defense (Ex)]{l=3 icon=def passive="A shielded fighter gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC when wielding a shield and ‹misc/fighting defensively›, using ‹feat/Combat Expertise›, or using ‹misc/total defense›." increment="The dodge bonus~3~4" swift="He may share this bonus with one adjacent ally, or ‹misc/half› of the bonus (minimum +0) with all adjacent allies, until the beginning of his next turn." order=pw replace="Armor training 1, 2, 3, and 4"} ::ab[Shield Fighter (Ex)]{l=5 icon=boost-def passive="A shielded fighter gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls when making a ‹misc/shield bash›." increment="The bonus~5~4" special="With a ‹rule/full attack› action, a shielded fighter may alternate between using his weapon or his shield for each attack. This action does not grant additional attacks or incur penalties as two-weapon fighting does." replace="Weapon training 1"} ::ab[Shield Buffet (Ex)]{l=9 icon=lower move="A shielded fighter may make a combat maneuver check to use his shield to impede an adjacent enemy. If successful, the target suffers a -2 penalty on its attack rolls against the shielded fighter and a -2 penalty to AC on attacks made by the shielded fighter until the beginning of his next turn." imp13="A shielded fighter may use this ability as a @HLswift_action." replace="Weapon training 2 and 3"} ::ab[Shield Guard (Ex)]{l=17 icon=def swift="A shielded fighter may designate one square adjacent to him. He may designate two squares if using a heavy shield or three squares if using a tower shield, but these squares must be contiguous. Enemies in these squares cannot ‹rule/flank› the shielded fighter and do not count for flanking with other creatures. This effect lasts until he moves from his position or uses another swift action to change the affected squares." replace="Weapon training 4"} ::ab[Shield Mastery (Ex)]{l=19 icon=def passive="A shielded fighter gains DR 5/- when wielding a shield." replace="Armor mastery"} ::ab[Shield Ward (Ex)]{l=20 icon=def passive="A shielded fighter gains ‹ability/evasion› (as a ‹class/rogue›) while wielding a shield, and adds his shield bonus to his AC (not including enhancement bonuses) on Reflex saves and to his touch AC. In addition, his shield cannot be ‹rule/disarm«ed› or ‹rule/sunder«ed›." replace="Weapon mastery"}

name: Skirmisher
description: ## Skirmisher **Source** ‹source/Ultimate Wilderness« pg. 50›, [errata](https://paizo.com/paizo/faq/v5748nruor1hj#v5748eaic9wc9) Not all battles are fought between armies; sometimes, a settlement or nation faces a threat too dire to fight in the open. In order to repel a much larger enemy force, some soldiers must abandon equipment and tactics designed for open-field warfare and instead rely on ambushes, hit-and-run tactics, and sabotage to whittle down their enemies' strength and morale. Skirmishers use harsh weather and unforgiving terrain to their advantage, attacking isolated groups of enemies that cannot flee or fight back effectively. Many tribal warriors also employ small-unit tactics because it is part of their warrior culture, because they cannot field a large army, or simply because they refuse to fight on the enemy's terms. ::ab[Armor Proficiency]{icon=down info="A skirmisher is proficient with light armor and shields but not with medium armor, heavy armor, or tower shields." replace="The fighter's armor proficiency"} ::ab[Wilderness Training (Ex)]{icon=skill info="A skirmisher relies on his skills and the element of surprise rather than the heaviest shields and armor. He gains ‹skill/Acrobatics› (DEX) and ‹skill/Stealth› (DEX) as class skills. In addition, the skirmisher gains a number of skill ranks at each level equal to 4 + his Intelligence modifier, instead of 2 + his Intelligence modifier." alter="Class skills~skill ranks per level"} ::ab[Conditioning (Ex)]{head l=2 icon=def choice="A skirmisher becomes more resistant to mental and physical threats that are commonly employed by his enemies or often encountered in the terrain in which he operates. The skirmisher must choose one of the specializations below, gaining a +1 bonus on saving throws of the appropriate type." increment="The saving throw bonus~2~4" replace="2nd level fighter bonus feat"} ::ab[Alpine Training (Ex)]{next icon=def passive="A skirmisher operating in mountainous terrain becomes resistant to cold climates and the rigors of long treks at high altitudes. He gains a bonus on Fortitude saving throws against ‹rule/altitude sickness›, exposure to ‹rule/cold« weather›, and other effects that cause ‹misc/fatigue› or ‹misc/exhaustion›."} ::ab[Counter-Interrogation Training (Ex)]{next icon=def passive="A skirmisher undertaking infiltration missions learns to resist interrogation and persuasion. The skirmisher gains a bonus on Will saving throws against charms and divinations."} ::ab[Jungle Training (Ex)]{next icon=def passive="Through repeated exposure, a skirmisher operating in jungles and wetlands builds up a tolerance against pathogens and toxins. He gains a bonus on Fortitude saving throws against disease and poison."} ::ab[Light Infantry Training (Ex)]{next icon=def passive="A skirmisher fighting in a light infantry unit learns to avoid fire from enemy artillery, siege weapons, and spellcasters. He gains a bonus on Reflex saving throws against attacks that deal half damage on a successful save (such as the ‹spell/fireball› spell) but not against traps, natural hazards, or environmental effects."} ::ab[Reconnaissance Training (Ex)]{l=2 flavor="A skirmisher operating in heavily trapped or naturally hazardous areas learns to expertly avoid them." icon=def passive="He gains a +1 bonus on Reflex saving throws to avoid traps, natural hazards, and environmental effects." increment="This bonus~2~4" replace=Bravery} ::ab[Mobility Training (Ex)]{l=3 icon=def-boost passive="A skirmisher learns to be more maneuverable while wearing light or no armor. He gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC while wearing light or no armor and while carrying no more than a light load. Anything that causes the skirmisher to lose his Dexterity bonus to AC also causes the skirmisher to lose this dodge bonus. In addition, a skirmisher gains an enhancement bonus of +5 feet to his base speed. This benefit applies only when he is wearing no armor or light armor, and when he is carrying no more than a light load." imp7="The bonus to speed becomes +10 feet, and the dodge bonus becomes +2." imp11="The dodge bonus becomes +3." imp15="The dodge bonus increases to +4." replace="Armor training"} ::ab[Mobile Mastery (Ex)]{l=19 icon=def passive="A skirmisher learns to position his body and conceal his body proportions with clothes so well that it is difficult to hit him. He gains a 20% miss chance on attacks against him. Mobile mastery functions even when the skirmisher is ‹rule/flat-footed›, but not when he is immobilized or ‹misc/helpless›, when he wears medium or heavy armor, or when he carries a medium or heavy load." replace="Armor mastery"}

name: Tactician

features.name: Strategic Training (Ex)
features.replaces: The bonus fighter combat feat gained at 1st level

description: ## Tactician ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/47› While many fighters focus on the fundamentals of melee and ranged combat, there are those who are trained to view the bigger picture on the battlefield. These fighters use their training and tactical acumen to overcome challenges that would overwhelm mere brute strength and skill at arms. ::ab[Armor Proficiency]{icon=down info="A tactician is not proficient with heavy armor or tower shields." alter="Armor proficiencies"} ::ab[Strategic Training (Ex)]{icon=skill info="A tactician gains 4 skill points + a number of skill points equal to his Intelligence modifier at each level, instead of the normal 2 skill points + Intelligence modifier at each level. Furthermore, ‹skill/Diplomacy› (Cha), ‹skill/Knowledge (geography)› (Int), ‹skill/Knowledge (nobility)› (Int), ‹skill/Linguistics› (Int), and ‹skill/Sense Motive› (Wis) are all class skills for the tactician." replace="The bonus fighter combat feat gained at 1st level"} ::ab[Bonus Feats]{icon=power info="A tactician may choose ‹feat/Skill Focus› or any ‹main/teamwork feat›, in addition to combat feats, as bonus feats."} ::ab[Tactical Awareness (Ex)]{l=2 icon=boost passive="A tactician gains a +1 bonus on initiative checks." increment="This bonus~2~4" replace=Bravery} ::ab[Tactician (Ex)]{l=5 icon=power ability="A tactician gains this ability as the ‹class/cavalier› class feature." useL=fighter useUnit=time special="If the tactician also has cavalier levels, these levels stack for determining the number of uses per day, and he can take the better progression." order=au replace="Weapon training 1"} ::ab[Cooperative Combatant (Ex)]{l=11 icon=power ability="When a tactician uses the ‹rule/aid another<_2› special attack, he may affect one additional ally per point of Intelligence bonus. name: Thunderstriker
description: ## Thunderstriker ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/48› The thunderstriker adopts an unusual fighting style, gripping a heavy weapon with both hands and switching to a defensive posture with weapon and buckler, lashing out with the shield with surprising speed and power. ::ab[Strapped Shield (Ex)]{l=3 icon=def passive="A thunderstriker takes no penalty on attack rolls when using a weapon in two hands while wearing a ‹eq-armor/buckler›." replace="Armor training 1"} ::ab[Hardbuckler (Ex)]{l=7 icon=melee ability="A thunderstriker may make ‹misc/shield bash› attacks with a buckler as if it were a ‹eq-armor/light shield›." replace="Armor training 2"} ::ab[Knockback Smash (Ex)]{l=11 icon=boost passive="When a thunderstriker uses his buckler to attack, he gains a bonus equal to the enhancement bonus of the buckler on both attack and damage rolls." replace="Armor training 3"} ::ab[Hammer and Anvil (Ex)]{l=13 icon=boost passive="A thunderstriker suffers only half the normal penalties for two-weapon fighting when using a buckler as his off-hand weapon." replace="Weapon training 3"} ::ab[Buckler Defense (Ex)]{l=15 icon=def passive="A thunderstriker retains partial use of his buckler even when using a weapon in both hands or in each hand (rather than losing his shield bonus until the beginning of his next turn). He gains a +1 shield bonus to AC and may apply the benefits of any feats he knows that require the use of a shield, but does not benefit from any magical properties his shield may possess." replace="Armor training 4"} ::ab[Balanced Bashing (Ex)]{l=17 icon=boost passive="A thunderstriker no longer suffers two-weapon fighting penalties when using a buckler as his off-hand weapon." replace="Weapon training 4"} ::ab[Improved Buckler Defense (Ex)]{l=19 icon=def passive="A thunderstriker does not forfeit his shield bonus to AC from a buckler when fighting two-handed." replace="Armor mastery"}

name: Tower Shield Specialist
description: ## Tower Shield Specialist ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/48› Many fighters believe the ‹eq-armor/tower shield› is a tool suitable only for troops on the battlefield, claiming it is too large and bulky to use in skirmishes or within dungeon corridors. Tower shield specialists defy those notions, using their massive shields with startling skill and incredible effect. They use these seemingly clumsy shields to perform deft maneuvers that confound their enemies. ::ab[Burst Barrier (Ex)]{l=2 icon=def passive="A tower shield specialist can use his shield to screen himself from burst spells and effects, gaining a +1 bonus on Reflex saves against them while employing a tower shield." increment="This bonus~2~4" replace=Bravery} ::ab[Tower Shield Training (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost ability="A tower shield specialist gains *armor training* as normal, but while he employs a tower shield, the armor penalty is reduced by 3 and the maximum Dexterity bonus allowed by his armor increases by 2. The benefit increases every four levels thereafter as per standard *armor training;* if the tower shield specialist is not employing a tower shield, the benefits to *armor training* revert to the normal bonuses."} ::ab[Tower Shield Specialist (Ex)]{l=5 icon=boost passive="When a tower shield specialist employs a tower shield in combat, he does not take the -2 penalty on attack rolls because of the shield's encumbrance." replace="Weapon training 1"} ::ab[Tower Shield Defense (Ex)]{l=9 icon=def passive="While using a tower shield, a tower shield specialist gains his shield bonus against touch attacks." replace="Weapon training 2"} ::ab[Immediate Repositioning (Ex)]{l=13 icon=power immediate="A tower shield specialist can reposition his tower shield to another facing, but he cannot use this ability to interrupt an attack." replace="Weapon training 3"} ::ab[Tower Shield Evasion (Ex)]{l=16 icon=def ability="While using a tower shield, the tower shield specialist gains ‹ability/evasion›, as the ‹class/rogue› class ability." imp20="The shield specialist gains ‹talent/improved evasion›, as the rogue advanced talent, while using a tower shield." replace="Weapon training 4~weapon mastery"}

name: Tribal Fighter

features.name: Battle Focus (Ex)
features.replaces: The fighter feat gained at 1st level

description: ## Tribal Fighter ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/50› A tribal fighter knows that it is not the weapon that matters but the hand that wields it. Instead of encasing himself in metal armor like the soldiers fighting and dying for the so-called civilized lands do, he prefers to wear something he or his ancestors have killed. These relics and trophies help the tribal fighter attain a battle focus that allows him to perform incredible feats of violence with the simplest of weapons. ::ab[Forbidden Armor]{icon=down info="A tribal fighter favors traditional armor and shields, avoiding other types out of spiritual devotion, superstitious suspicion, or respect for tradition. He can attain his *battle focus* only while using armaments of the appropriate types. Like a ‹class/druid›, a tribal fighter is prohibited from wearing metal armor and using metal shields. A tribal fighter who wears prohibited armor or uses a prohibited shield loses the benefits of the *battle focus* and *tribal weapon training* abilities while doing so and for 24 hours after removing the prohibited armor or shield." alter="Armor proficiency"} ::ab[Battle Focus (Ex)]{icon=power ability="A tribal fighter learns to fight with his bare hands and wield traditional tribal weapons so effortlessly that they are almost extensions of his arms. He gains ‹feat/Improved Unarmed Strike› as a bonus feat. For the purpose of meeting the prerequisites of ‹main/style feat«s› and feats that have style feats as prerequisites, the tribal fighter counts as having a number of skill ranks equal to his fighter level in all skills in which he is trained." replace="The fighter feat gained at 1st level"} ::ab[Tribal Weapon Training (Ex)]{l=5 icon=power-boost ability="When a tribal fighter gains the *weapon training* ability, he must choose the tribal ‹ability/weapon group<s› and doesn't later gain additional weapon groups, though the *weapon training* bonus for tribal weapons still improves at 9th level and every 4 levels thereafter. Additionally, if the tribal fighter has combat feats that apply to a specific weapon type (such as ‹feat/Improved Critical› or ‹feat/Weapon Focus›) and he has selected a weapon that belongs to the tribal weapon group, he can apply the benefits of that feat to all weapons that belong to the tribal weapon group that would legally apply (for instance, a feat that applies only to throwing weapons wouldn't apply to ‹eq-weapon/greatclub«s›). This benefit applies only to feats selected as fighter bonus feats." alter="Weapon training"}

name: Two-Handed Fighter
description: ## Two-Handed Fighter ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/108› Some fighters focus their efforts on finding the biggest, heaviest, most imposing weapon they can find and training to manage and harness the weight of their massive weapons for maximum impact. These fighting school benefits only apply when using two-handed weapons. ::ab[Shattering Strike (Ex)]{l=2 icon=boost passive="A two-handed fighter gains a +1 bonus to CMB and CMD on ‹rule/sunder› attempts and on damage rolls made against objects." increment="p!These bonuses~2~4" replace=Bravery} ::ab[Overhand Chop (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost passive="When a two-handed fighter makes a single attack (with the attack action or a ‹rule/charge›) with a two-handed weapon, he adds double his Strength bonus on damage rolls." replace="Armor training 1"} ::ab[Weapon Training (Ex)]{l=5 icon=down ability="As the fighter class feature, but the bonuses only apply when wielding two-handed melee weapons."} ::ab[Backswing (Ex)]{l=7 icon=melee passive="When a two-handed fighter makes a ‹rule/full attack› with a two-handed weapon, he adds double his Strength bonus on damage rolls for all attacks after the first." replace="Armor training 2"} ::ab[Piledriver (Ex)]{l=11 icon=melee standard="A two-handed fighter can make a single melee attack with a two-handed weapon. If the attack hits, he may make a ‹rule/bull rush› or ‹rule/trip› combat maneuver against the target of his attack as a @HLfree_action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity." replace="Armor training 3"} ::ab[Greater Power Attack (Ex)]{l=15 icon=boost passive="When using ‹feat/Power Attack› with a two-handed melee weapon, the bonus damage from Power Attack is doubled (+100%) instead of increased by half (+50%)." replace="Armor training 4"} ::ab[Devastating Blow (Ex)]{l=19 icon=melee standard="A two-handed fighter may make a single melee attack with a two-handed weapon at a -5 penalty. If the attack hits, it is treated as a critical threat." special="Special weapon abilities that activate only on a critical hit do not activate if this critical hit is confirmed." replace="Armor mastery"}

name: Two-Weapon Warrior
description: ## Two-Weapon Warrior ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/109› Trained under great masters who preached the simple truth that two are better than one when it comes to weapons, the two-weapon warrior is a terror when his hands are full. From paired daggers to exotic double weapons, all combinations come equally alive in his skilled hands. ::ab[Defensive Flurry (Ex)]{l=3 icon=def passive="When a two-weapon warrior makes a ‹rule/full attack› with both weapons, he gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC against melee attacks until the beginning of his next turn." increment="This bonus~3~4" replace="Armor training 1 and 2"} ::ab[Twin Blades (Ex)]{l=5 icon=boost passive="A two-weapon warrior gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls when making a full attack with two weapons or a double weapon." increment="This bonus~5~4" replace="Weapon training 1"} ::ab[Doublestrike (Ex)]{l=9 icon=melee standard="A two-weapon warrior may make one attack with both his primary and secondary weapons. The penalties for ‹rule/attacking with »two weapon«s<_fighting› apply normally." replace="Weapon training 2"} ::ab[Improved Balance (Ex)]{l=11 icon=boost passive="The attack penalties for fighting with two weapons are reduced by -1 for a two-weapon warrior. Alternatively, he may use a one-handed weapon in his off-hand, treating it as if it were a light weapon with the normal light weapon penalties." replace="Armor training 3"} ::ab[Equal Opportunity (Ex)]{l=13 icon=power ability="When a two-weapon warrior makes an attack of opportunity, he may attack once with both his primary and secondary weapons. The penalties for attacking with two weapons apply normally." replace="Weapon training 3"} ::ab[Perfect Balance (Ex)]{l=15 icon=boost passive="The penalties for fighting with two weapons are reduced by an additional -1 for a two-weapon warrior. This benefit stacks with *improved balance.* If he is using a one-handed weapon in his off hand, treating it as a light weapon, he uses the normal light weapon penalties." replace="Armor training 4"} ::ab[Deft Doublestrike (Ex)]{l=17 icon=melee immediate="When a two-weapon warrior hits an opponent with both weapons, he can make a ‹rule/disarm› or ‹rule/sunder› attempt (or ‹rule/trip›, if one or both weapons can be used to trip) against that opponent, and it does not provoke attacks of opportunity." replace="Weapon training 4"} ::ab[Deadly Defense (Ex)]{l=19 icon=power passive="When a two-weapon warrior makes a full attack with both weapons, every creature that hits him with a melee attack before the beginning of his next turn provokes an attack of opportunity from the warrior." replace="Armor mastery"}

name: Unarmed Fighter
description: ## Unarmed Fighter ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/48› Not all fighters need weapons to make their mark on the world. The unarmed fighter picks up a weapon only rarely, and when he does, he prefers the weapons of the monk. There are even those who mistake them for monks, but these fighters enter the fight without ki, and instead have a tough perseverance that few can rival. ::ab[Weapon and Armor Proficiency]{icon=down-power info="An unarmed fighter is not proficient with medium armor, heavy armor, or shields. An unarmed fighter is proficient with all ‹class/monk› weapons, including exotic monk weapons."} ::ab[Unarmed Style]{l=1 icon=power ability="An unarmed fighter gains the ‹feat/Improved Unarmed Strike› feat and any single ‹main/style feat› as a bonus feat. The unarmed fighter need not meet all the prerequisites of the style feat he chooses, but style feats that grant additional uses of the ‹feat/Elemental Fist› feat cannot be taken until the unarmed fighter has that feat." replace="The bonus feat at 1st level"} ::ab[Harsh Training (Ex)]{l=2 icon=def passive="An unarmed fighter gains a +1 bonus on saving throws against effects that cause the exhausted, fatigued, or staggered conditions or temporary penalties to ability scores." increment="This bonus~2~4" replace=Bravery} ::ab[Tough Guy (Ex)]{l=3 icon=def passive="An unarmed fighter gains DR/- equal to ‹misc/half› his fighter level against nonlethal damage or damage taken while he is ‹rule/grappled›." replace="Armor training 1"} ::ab[Weapon Training (Ex)]{l=5 icon=boost passive="An unarmed fighter gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with weapons in the monk and natural ‹ability/weapon groups›." increment="This bonus~5~4" replace="Weapon training 1, 2, 3, and 4"} ::ab[Clever Wrestler (Ex)]{l=7 icon=def-power passive="An unarmed fighter takes no penalties to Dexterity or on attack rolls while grappled, and retains his Dexterity bonus to AC while pinning an opponent." order=pa ability="The unarmed fighter can make attacks of opportunity even when grappled and even against creatures attempting to ‹rule/grapple› him if the opponent has the ‹feat/Improved Grapple› feat or the ‹umr/grab› ability." replace="Armor training 2"} ::ab[Trick Throw (Ex)]{l=8 icon=melee immediate="When an unarmed fighter successfully ‹rule/trip«s› an opponent with an unarmed attack, he can attempt a ‹rule/dirty trick› combat maneuver against that creature (before the opponent becomes prone)." provokes=No replace="The 8th-level bonus feat"} ::ab[Takedown (Ex)]{l=12 icon=melee swift="If an unarmed fighter succeeds on a ‹rule/drag› maneuver, he can attempt a trip maneuver against the same target." provokes=No imp15="He may do so after a successful grapple check." replace="The 12th-level bonus feat"} ::ab[Eye Gouge (Ex)]{l=13 icon=melee swift="If an unarmed fighter confirms a critical hit with his unarmed strike or begins his turn grappled, he may attempt a dirty trick maneuver to ‹misc/blind› his target." provokes=No special="A target more than one size category larger is unaffected." replace="Weapon training 3"} ::ab[Sucker Punch (Ex)]{l=17 icon=melee swift="When an unarmed fighter strikes a creature that is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC, or that he has successfully pinned with a grapple check, he can attempt a dirty trick or trip combat maneuver against that target." replace="Armor training 4"} ::ab[Sheer Toughness (Ex)]{l=19 icon=def passive="An unarmed fighter becomes immune to nonlethal damage and the exhausted, fatigued, and staggered conditions." replace="Armor mastery"} ::ab[Weapon Mastery (Ex)]{l=20 icon=info info="*Weapon mastery* applies to unarmed strikes only." alter="Weapon mastery"}

name: Unbreakable
description: ## Unbreakable ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/49› The unbreakable is a warrior of indomitable will, unstoppable and implacable once he has set his mind upon a course of action. The unbreakable endures any trial to do what must be done, and when his mind is set toward a goal, nothing can stop him from achieving it, though many may try. He is a juggernaut and a zealot, supremely confident in his own abilities. ::ab[Weapon and Armor Proficiency]{icon=down info="An unbreakable is not proficient with tower shields."} ::ab[Tough as Nails]{icon=power ability="An unbreakable gains ‹feat/Endurance› and ‹feat/Diehard› as bonus feats." replace="The fighter's 1st-level bonus feat"} ::ab[Unflinching (Ex)]{l=2 icon=def passive="An unbreakable gains a +1 bonus on Will saves against mind-affecting effects." increment="This bonus~2~4" replace=Bravery} ::ab[Heroic Recovery (Ex)]{l=5 icon=power ability="An unbreakable gains the ‹feat/Heroic Recovery› feat as a bonus feat, if he does not have it already. If he already has this feat, the unbreakable can choose any ‹main/combat feat› instead." incrementUse=He~5~4 incrementDesc="may use this feat" replace="Weapon training 1"} ::ab[Heroic Defiance (Ex)]{l=9 icon=power ability="An unbreakable gains the ‹feat/Heroic Defiance› feat as a bonus feat, if he does not have it already. If he already has this feat, the unbreakable can choose any combat feat instead." incrementUse=He~9~4 incrementDesc="may use this feat" replace="Weapon training 2"} ::ab[Quick Recovery (Ex)]{l=11 icon=boost passive="An unbreakable needs only 15 minutes of rest or to be subject to a healing spell or effect to recover from the ‹misc/fatigued› condition." replace="Armor training 3"} ::ab[Stalwart (Ex)]{l=13 icon=def passive="When an unbreakable succeeds on a Fortitude or Will save against a spell or spell-like ability that has a partial effect even on a successful save, he is completely unaffected by it." replace="Weapon training 3"} ::ab[Unlimited Endurance (Ex)]{l=15 icon=boost passive="When an unbreakable is ‹misc/exhausted›, he only suffers the effects of the fatigued condition instead, but does require 1 hour of rest to reduce this condition to the actual fatigued condition." replace="Armor training 4"} ::ab[Miraculous Recovery (Ex)]{l=17 icon=def-roll passive="When an unbreakable makes a saving throw to recover from an ongoing effect, he may roll twice and choose the better roll." replace="Weapon training 4"} ::ab[Unbreakable Mind (Ex)]{l=20 icon=def passive="An unbreakable becomes nearly impossible to sway with honeyed words or magic. He gains immunity to mind-affecting effects." replace="Weapon mastery"}

name: Viking
sourceBook: Ultimate Wilderness, People of the North
description: ## Viking ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/51;People of the North/24› Vikings seek to raid "softer societies" and return with their longships filled with plunder. A viking strikes fear into the heart of her foes, and in battle she can fly into a terrible rage. Many vikings wear the pelts of bears or wolves, drawing on the strength and ferocity of these beasts in battle. Vikings do not wear heavy armor, but they are skilled at fighting with an axe or spear in conjunction with a shield. ::ab[Weapon and Armor Proficiency]{icon=down info="A viking is not proficient with heavy armor or tower shields." alter="Weapon and armor proficiencies"} ::ab[Fearsome (Ex)]{icon=power l2="A viking can attempt an Intimidate check to demoralize an opponent as a @HLmove_action." l10="She can do so as a @HLswift_action." imp18="She can attempt to demoralize a foe as a @HLfree_action once per round." replace=Bravery} ::ab[Shield Defense (Ex)]{l=3 icon=def flavor="A viking learns the art of fighting with a shield." passive="Whenever she is wearing medium, light, or no armor and using a shield, the viking's shield bonus to AC increases by 1." incrementPlain incrementAt="The shield bonus to AC now increases~7~11~15~2" incrementDesc=by replace="Armor training"} ::ab[Berserker (Ex)]{l=5 icon=power ability="A viking gains the *rage* ability as per the ‹class/barbarian› class feature, and she uses her fighter level as her barbarian level for the purposes of determining her rounds of rage, qualifying for rage powers, and determining the effects of rage powers." replace="Weapon training"} ::ab[Rage Powers (Ex)]{l=6 icon=power choice="Whenever a viking gains a fighter bonus feat, she can instead gain a single ‹ability/rage power<s›, as the barbarian class feature, in place of the bonus feat. Once selected, these rage powers cannot be changed." alter="The fighter's bonus feats"}

name: Weapon Master
description: ## Weapon Master ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/109› Devoted to the perfection of a single weapon, the weapon master's meditations upon his favored weapon border on the obsessive, but none can deny his consummate skill. ::ab[Chosen Weapon]{icon=info choice="The weapon master must select a single type of weapon (such as longsword or shortbow). All of his abilities apply to that weapon type."} ::ab[Weapon Guard (Ex)]{l=2 icon=def passive="A weapon master gains a +1 bonus to CMD against ‹rule/disarm› and ‹rule/sunder› attempts while wielding his chosen weapon. This bonus also applies on saves against any effect that targets his chosen weapon (for example, ‹spell/grease›, ‹spell/heat metal›, ‹spell/shatter›, ‹spell/warp wood›)." increment="The bonus~2~4" replace=Bravery} ::ab[Weapon Training (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost passive="A weapon master gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with his chosen weapon." increment="The bonus~3~4" replace="Armor training 1, 2, 3, and 4"} ::ab[Reliable Strike (Ex)]{l=5 icon=roll immediate="A weapon master may reroll an attack roll, critical hit confirmation roll, miss chance check, or damage roll. He must accept the second roll even if it is worse." useInc=fighter~5 useF="5~1" replace="Weapon training 1"} ::ab[Mirror Move (Ex)]{l=9 icon=def passive="A weapon master gains his weapon training bonus as an insight bonus to AC when attacked by his chosen weapon." replace="Weapon training 2"} ::ab[Deadly Critical (Ex)]{l=13 icon=boost immediate="When a weapon master confirms a critical hit with his chosen weapon, he can increase the weapon's damage multiplier by +1." useInc=fighter~3~13 useF="13~1~3" replace="Weapon training 3"} ::ab[Critical Specialist (Ex)]{l=17 icon=boost passive="The save DCs of any effects caused by a critical hit with a weapon master's chosen weapon increase by +4." replace="Weapon training 4"} ::ab[Unstoppable Strike (Ex)]{l=19 icon=lower standard="A weapon master can make one attack with his chosen weapon as a touch attack that ignores damage reduction (or hardness, if attacking an object)." replace="Armor mastery"}

name: Commando

features.name: Track (Ex)
features.replaces: The bonus feat gained at 4th level

description: ## Commando ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/91› Commandos are those rough and ready gunslingers who excel at hit-and-run tactics and leveraging their expertise in the wild against their enemies. ::cskill{gain=kg~kna~stl lose=ke~kl~soh} ::ab[Deeds]{head icon=power ability="A commando gains the following deeds; each of these deeds replaces an existing deed."} ::ab[Trap Shot (Ex)]{next l=3 icon=ranged ability="The commando can spend 1 point of grit and target a 5-foot square with her firearm. If she succeeds at an attack against an AC of 10, she triggers a single trap within that 5-foot square, even if she is unaware of the trap. If a creature is occupying the same square as the triggered trap, the trap affects the creature as if it had triggered the trap." special="If there are multiple traps within the same 5-foot square, the commando must declare which trap she is triggering; otherwise it is determined randomly." replace="‹deed/Utility shot› deed"} ::ab[Sniping Shot (Ex)]{next l=11 icon=boost swift="The commando can spend 1 point of grit to negate the -20 penalty on Stealth checks when sniping until the start of her next turn." replace="‹deed/Expert loading› deed"} ::ab[Camouflage (Ex)]{next l=11 icon=power ability="As long as the commando has 1 point of grit, she gains the *camouflage* ‹class/ranger› class feature: She can use the Stealth skill to hide in any of her favored terrains, even if the terrain doesn't grant ‹rule/cover› or ‹rule/concealment›." replace="‹deed/Lightning reload› deed"} ::ab[Hide in Plain Sight (Ex)]{next l=15 icon=power ability="As long as the commando has 1 point of grit, she gains the *hide in plain sight* ranger class feature: While in any of her favored terrains, she can use the Stealth skill even while being observed." replace="‹deed/Slinger's luck› deed"} ::ab[Favored Terrain (Ex)]{l=2 icon=power ability="A commando gains the ‹ability/favored terrain› ranger class feature." imp6="The commando can select a second favored terrain." imp10="She can pick a third favored terrain." imp14="A commando can pick a fourth favored terrain." imp18="The commando can select a fifth favored terrain." replace=Nimble} ::ab[Track (Ex)]{l=4 icon=boost passive="A commando adds half her level on Survival checks to follow tracks." replace="The bonus feat gained at 4th level"} ::ab[Trapsmith]{l=5 icon=power ability="A commando can learn how to create one ‹ability/ranger trap<s› in place of gaining the next level of gun training. A commando can use a known trap a number of times per day equal to her Wisdom bonus (minimum 1). The DC for a commando's trap is equal to 10 + half her commando level + her Wisdom bonus, and it lasts 1 day per 2 levels she has." special="A commando can set only extraordinary ranger traps with this ability; as with extraordinary ranger traps, the trap DC for these traps has a -2 penalty." alter="Gun training"}

name: Gun Tank
description: ## Gun Tank ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/50› Gunslingers usually don't use heavy armor, but there are a few who use and modify their armor to protect themselves from both traditional weapons and gunfire. These gun tanks trundle into battle with barrels blazing, dealing out punishment with their firearms while knowing few can penetrate their hard protective shells. ::ab[Armor Proficiency]{icon=power ability="A gun tank is proficient with all armors and shields, including tower shields."} ::ab[Deeds]{head icon=info info="A gun tank swaps a pair of deeds for the following."} ::ab[Gun Tank's Resolve (Ex)]{next l=1 icon=def flavor="The gun tank can shrug off the most serious of attacks." immediate="When the gun tank is wearing medium or heavy armor and is subject to a critical hit or ‹ability/sneak attack›, she can spend 1 grit point to attempt to negate the critical hit or sneak attack damage. She has a 25% chance of doing so." imp10="The negation chance becomes 50%." imp15="The chance increases to 75%." special="While a gun tank's resolve does not stack with the ‹magic-enh/light_>fortification› armor special ability, it does work in concert with that armor special ability or similar effects, so a gun tank can use this ability even after the armor of fortification has failed to negate the critical hit or sneak attack damage." replace="‹deed/Gunslinger's dodge› deed"} ::ab[Gun Tank's Resilience (Ex)]{next l=15 icon=def passive="When the gun tank has at least 1 grit point and makes a successful Fortitude saving throw against an attack that would deal half damage or have a partial effect, she takes no damage or other effects from that attack. Furthermore, she gains a +2 bonus on all saving throws against fear and mind-affecting effects." replace="‹deed/Evasive› deed"} ::ab[Bullet Defection (Ex)]{icon=def flavor="A gun tank is adept at modifying and using her armor to stop firearm attacks." l=2 passive="A gun tank wearing medium or heavy armor gains half the armor's bonus plus the armor's enhancement bonus (if any) as a deflection bonus against any non-siege firearm or splash weapon attack (including the ‹class/alchemist«'s› bomb class ability).
