This ability has no affect on spells, spell-like abilities, or supernatural abilities that make a touch attack." replace=Nimble} ::ab[Armor Training (Ex)]{l=4 icon=boost-def flavor="A gun tank learns to be more maneuverable while wearing armor." passive="Whenever she is wearing armor, the armor check penalty is reduced by ‹misc/one-fourth› of her gunslinger level (to a minimum of 0) and the maximum Dexterity bonus allowed by her armor increases by one-fourth of her gunslinger level." special="This ability stacks with the ‹class/fighter› class ability of the same name. If the gun tank has both class features, she takes the most advantageous benefit of the two class features." replace="All bonus combat/grit feats"}

name: Maverick
description: ## Maverick ‹SOURCE Ultimate Intrigue/64› Trouble always finds a maverick, whether she is a con artist or an honest gambler. Quick with her gun and no stranger to barroom brawls, she can hold her own when bullets and punches start flying. ::ab[Deeds]{head icon=power info="A maverick gains the following three deeds."} ::ab[Stacked Deck (Ex)]{next l=1 icon=boost ability="The maverick can spend 1 grit point when she attempts a Bluff, Profession (gambler), or Sleight of Hand check to roll 1d6 and add the result to the check. She can do this after she rolls the check but before the result is revealed. If the result of the d6 roll is a natural 6, she rolls another 1d6 and adds it to the check. She can continue to do this as long as she rolls natural 6s, up to a number of times equal to her Wisdom modifier (minimum 1)." replace="‹deed/Gunslinger's dodge› deed"} ::ab[Fist Fighter (Ex)]{next l=3 icon=power ability="As long as the maverick has at least 1 grit point, she gains the benefit of the ‹feat/Improved Unarmed Strike› feat." replace="‹deed/Pistol whip› deed"} ::ab[Gun Twirl (Ex)]{next l=3 icon=power ability="As long as the maverick has at least 1 grit point, she can use flashy gunplay to intimidate her opponents. She gains the ‹feat/Dazzling Display› feat and can use it with any firearm, even if she doesn't have ‹feat/Weapon Focus› in that firearm." replace="‹deed/Gunslinger initiative› deed"}

name: Musket Master
description: ## Musket Master ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/50› Pistols and other one-handed firearms are often easy to conceal and faster to load than other firearms, and do sufficient damage for most situations. But some gunslingers want a little more firepower and range. These are the musket masters; the best of these gunslingers can reload a musket with dazzling speed, potentially putting even their pistol-wielding brethren to shame. ::ab[Weapon Proficiency]{icon=down info="Instead of proficiency with all firearms, a musket master only gains proficiency with two-handed firearms. She must take the ‹feat/Exotic Weapon Proficiency› (firearm) feat to gain proficiency with one-handed firearms and firearm siege engines."} ::ab[Gunsmith]{icon=info info="A musket master must take a ‹eq-weapon/musket› when she chooses a battered firearm at 1st level." alter=Gunsmith} ::ab[Deeds]{head icon=info info="A musket master swaps a pair of deeds for the following."} ::ab[Steady Aim (Ex)]{next l=1 icon=boost move="As long as a musket master has at least 1 grit point, she can increase the accuracy of a two-handed firearm. When she does, she increases the range increment of the firearm she is firing by 10 feet. This stacks with other abilities that increase her range increment." replace="‹deed/Gunslinger's dodge› deed"} ::ab[Fast Musket (Ex)]{next l=3 icon=power ability="As long as the musket master has 1 grit point, she can reload any two-handed firearm as if it were a one-handed firearm." replace="‹deed/Utility shot› deed"} ::ab[Rapid Reloader]{l=1 icon=power ability="A musket master gains ‹feat/Rapid Reload› (muskets) as a bonus feat."} ::ab[Musket Training (Ex)]{l=5 icon=boost-def ability="A musket master increases her skill with two-handed firearms. She gains a bonus on damage rolls equal to her Dexterity modifier, and when she misfires with a two-handed firearm, the misfire value increases by 2 instead of 4." increment="The damage bonus~5~4~1" replace="Firearm training 1, 2, 3, and 4"}

name: Mysterious Stranger
description: ## Mysterious Stranger ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/51› Gunslingers use a potent mixture of common sense and manual dexterity in order to control the fickle power of their weapons. But a few rare gunslingers seem to accomplish their chosen tasks purely through willpower and an unwillingness to ever give up. These mysterious strangers use their force of personality to keep going when the chips are down, often moving on from a region as soon as they accomplish their goals - hence the name. ::ab[Grit (Ex)]{icon=info info="A mysterious stranger is a force to be reckoned with. Instead of using her Wisdom to determine the number of grit points she gains at the start of each day, she uses Charisma. This ability works in all other ways like the gunslinger's *grit* class feature." alter=Grit} ::ab[Deeds]{head icon=info info="A mysterious stranger swaps a pair of deeds for the following."} ::ab[Focused Aim (Ex)]{next l=1 icon=boost swift="The mysterious stranger can spend 1 grit point to gain a bonus on all firearm damage rolls equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 1) with all firearm attacks she makes until the end of her turn." imp7="When she uses the ‹deed/dead shot› deed, she multiplies this bonus by the number of hits she made while rolling the *Dead Shot* attack." replace="‹deed/Quick clear› deed"} ::ab[Clipping Shot (Ex)]{next l=11 icon=ranged ability="When the mysterious stranger misses with a firearm attack, she can spend 1 grit point to deal half the damage that attack would have dealt if it were a hit (roll damage normally). She can decide to use this deed and spend the grit point after making the attack. This deed has no effect if the attack used the *dead shot* deed." special="The cost of using this deed cannot be reduced with the ‹feat/Signature Deed› feat, the true grit class feature, or any similar effect." replace="‹deed/Bleeding wound› deed"} ::ab[Lucky (Ex)]{l=2 icon=def passive="A mysterious stranger gains a +1 luck bonus on Will saving throws." increment="This bonus~2~4" replace=Nimble} ::ab[Stranger's Fortune (Ex)]{l=5 icon=def free="A mysterious stranger can ignore a firearm misfire." useMod=Cha replace="Gun training 1"}

name: Pistolero
description: ## Pistolero **Source** ‹source/Ultimate Combat« pg. 51› While most gunslingers have favorite firearms, there are those rare ones who choose to specialize in one-handed firearms exclusively. These gunslingers are called pistoleros. While they lack the flexibility of being able to pick up any kind of firearm and use it with reasonable proficiency, they are crackerjack shots with pistols and similar firearms. Their skill and aim with these firearms at close range is second to none, and they rarely misfire with these weapons. ::ab[Weapon Proficiency]{icon=down info="Instead of proficiency with all firearms, a pistolero only gains proficiency with one-handed firearms. She must take ‹feat/Exotic Weapon Proficiency› (firearm) to gain proficiency with two-handed firearms and firearm siege engines."} ::ab[Gunsmith]{icon=info info="A pistolero must take a ‹eq-weapon/pistol› when she chooses a battered firearm at 1st level." alter=Gunsmith} ::ab[Deeds]{head icon=info info="A pistolero swaps a trio of deeds for the following."} ::ab[Up Close and Deadly (Ex)]{next l=1 icon=boost ability="When the pistolero hits a target with a one-handed firearm that is not making a scatter shot, she can spend 1 grit point to deal extra damage on a hit. This extra damage is a number of d6s equal to 1 + ‹misc/one-fifth› of her gunslinger level. If she misses with the attack, she grazes the target, dealing half the extra damage anyway. This is ‹misc/precision damage› and is not multiplied if the attack is a critical hit. This precision damage stacks with ‹ability/sneak attack› and other forms of precision damage." special="The cost of using this deed cannot be reduced with the ‹feat/Signature Deed› feat, the true grit class feature, or any similar effect." replace="*Deadeye* deed"} ::ab[Deadeye (Ex)]{next l=7 icon=power ability="The pistolero gains the ‹deed/deadeye› deed, which is normally a 1st-level gunslinger deed." replace="‹deed/Startling shot› deed"} ::ab[Twin Shot Knockdown (Ex)]{next l=11 icon=boost ability="When the pistolero hits a single target with two or more one-handed firearm attacks during her turn, she can spend 1 grit point to knock the target ‹rule/prone›. She can choose to spend the grit point after the attacks are made." replace="‹deed/Bleeding wound› deed"} ::ab[Pistol Training (Ex)]{l=5 icon=boost passive="A pistolero increases her skill with one-handed firearms. She gains a bonus on damage rolls equal to her Dexterity modifier, and when she misfires with a one-handed firearm, the misfire value increases by 2 instead of 4." increment="The bonus on damage rolls~5~4" replace="Gun training 1-4"}

name: Cloaked Wolf
description: ## Cloaked Wolf ‹SOURCE Ultimate Intrigue/28› Some inquisitors are adept at appearing harmless until they throw off their unassuming facades and take their enemies by surprise. ::cskill{gain=soh lose=intm} ::ab[Lure Prey (Ex)]{l=1 icon=boost flavor="Cloaked wolves are skilled at maintaining a harmless guise even while they silently prepare to strike against their enemies." passive="A cloaked wolf receives a morale bonus on all Disguise and Sleight of Hand checks equal to ‹misc/half› her inquisitor level (minimum +1). When a cloaked wolf uses Sleight of Hand to draw a hidden weapon, this bonus doubles." replace="Stern gaze"} ::ab[Always Wary (Ex)]{flavor="A cloaked wolf is always ready for betrayal and subterfuge." l1="Whenever she attempts a Sense Motive check to avoid being surprised by a foe using Bluff to conceal the attack, the cloaked wolf can always act during the surprise round, regardless of the result of the check." l2="She adds her Wisdom modifier (in addition to her Dexterity modifier) to her initiative checks during any such encounter." alter="Cunning initiative" icon=power-boost replace="Monster lore"} :::ab{l=3 icon=power action="At 6th Level" ability="A cloaked wolf can transition between parley and combat in the blink of an eye. She gains ‹feat/Quick Draw› as a bonus feat." order=aC title="Unleashed Fury (Ex)" replace="Solo tactics~teamwork feats" incrementOrd=The~6~3 incrementDesc="inquisitor gains a~cloaked wolf chooses a" incrementEnd=" bonus feat from the list above." special="She must meet the prerequisites of any bonus feat she selects."} She gains a bonus feat from the following list: ‹feat/Alertness›, ‹feat/Catch Off-Guard›, ‹feat/Deceitful›, ‹feat/Deft Hands›, ‹feat/Dodge›, ‹feat/Improved Initiative›, ‹feat/Improved Unarmed Strike›, ‹feat/Improvised Weapon Mastery›, ‹feat/Lookout›, ‹feat/Mobility›, ‹feat/Spring Attack›, ‹feat/Stunning Fist›, and ‹feat/Throw Anything›. As a @HLstandard_action, a cloaked wolf can choose to learn a new bonus feat from the above list in place of the most recent bonus feat she has already learned. In effect, the cloaked wolf loses the bonus feat in exchange for the new one. She can only change the most recent bonus feat gained. Whenever she gains a new bonus feat, the previous bonus feat becomes set and cannot be changed again. A cloaked wolf can change her most recent bonus feat a number of times per day equal to her Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). :::

name: Exorcist
description: ## Exorcist ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/44› Some inquisitors, as they learn more about the threat of possession and the machinations of the planes, task themselves to expel possessing spirits and conniving outsiders from the world whenever possible. Eventually they learn the secret of the *verdicts of exorcism, exile,* and *anathema.* ::ab[Verdict of Exorcism (Su)]{l=8 icon=power ability="An inquisitor using *judgment* can unleash the *verdict of exorcism* on a creature. When she does, her judgment ends, but the creature is ‹misc/dazed› for 1 round (Will negates); if the creature is possessed, the possessing entity must succeed at a Will saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 inquisitor level + inquisitor's Wisdom bonus), or be exorcised and never again allowed in that same body." replace="Second judgment"} ::ab[Verdict of Exile (Su)]{l=16 icon=power ability="An inquisitor using *judgment* can unleash the *verdict of exile* on a creature. When she does, her judgment ends, but the creature subject to that judgment is dazed for 1 round (Will negates, DC of 10 + 1/2 inquisitor level + Wisdom bonus). If the creature is possessed or an outsider, the possessing entity or the outsider is affected by ‹spell/dismissal› (Will negates)." replace="Third judgment"} ::ab[Closed Mind (Su)]{icon=def l=17 flavor="An exorcist inquisitor must close off her mind to deny her enemies even a foothold." passive="The inquisitor becomes immune to compulsion effects and possession attempts (including ‹spell/magic jar›)." replace=Slayer} ::ab[Verdict of Anathema (Su)]{l=20 icon=boost ability="An inquisitor using *judgment* can unleash the *verdict of anathema* on her enemies. When she does, her judgment ends, and all enemy creatures within 10 feet are affected by her *verdict of exorcism.*" replace="True judgment"}

name: Faith Hunter
description: ## Faith Hunter ‹SOURCE Ultimate Intrigue/28› Certain relentless inquisitors burn with special hatred for an enemy of specific convictions, and they stop at nothing when obsessively hunting these foes down. ::ab[Sworn Enemy (Sp, Su)]{icon=power-boost choice="A faith hunter chooses a single alignment (such as chaotic evil, rather than simply chaotic or evil) that directly opposes her own along either the law/chaos axis or the good/evil axis (so a lawful good faith hunter can choose chaotic good, chaotic neutral, chaotic evil, neutral evil, or lawful evil, whereas a neutral good faith hunter can only choose chaotic evil, neutral evil, or lawful evil). Creatures of this alignment are her **sworn enemies.**" ability="She can detect creatures of the chosen alignment at will, functioning as ‹spell/detect evil›, except this ability works only on creatures and detects the specific alignment." order=ca replace="Domain~justice and destruction judgments" alter=Judgment imp6="Once per day as a @HLswift_action, a faith hunter can smite one foe she can see. If the foe is of the faith hunter's *sworn enemy* alignment, the faith hunter gains a +4 sacred bonus on attack rolls against that foe and a sacred bonus equal to half her inquisitor level on damage rolls made against the foe. Smites against targets of the faith hunter's *sworn enemy* alignment automatically bypass any DR the creature might possess. If the faith hunter targets a creature that is not of her *sworn enemy* alignment, the smite is wasted with no effect." special="The smite effect remains until the foe is dead or the next time the faith hunter rests and regains her uses of this ability. At 10th level and every 4 inquisitor levels thereafter, a faith hunter can smite her enemies one additional time per day, to a maximum of four times per day at 18th level. A faith hunter does not gain the justice or destruction judgments." incrementPlain="A faith hunter can now~6~4~2" incrementDesc=smite incrementEnd=" times a day." } ::ab[Enemy Revealed (Su)]{l=2 icon=lower ability="When a faith hunter uses her *sworn enemy* ability to identify a creature's alignment (typically on the third round of concentrating on an area including the creature), she can reveal that creature's alignment aura, causing it to glow for 1 round per inquisitor level so that even creatures with regular vision can see the aura. This not only allows others to recognize the creature's alignment, potentially exposing its true nature, it also allows them to track its location easily by the glow. Even if such a creature is invisible, the telltale glow pinpoints the creature's square or squares." useMod=Wisdom useM special="This doesn't take any extra action on her part; this ability is part of the same action as concentrating on her *sworn enemy* detect ability." replace="Detect alignment"} ::ab[Hateful Bane (Su)]{l=5 icon=down passive="A faith hunter's *bane* ability functions only against creatures that are both the selected creature type and her *sworn enemy* alignment." alter=Bane}

name: Green Faith Marshal
sourceBook: Ultimate Wilderness, Heroes of the Wild
description: ## Green Faith Marshal ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/141;Heroes of the Wild/24› The ‹faith/Green Faith› marshal serves as a literal force of nature, hunting down and punishing those who have committed sins against nature through enslavement and mistreatment of animals or destruction of wild places. ::ab[Power of Nature]{icon=power-learn ability="A Green Faith marshal gains one domain selected from the ‹ability/druid>animal and terrain» domains›. The 1st- through 6th-level bonus spells from this domain are added to the Green Faith marshal's spell list." alter=Domain replace="Stern gaze"} ::ab[Wild Lore (Ex)]{icon=boost passive="A Green Faith marshal adds her Wisdom modifier to her Knowledge (nature) skill checks, in addition to her Intelligence modifier." replace="Monster lore"} ::ab[Nature's Ally (Sp)]{l=5 icon=magic ability="A Green Faith marshal gains the ability to cast ‹spell/commune with nature› once per week." replace="Discern lies"} ::ab[Wild Step (Ex)]{l=11 icon=power passive="A Green Faith marshal can move through any sort of naturally occurring ‹rule/difficult terrain› (such as natural thorns, briars, overgrown areas, and similar terrain) at her normal speed without taking damage or suffering any other impairment. Terrain that is enchanted or magically manipulated to impede motion still affects her." replace=Stalwart}

name: Heretic
description: ## Heretic ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/45› While all inquisitors hunt the enemies of the faith, sometimes, either through political maneuvering by her enemies or an unyielding tenacity that breaks her faith's basic tenets, an inquisitor can find herself a heretic. Still unyielding in her cause, these heretics are accustomed to using guile and deception to hide themselves and their activities while they continue to hunt their enemies. ::ab[Judgment (Su)]{head icon=power ability="A heretic gains the following judgment in addition to the normal list of inquisitor judgments."} ::ab[Escape (Su)]{next icon=def ability="Each time the inquisitor using this judgment hits an opponent with a melee or ranged attack, she can use a @HLmove_action attempt to create a diversion to hide (see the ‹skill/Stealth› skill)."} ::ab[Lore of Escape (Ex)]{l=1 icon=boost flavor="The heretic uses every trick she knows to escape those now pursuing her." passive="She adds her Wisdom modifier on Bluff and Stealth skill checks in addition to the normal ability score modifiers." replace="Monster lore"} ::ab[Hide Tracks (Ex)]{l=1 icon=def flavor="A heretical inquisitor is adept at hiding her tracks." passive="Creatures attempting to track her take a -5 penalty on rolls to find or follow her tracks."} ### Ex-Inquisitors An inquisitor who becomes an ex-inquisitor can, with the GM's permission, take the heretic archetype, replacing her class abilities with the appropriate archetype abilities. If the character atones or joins a different faith, she loses her heretic abilities and regains her previous inquisitor class abilities.

name: Iconoclast
description: ## Iconoclast ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/52› Some magic items are heretical by nature, enabling the unfaithful to spread wickedness. Iconoclasts seek out and remove such crutches, cleansing the taint these items exude. ::ab[Shake Effects (Ex)]{l=1 icon=def passive="An iconoclast gains a +2 bonus on all saving throws against effects that come from a magic item." replace="Monster lore"} ::ab[Detect Magic (Sp)]{l=2 icon=magic ability="An iconoclast gains the ability to ‹spell/detect magic› at will." replace="Detect alignment"} ::ab[Dispelling Attack (Sp)]{l=5 icon=magic standard="Once per day, an iconoclast can make a melee or ranged attack against an opponent, and if she hits, she can affect that opponent as if she had cast ‹spell/dispel magic›, using the targeted dispel option. If she misses, this ability is wasted. Use her inquisitor level as the caster level of the dispel magic effect." replace="Discern lies"} ::ab[Negating Critical (Sp)]{l=14 icon=lower ability="When an iconoclast confirms a critical hit, the creature she hit must succeed at a Fortitude save at DC 10 + 1/2 the iconoclast's caster level + the iconoclast's Wisdom modifier for each non-artifact magic item the target is wearing or carrying. On a failed saving throw, the target of the critical hit can neither use nor gain benefit from any ‹misc/minor magic item› for 1d4 rounds. This ability can be used in conjunction with critical feats." replace="Exploit weakness"} ::ab[Destroy Artifact (Sp)]{l=20 icon=magic ability="An iconoclast has the ability to destroy minor ‹rule/artifacts›. The iconoclast must have possession of the minor artifact for at least a week, which she must spend in uninterrupted contemplation of the nature of the artifact. At the end of that week, she makes a DC 30 Spellcraft check to unweave the fabric of the item, and if she is successful, the artifact is destroyed. If the iconoclast fails, she cannot try to destroy the artifact again with this ability, but another iconoclast can." replace="True judgment"}

name: Infiltrator
description: ## Infiltrator ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/45› This inquisitor uses guile and deception to blend in among the enemies of the faith rather than confronting them head-on. ::ab[Misdirection (Sp)]{l=1 icon=magic ability="Each day when the infiltrator prepares spells, she may choose an alignment. She detects as that alignment as if she had used ‹spell/misdirection› on a creature with that alignment (this does not change any divination results about her other than her alignment)." alter="Stern gaze"} ::ab[Guileful Lore (Ex)]{l=1 icon=boost flavor="The infiltrator's will is bent toward subterfuge and deception." passive="She adds her Wisdom modifier on Bluff and Diplomacy skill checks in addition to the normal ability score modifiers." replace="Monster lore"} ::ab[Forbidden Lore (Ex)]{flavor="While other inquisitors learned to track unbelievers, an infiltrator learns how to cast their spells." icon=magic ability="An infiltrator can cast spells of an alignment opposed to her or her deity (ignoring the restriction in the Chaotic, Evil, Good, and Lawful Spells class ability)." replace=Track} ::ab[Necessary Lies (Su)]{icon=def passive="An infiltrator adds her class level on saving throws against abilities that detect lies or reveal or force the truth, such as ‹spell/discern lies› and ‹spell/zone of truth›." replace="Discern lies"}

name: Preacher
description: ## Preacher ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/46› Some inquisitors wander the land to spread the true word of their faith. Often they come into conflict with those hostile to their teachings or to the preacher's need to help those who cannot help themselves. The leaders of evil or aggressive religions send these preachers into new territories to win converts and hopefully allies. Often, they start uprisings against powers hostile to their religion, or defend a group of honest believers from the depredations of the unfaithful. ::ab[Determination (Ex)]{head l=3 icon=power flavor="The preacher is a person of few words on the battlefield, but those words hold great power and authority." ability="Once per day, the inquisitor can use this ability to create one of the effects below." replace="Solo tactics" alter="Teamwork feats" repeat="Instead of selecting a bonus teamwork feat, you may increase the number of uses per day of this ability by one.~6~3"} ::ab[Aggression]{next icon=roll free="The preacher may reroll an attack roll that she just made before the results of the roll are revealed. She must take the result of the reroll, even if it's worse than the original roll."} ::ab[Defense]{next icon=def immediate="When the inquisitor would be hit by a melee or ranged attack, she may add a +4 insight bonus to her Armor Class against that attack, and if this makes the inquisitor's AC higher than the opponent's attack roll, the attack misses."} ::ab[Warning]{next icon=protect-roll free="When a preacher's ally within line of sight would be hit by a melee or ranged attack, she may call out a warning to that ally, and the attacker must reroll the attack and use the results of the second roll. The ally must be able to hear the preacher and must not be ‹misc/helpless› for this ability to have any effect."}

name: Secret Seeker
description: ## Secret Seeker ‹SOURCE Ultimate Intrigue/29› Secret seekers are trained in the art of extracting answers from intransigent foes. Recognizing that torture is a poor method of securing truthful intelligence, secret seekers instead prefer magical means of inquiry. ::ab[Occult Lore (Su)]{icon=power ability="A secret seeker gains access to the ‹skill/prognostication› and ‹skill/read aura› occult skill unlocks, but not the other occult skill unlocks." special="If she ever chooses to gain the ‹feat/Psychic Sensitivity› feat or otherwise gains access to all occult skill unlocks, she receives ‹feat/Psychic Maestro› as a bonus feat, with prognostication and read aura as the two occult skill unlocks selected." replace="Monster lore"} ::ab[Detect Mind (Sp)]{l=5 icon=magic ability="A secret seeker can ‹spell/detect anxieties›, ‹spell/detect desires›, or ‹spell/detect thoughts›, as per the spells, for a number of rounds per day equal to twice her inquisitor level. These rounds need not be consecutive. A creature that succeeds at a saving throw against this ability is immune to that secret seeker's detect mind ability for 24 hours. If the secret seeker has the ‹inquisition/secrets› inquisition, she doubles the number of rounds per day that she can use this ability." imp12="A secret seeker can use her *detect mind* ability for a number of minutes per day equal to twice her inquisitor level, rather than rounds. These minutes need not be consecutive but must be spent in 1-minute increments. If the secret seeker has the *secrets* inquisition, she doubles the number of minutes per day she can use this ability." replace="Bane~greater bane"} ::ab[Seek Mind (Sp)]{l=14 icon=magic ability="A secret seeker can use her *detect mind* ability to seek out people with particular anxieties, desires, or thoughts. This functions as per ‹spell/seek thoughts› except that it works with any of the three types of mental output the secret seeker can detect with detect mind." replace="Exploit weakness"}

name: Sin Eater
description: ## Sin Eater ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/46› There is a sect of inquisitors in some religions that believes it is not enough to hunt the enemies of the church - one must also devour those enemies' sins. More benign versions of the practice believe that sin, or evil, is taken out of the world when a sin is devoured, denying the enemy's soul to the enemy's god and purifying the world of its taint. Followers of malevolent churches believe that consuming the sins of good folk not only corrupts the enemy soul to keep it from the celestial planes, but also taints the souls of those who witness the sin-eating or the corpse of its victim. Consuming sins empowers the sin eater, at least for a time. ::ab[Eat Sin (Sp)]{l=1 replace=Domain icon=power-aid order=frn free="When the sin eater inquisitor kills an enemy, she may eat the sins of that enemy by spending 1 minute adjacent to its corpse. This provokes attacks of opportunity." fullround="The inquisitor can rush this ritual, performing it as a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity, but she only gains half the normal benefit (see below)." info="Eating the enemy's sins heals the inquisitor of a number of hit points of damage equal to 1d8 + her inquisitor level (maximum +5). The enemy must have been killed by the sin eater within the last hour, and it must have had at least as many Hit Dice as half the inquisitor's level. The inquisitor can use this ability once for each enemy she kills. This ability has no effect on mindless creatures or those with Intelligence 2 or less." imp5="The healing increases to 2d8 plus her inquisitor level (maximum +10)." imp9="The healing increases to 3d8 + her inquisitor level (maximum +15)." imp13="It increases to 4d8 + her inquisitor level (maximum +20)." special="In some faiths, this &quot&eating&quot& is a purely symbolic act, while in others, the inquisitor must eat a small amount of food and water as part of the ritual. A few extreme faiths actually require the inquisitor to eat some of the body of the slain enemy." imp8="When a sin eater eats the sins of a creature that would rise as an undead (such as someone slain by a ‹monster/shadow›, ‹monster/spectre›, or ‹template/vampire›), the sin eater may choose to accept 1 temporary ‹rule/negative level› to absorb the taint in the corpse, preventing it from rising as an undead. This negative level can be removed with the appropriate magic, though it automatically expires after 24 hours, and never becomes a permanent negative level. At the GM's discretion, this ability may prevent a ‹template/ghost› from using its rejuvenation ability."} ::ab[Speak with Dead (Sp)]{l=6 icon=magic ability="When the inquisitor eats an enemy's sins, within 10 minutes of doing so, she can ask the remnants of the enemy's soul questions as if using ‹spell/speak with dead›, with a caster level equal to her inquisitor level. She does not need the enemy's corpse to use this ability (she can eat sin, move away from the corpse, then use *speak with dead*), though the soul gets a saving throw just as a corpse would." replace="Teamwork feat gained at 6th level"} ::ab[Burden of Sin (Sp)]{l=14 icon=protect fullround="A sin eater may transfer one harmful affliction, condition, or spell effect from another creature to herself (this includes curses, possessions, and permanent effects such as petrification, or any condition that ‹spell/break enchantment› can end or reverse). The effect to be transferred is chosen by the sin eater and affects her as if she were the original target, continuing its duration (if any) and preventing any further effect on the original bearer. For example, the inquisitor could transfer a lethal disease to herself, or petrify herself to restore a petrified comrade. The sin eater can use this ability as often as desired, even using it multiple times on the same creature." replace="Exploit weakness"}

name: Spellbreaker
description: ## Spellbreaker ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/52› The world is full of dangerous magic, and many recoil in the face of such power. The spellbreaker, by contrast, learns to recognize and resist certain types of magic, wading through waves of magic to reach her foes. ::ab[Strong-Willed (Ex)]{l=1 icon=def-roll flavor="A spellbreaker is able to stand strong against magical effects that seek to control, compel, or persuade her." passive="The spellbreaker rolls twice and takes the best result when making a Will saving throw against a mind-affecting effect." replace="Monster lore"} ::ab[Defense against Magic (Ex)]{l=3 icon=def passive="A spellbreaker picks a single ‹ability/arcane>wizard» school<s›. She gains a +1 bonus on saving throws against arcane spells of that school." incrementOrd="The spellbreaker picks~3~4" incrementDesc=a incrementEnd=" school and gains this bonus against arcane spells of that school." special="Each time the spellbreaker picks a new school, the bonuses for the schools she has already chosen increase by 1." replace="Teamwork feats"} ::ab[Foil Casting (Su)]{l=3 icon=lower passive="When an opponent tries to cast an arcane spell within a spellbreaker's threatened area, the DC for that caster to cast defensively increases by 2. This increase stacks with the effects of the ‹feat/Disruptive› feat." ability="Furthermore, the spellbreaker knows where to hit foes to foil casting from a distance. Each time she hits an arcane spellcaster or a creature that uses spell-like abilities with a ranged weapon attack, the DC of any ‹rule/concentration› checks the caster makes increases by 2 for 1 round." order=pa replace="Solo tactics"} ::ab[Impervious (Ex)]{l=20 icon=def passive="A spellbreaker becomes immune to the effects of a single school of arcane magic. That school of magic must be the first one she picked for *defense against magic* (see above). Neither harmful nor helpful arcane spells of that school have an effect on the spellbreaker. If a spell of that school is an area of effect spell, the spell goes off as normal, but the spellbreaker is untouched by its effects." swift="Once per day, the spellbreaker can grant this imperviousness to all allies in a 60-foot ‹misc/burst› for 1 minute." order=pw replace="True judgment"}

name: Tactical Leader
description: ## Tactical Leader ‹SOURCE Ultimate Intrigue/29› Rather than pursuing their holy missions alone, some inquisitors see the inherent value of working with like-minded allies to accomplish mutual goals. ::ab[Leader's Words (Ex)]{icon=boost flavor="Tactical leaders are skilled at speaking soothing words that keep the peace and bolster allies' resolve." passive="A tactical leader receives a morale bonus on all Diplomacy checks equal to half his inquisitor level (minimum +1)." replace="Stern gaze"} ::ab[Tactician (Ex)]{icon=power l3="A tactical leader gains a teamwork feat as a bonus feat. He must meet the prerequisites for this feat." l9="He gains another teamwork feat, as above." l18="He gains a third teamwork feat, as above." standard="The tactical leader can grant one of these feats to all allies within 30 feet who can see and hear him. Allies retain the use of this bonus feat for 3 rounds plus 1 round for every 2 inquisitor levels the tactical leader has. Allies do not need to meet the prerequisites of these bonus feats." order=su useInc=inquisitor~3 useF="3~1" special="If the tactical leader also has ‹class/cavalier› levels, these levels stack for determining the number of uses of this ability per day." replace="Solo tactics~teamwork feats" imp12="A tactical leader can use the *tactician* ability as a @HLswift_action." imp18="Whenever the tactical leader uses this ability, he grants any two teamwork feats that he knows. He can select from any of his teamwork feats, not just his bonus feats."} ::ab[Battle Acumen (Ex)]{l=14 icon=power immediate="A tactical leader can grant his *judgment* benefits to a single other ally within 30 feet who can see and hear the tactical leader. These benefits last until the beginning of the tactical leader's next turn. A tactical leader must have a *judgment* active to use this ability and the benefits granted are the same as those selected by his *judgment.*" useMod=Wis useM replace="Exploit weakness"}

name: Traceless Operative
description: ## Traceless Operative ‹SOURCE Ultimate Intrigue/30› Traceless operatives practice subterfuge and careful preparation in order to accomplish their divine mandates. ::ab[Conceal Evidence (Ex)]{icon=power ability="A traceless operative knows how to clean up and obscure the evidence of foul play. It takes her 1d3 &times& 10 minutes to conceal or alter evidence in a 10-foot-by-10-foot area. She uses Disguise to alter evidence or Stealth to conceal it, though bonuses and penalties based on her abilities or effects that disguise or hide her own body (such as from ‹spell/disguise self›, a ‹magic-wondrous/cloak of elvenkind›, or the size modifier on Stealth checks) do not apply." special="A creature attempting to investigate the scene using Perception must succeed at the original Perception DC or a DC equal to the traceless operative's check, whichever is higher, in order to discover the true evidence. A creature who fails against a traceless operative's Disguise check potentially also derives the false evidence planted by the traceless operative." replace="Monster lore~stern gaze"} ::ab[Trackless (Sp)]{l=2 icon=boost flavor="A traceless operative's deity helps obscure her path from others." passive="The DC to track the traceless operative (or a group including her) increases by ‹misc/half› her inquisitor level. This does not stack with similar abilities, such as a ‹arc-ranger/transporter«'s› *trailbreaker* ability." replace=Track} ::ab[Uncanny Dodge (Ex)]{l=5 icon=def ability="A traceless operative can react to danger before her senses would normally allow her to do so. She cannot be caught ‹rule/flat-footed›, nor does she lose her Dexterity bonus to AC if the attacker is invisible. She still loses her Dexterity bonus to AC if immobilized. A traceless operative with this ability can still lose her Dexterity bonus to AC if an opponent successfully uses the feint action against her. If the traceless operative already possesses ‹ability/uncanny dodge› from a different class, she automatically gains *improved uncanny dodge* instead." replace=Bane} ::ab[Improved Uncanny Dodge (Ex)]{l=12 icon=def passive="A traceless operative can no longer be ‹rule/flanked›. This defense denies ‹class/rogue«s› (or other classes with the ‹ability/sneak attack› ability) the ability to *sneak attack* the traceless operative by flanking her, unless the attacker has at least 4 more rogue levels (or levels in a class that grants the *sneak attack* class ability) than the traceless operative has inquisitor levels. If the traceless operative already has ‹ability/improved uncanny dodge› from another class, the levels from the classes that grant *improved uncanny dodge* stack when determining the minimum rogue level (or level in another class with the *sneak attack* ability) required to flank the character." replace="Greater bane"}

name: Umbral Stalker
description: ## Umbral Stalker ‹SOURCE Ultimate Intrigue/31› As a consummate lurker in the shadows, an umbral stalker observes the enemies of her faith and strikes before the unfortunate victims even know she is skulking nearby. ::cskill{gain=acro lose=diplo} ::ab[Dark Descent (Su)]{icon=info info="An umbral stalker gains the ‹domain/Darkness› domain with the Night subdomain, even if her deity normally doesn't offer it." alter=Domain} ::ab[Judgment]{head icon=power ability="Umbral stalkers are most effective when they get the drop on an opponent. An umbral stalker gains access to the following judgment."} ::ab[Stalking]{next icon=boost passive="The umbral stalker gains a +2 sacred bonus on attack rolls against creatures that are unaware of her presence (typically because she is invisible or using Stealth)." increment="This bonus~0~5~4~2" replace="Justice judgment"} ::ab[Swift and Silent (Ex)]{flavor="Umbral stalkers often descend upon their prey with deadly grace and efficiency." icon=boost passive="An umbral stalker gains a morale bonus on all Acrobatics and Stealth checks equal to ‹misc/half› her inquisitor level (minimum +1)." replace="Stern gaze"} ::ab[Deadly Efficiency (Ex)]{l=14 icon=lower-boost flavor="An umbral stalker becomes even deadlier against enemies who haven't yet noticed her in the shadows." ability="Whenever she confirms a critical hit against a foe that is unaware of her presence, she ignores any damage reduction the target might have and adds her Wisdom bonus to her damage roll (this multiplies on the critical hit as normal); in addition, if the target has ‹umr/regeneration›, the creature loses regeneration on the round following the critical hit and can die normally during that round. Creatures whose regeneration always functions are immune to this ability." special="If the umbral stalker deals energy damage to a creature unaware of her presence with vulnerability to that energy type, she deals 2 extra points of damage per die rolled." alter="Exploit weakness"}

name: Vigilant Defender
description: ## Vigilant Defender ‹SOURCE Ultimate Intrigue/31› Some inquisitors focus more on protecting those who share their faiths and their ideals than on actively hunting their enemies. These vigilant defenders often work alongside traveling clerics and paladins. ::ab[Shared Judgments (Su)]{icon=power swift="Whenever a vigilant defender has pronounced judgment on her foes, she can grant all of her allies the bonus or special ability that the judgment bestows. If she has multiple active judgments, they all affect her allies. When she does this, the judgments no longer affect her, and their effects only last for 1 round, after which that daily use of judgment ends immediately, even if the combat is not over. The vigilant defender cannot change any of these judgments to another type during this round." alter=Judgment} ::ab[Protect the Faithful (Ex)]{icon=boost order=nua info="A vigilant defender can spend 1 minute coaching and teaching a group of allies how best to avoid scrutiny from those who wish them harm. The vigilant defender and her allies cannot be in combat or threatened during this coaching, and allies must be able to see and hear the vigilant defender to benefit from this ability. This ability provides no benefits against enemies that have heard or seen the coaching." ability="Affected allies receive a morale bonus equal to ‹misc/one-fourth› of the vigilant defender's inquisitor level (minimum +1) on all Bluff, Disguise, Perception, and Stealth checks outside of combat made to avoid, deceive, or notice other creatures. This bonus lasts for 10 minutes, and the vigilant defender can affect herself and a number of allies equal to her Wisdom modifier (minimum 1)." useInc=inquisitor~4~+ useF="1~1~4~~4" replace="Stern gaze"} ::ab[Bolster the Wounded (Ex)]{l=14 icon=protect flavor="A vigilant defender can preternaturally sense when her allies are in grave peril and can form a mystical conduit to protect them from the full effects of grievous wounds." immediate="Whenever an enemy confirms a critical hit against an ally within 30 feet, the vigilant defender can choose to accept half the damage. If she does so, similar to the ‹spell/shield other› spell, any of her damage reduction, resistances, or immunities do not apply to the damage she takes." replace="Exploit weakness"} ::ab[True Vengeance (Su)]{l=20 icon=boost-down passive="When a vigilant defender calls *true judgment* down upon a foe, if the foe has killed one of the vigilant defender's allies (permanent sentient allies, such as fellow party members or cohorts, not summoned monsters, animal companions, pets, or the like), the DC of the target's Fortitude save to avoid death is 2 higher. If the foe has not damaged any of the vigilant defender's allies, the DC to avoid death is instead 2 lower." alter="True judgment"}

name: Witch Hunter
description: ## Witch Hunter ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/53› When pursuing justice for their faith, inquisitors sometimes hunt sorcerers, witches, wizards, and other practitioners of arcane magic - but especially witches, since their devotion to a patron is often seen as suspect by many religions. ::ab[Spell Sage (Ex)]{l=1 icon=boost passive="A witch hunter adds her Wisdom modifier on Spellcraft checks in addition to her Intelligence modifier when attempting to identify a spell as it is being cast, to identify the properties of a magic item using ‹spell/detect magic›, or to decipher a scroll." replace="Monster lore"} ::ab[Knowledgeable Defense]{l=2 icon=def passive="A witch hunter who identifies a spell with Spellcraft gains a bonus against its effects, either a +1 bonus on saving throws or a +1 dodge bonus to AC against this spell." increment="This bonus~2~4" imp20="Once per day as a @HLswift_action, she can grant this bonus to all her allies within 60 feet, for 1 minute. The allies gain the bonus when the witch hunter identifies the spell, and those among the allies who have at least 1 rank in Spellcraft can aid the witch hunter's next Spellcraft check as a @HLswift_action while under the effect of this ability." replace="Detect alignment~discern lies~true judgment"} ::ab[Spell Scent]{l=6 icon=power flavor="The witch hunter learns how to sense unique spell signatures, and can follow the trail of a cast spell or spell effect cast back to its source." fullround="Once per day, when the witch hunter comes into contact with or is exposed to a spell effect or a magic item, she can examine the spell effect or magic item, and then gains the effect of a ‹spell/locate creature› spell. She can do this even if the spell effect was instantaneous, but must start her examination within 1 round after she experienced the spell's effect. Instead of locating a known creature, the witch hunter locates the caster of the spell effect or magic item she examined. Doing so does not allow the witch hunter to gain any intelligence about the spellcaster other than its location." replace=Track} ::ab[Witch's Bane Judgment (Ex)]{head l=14 icon=power ability="A witch hunter gains the following judgment." replace="Exploit weakness"} ::ab[Witch's Bane]{next icon=lower passive="Any creature that casts an arcane spell within 30 feet of the witch hunter takes a -2 penalty to AC against her attacks and a -2 penalty on saving throws against her spells while this judgment remains in effect."}

name: Bladebound
description: ## Bladebound ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/47› A select group of magi are called to carry a @HL[black blade]: a sentient weapon of often unknown and possibly unknowable purpose. These weapons become valuable tools and allies, as both the magus and weapon typically crave arcane power, but as a *black blade* becomes more aware, its true motivations manifest, and as does its ability to influence its wielder with its ever-increasing ego. ### Black Blades A *black blade* is a particular form of ‹rule/intelligent «weapon Intelligent Item» Purpose @HL[Intelligence:] This is the intelligence score of the *black blade.* It starts at 10 and increases by 1 for every two levels of the bladebound magus (at 3rd level, 5th level, and so on). > >@HL[Wisdom and Charisma:] As the bladebound magus increases in level, so do the Wisdom and Charisma of the *black blade.* These abilities start at 6 and increase by 1 for every two levels of magus. > >@HL[Ego:] A *black blade* starts with an ego of 5, and that ego increases as the blade becomes more powerful. In cases where a wielder and the *black blade* come into conflict, like any intelligent item, a *black blade* can attempt to exert its dominance using the ‹rule/items against characters› rules. Due to its flexible and powerful nature, a *black blade* has a non-standard ego progression. > >@HL[Languages and Skills:] A *black blade* starts with Common as a language. As the *black blade* increases in Intelligence, it manifests knowledge of languages and arcane lore. Upon reaching an Intelligence of 12, it gains a bonus language of the GM's choice, and gains 1 rank in Knowledge (arcana). Each time the sword gains a bonus to Intelligence, it gains another language and another rank in Knowledge (arcana). > >@HL[Senses:] A *black blade* is aware of everything around it like a creature that can see and hear. It can be blinded and deafened as if it were a creature. It uses the saving throws of its magus, even if the magus is not currently wielding the *black blade.* > >@HL[Black Blade Arcane Pool:] A *black blade* has an *arcane pool* with a number of points equal to 1 + its Intelligence bonus. ::: ::ab[Black Blade Ability Descriptions]{head icon=power ability="A *black blade* has special abilities (or imparts abilities to its wielder) depending on the wielder's magus level. The abilities are cumulative. A *black blade* normally refuses to use any of its abilities when wielded by anyone other than its magus, and acts as a ‹rule/masterwork w«eapon› of its type."} ::ab[Alertness (Ex)]{next icon=power ability="While a magus is wielding his *black blade,* he gains the ‹feat/Alertness› feat."} ::ab[Black Blade Strike (Sp)]{next icon=boost free="The magus can spend a point from the *black blade's arcane pool* to grant the *black blade* a +1 bonus on damage rolls for 1 minute." increment="The bonus~1~4"} ::ab[Telepathy (Su)]{next icon=power ability="While a magus is wielding or carrying his *black blade,* he can communicate telepathically with the blade in a language that the magus and the *black blade* share."} ::ab[Unbreakable (Ex)]{next icon=def ability="As long as it has at least 1 point in its *arcane pool,* a *black blade* is immune to the ‹misc/broken› condition. If broken, the *black blade* is unconscious and powerless until repaired." special="If destroyed, the *black blade* can be reforged 1 week later through a special ritual that costs 200 gp per magus level. The ritual takes 24 hours to complete."} ::ab[Energy Attunement (Su)]{next l=5 icon=boost free="A magus can spend a point of his *black blade's arcane pool* to have it deal one of the following types of damage instead of weapon damage: cold, electricity, or fire. He can spend 2 points from the *black blade's arcane pool* to deal sonic or force damage instead of weapon damage. This effect lasts until the start of the magus's next turn."} ::ab[Teleport Blade (Sp)]{next icon=magic l=9 standard="A magus can expend an arcane point from his or his *black blade's arcane pool,* and can call his *black blade* from as far as 1 mile away, causing it to instantaneously teleport to his hand."} ::ab[Transfer Arcana (Su)]{next l=13 icon=magic fullround="Once per day, a magus can attempt to siphon points from his *black blade's arcane pool* into his own *arcane pool.* The magus must succeed at a Will saving throw with a DC equal to the *black blade's* ego. If the magus succeeds, he regains 1 point to his *arcane pool* for every 2 points he saps from his *black blade.* If he fails the saving throw, the magus becomes ‹misc/fatigued› (but can try again). If he is fatigued, he becomes ‹misc/exhausted› instead. He cannot use this ability if he is exhausted."} ::ab[Spell Defense (Sp)]{next l=17 icon=def free="A magus can expend an arcane point from his weapon's *arcane pool;* he then gains SR equal to his *black blade's* ego until the start of his next turn."} :::ab{next title="Life Drinker (Su)" l=19 icon=power-aid action=Ability special="The creature killed must have a number of Hit Dice equal to half the magus's character level for this to occur."} Each time the magus kills a living creature with the *black blade,* he can pick one of the following effects: - The *black blade* restores 2 points to its *arcane pool.* - The *black blade* restores 1 point to its *arcane pool* and the magus restores 1 point to his *arcane pool.* - The magus gains a number of ‹rule/temporary hit points› equal to the *black blade's* ego (these temporary hit points last until spent or 1 minute, whichever is shorter). ::: @HL[Magus Arcana:] The following magus arcana complement the bladebound magus archetype: ‹arcana/arcane accuracy›, ‹arcana/broad study›, ‹arcana/dispelling strike›, and ‹arcana/reflection›.

name: Hexcrafter
description: ## Hexcrafter ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/48› A hexcrafter magus has uncovered the secret of using his *arcane pool* to recreate ‹class/witch› hexes. These magi can hex friend and foe, curse those they strike, and expand their spell selection to include many curses and harmful spells. ::ab[Hex Magus (Su)]{l=4 icon=power ability="The hexcrafter magus gains access to a small number of witch ‹ability/hexes›. The hexcrafter magus picks one hex from the witch's *hex* class feature. He gains the benefit of or uses that hex as if he were a witch of a level equal to his magus level." replace="Spell recall"} ::ab[Hex Arcana]{head icon=power ability="A hexcrafter gains access to the following magus arcana, or may select any witch hex in place of a magus arcana." imp12="The hexcrafter may select a hex or ‹ability/major hex<es› in place of a magus arcana." imp18="A hexcrafter can select a hex, major hex, or ‹ability/grand hex<es› in place of a magus arcana." special="He cannot select any hex or arcana more than once."} ::ab[Accursed Strike (Sp)]{next icon=magic ability="A hexcrafter magus who can cast ‹spell/bestow curse›, ‹spell/major curse›, or any spell with the ‹spelldef/curse› descriptor can deliver these prepared spells using the *spellstrike* ability, even if the spells are not touch attack spells."} ::ab[Spells]{icon=learn info="A hexcrafter magus adds the following spells to his magus spell list: *bestow curse, major curse,* and all other spells of 6th level or lower that have the curse descriptor."} **Magus Arcana:** The following magus arcana complement the hexcrafter archetype: ‹arcana/arcane accuracy›, ‹arcana/broad study›, ‹arcana/familiar›, and ‹arcana/quickened magic›.

name: Kensai
description: ## Kensai ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/55;Adventurer's Armory 2/11› A kensai spends his life focusing his training and meditation into a rapturous perfection of the use of a single weapon, which is usually but not always a sword, channeling his arcane might through it in a dizzying and deadly dance beyond the abilities of even the greatest of mundane warriors. ::ab[Weapon and Armor Proficiency]{icon=power-down info="A kensai is proficient in simple weapons and in a single martial or exotic melee weapon of his choice. A kensai is not proficient with armor or shields and suffers normal arcane spell failure chance when casting magus spells while armored."} ::ab[Diminished Spellcasting]{icon=down info="A kensai may cast one fewer spell of each level than normal. If this reduces the number to 0, he may cast spells of that level only if his Intelligence allows ‹rule/bonus spells› of that level."} ::ab[Canny Defense (Ex)]{l=1 head icon=def ability="When a kensai is wielding his chosen weapon, he gains the *canny defense* ability. This is identical to the ‹pclass/duelist« prestige class› ability of the same name, save that his chosen weapon may be of any type"} ::ab[From the Duelist class]{next icon=def passive="When wearing light or no armor and not using a shield, a duelist adds 1 point of Intelligence bonus (if any) per duelist class level as a dodge bonus to her Armor Class while wielding a melee weapon. If a duelist is caught ‹rule/flat-footed› or otherwise denied her Dexterity bonus, she also loses this bonus."} ::ab[Weapon Focus (Ex)]{l=1 icon=power ability="A kensai gains either ‹feat/Weapon Focus› or ‹feat/Modified Weapon Proficiency› with his chosen weapon as a bonus feat."} ::ab[Perfect Strike (Ex)]{l=4 icon=melee-boost ability="When a kensai hits with his chosen weapon, he can spend 1 point from his *arcane pool* in order to maximize his weapon damage. Don't roll for damage: the weapon deals maximum damage. This affects only the weapon's base damage dice, not additional damage from ‹ability/sneak attack›, magical weapon properties, *spellstrike,* or critical hits." special="If the kensai confirms a critical hit, he can instead spend 2 points from his *arcane pool* to increase his weapon's critical multiplier by 1." replace="Spell recall"} ::ab[Fighter Training (Ex)]{l=7 icon=power passive="A kensai counts his magus level - 3 as his fighter level for the purpose of qualifying for feats (if he has levels in fighter, these levels stack), but forfeits the benefit of such feats with weapons other than his favored weapon." replace="Knowledge pool"} ::ab[Iaijutsu (Ex)]{l=7 icon=boost passive="A kensai applies his Intelligence modifier as well as his Dexterity modifier on initiative rolls (minimum 0)." ability="A kensai may make attacks of opportunity when flat-footed, and may draw his favored weapon as a @HLfree_action as part of taking an attack of opportunity." replace="Medium armor" order=pa} ::ab[Critical Perfection (Ex)]{l=9 icon=boost-power ability="A kensai adds his Intelligence bonus (minimum 0) on critical hit confirmation rolls with his favored weapon. In addition, the kensai may use his magus levels in place of his base attack bonuses to qualify for ‹feat/Critical Focus› and any feat for which it is a prerequisite; these feats apply only with a kensai's favored weapon." replace="Magus arcana gained at 9th level"} ::ab[Superior Reflexes (Ex)]{l=11 icon=power ability="Kensai can make a number of attacks of opportunity in a round equal to his Intelligence modifier (minimum 1). This effect stacks with the ‹feat/Combat Reflexes› feat." replace="Improved spell recall"} ::ab[Iaijutsu Focus (Ex)]{l=13 icon=power-boost ability="A kensai may always act and may draw his weapon as a @HLswift_action during a surprise round, though he is considered flat-footed until he acts. During a surprise round or when attacking a flat-footed opponent, he adds his Intelligence modifier on damage with his chosen weapon (minimum 0)." replace="Heavy armor"} ::ab[Iaijutsu Master (Ex)]{l=19 icon=boost-roll ability="A kensai's initiative roll is automatically a natural 20 and he is never surprised." replace="Greater spell access"} ::ab[Weapon Mastery (Ex)]{l=20 icon=power ability="A kensai gains *weapon mastery* with his favored weapon, as the ‹class/fighter› class ability." replace="True magus"} **Magus Arcana:** The following magus arcana complement the kensai archetype: ‹arcana/concentrate›, ‹arcana/critical strike›, ‹arcana/prescient attack›, ‹arcana/prescient defense›, ‹arcana/spell shield›.

name: Myrmidarch

features.name: Weapon Training (Ex)
features.replaces: Magus arcana gained at 6th, 12th, and 18th levels

description: ## Myrmidarch ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/56› The myrmidarch is a skilled specialist, using magic to supplement and augment his martial mastery. Less inclined to mix the two than a typical magus, the myrmidarch seeks supremacy with blade, bow, and armor. ::ab[Diminished Spellcasting]{icon=down ability="Myrmidarchs cast one fewer spell of each level than normal. If this reduces the number to 0, he may cast spells of that level only if his Intelligence allows ‹rule/bonus spells› of that level."} ::ab[Ranged Spellstrike (Su)]{l=4 icon=ranged ability="A myrmidarch can use *spellstrike* to cast a single-target touch attack ranged spell and deliver it through a ranged weapon attack. Even if the spell can normally affect multiple targets, only a single missile, ray, or effect accompanies the attack." imp11="A myrmidarch can spend a @HLfull-round_action to cast a spell that includes multiple ranged touch attacks and deliver more than one using ranged attacks. The spell must have a casting time of 1 full-round action or less. This functions similarly to the base ability of *ranged spellstrike,* but the myrmidarch can deliver a number of missiles, rays, or effect up to the number of attacks he could make with a full attack. Attacks beyond the first take penalties as if the myrmidarch were making a full attack. Any effects not used in the round the spell is cast are lost, as are any additional ranged touch attacks the spell would allow beyond the myrmidarch's maximum number of attacks." replace="Spell recall~improved spell recall"} ::ab[Weapon Training (Ex)]{l=6 head icon=power-boost ability="A myrmidarch gains *weapon training,* as the ‹class/fighter› ability, adding an additional weapon group every six levels after 6th (to a maximum of three groups at 18th level) and increasing the bonus on attack and damage rolls for weapon groups already chosen by +1." replace="Magus arcana gained at 6th, 12th, and 18th levels"} ::ab[Weapon Training (Ex)]{flavor="Text from the fighter class ability, with levels adjusted." next icon=boost l6="Select one ‹ability/weapon group<s›. Whenever you attack with a weapon from this group, you gain a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls. You also add this bonus to any combat maneuver checks made with weapons from this group. This bonus also applies to your ‹rule/CMD› when defending against ‹rule/disarm› and ‹rule/sunder› attempts made against weapons from this group." l12="You select a new weapon group and gain the +1 bonus when using weapons from that group. Your previously selected group's bonus increases to +2." l18="You select a new weapon group and gain the +1 bonus when using weapons from that group. Your previously selected groups' bonuses increase to +2 and +3." special="Bonuses granted from overlapping groups do not stack. Take the highest bonus granted for a weapon if it resides in two or more groups."} ::ab[Fighter Training (Ex)]{l=7 icon=power-boost passive="A myrmidarch counts his magus level - 3 as his fighter level for the purpose of qualifying for feats (if he has levels in fighter, these levels stack)." imp10="The myrmidarch treats his magus levels as fighter levels for the purposes of *fighter training.*" replace="Knowledge pool~10th-level fighter training"} ::ab[Armor Training (Ex)]{l=8 icon=def head ability="A myrmidarch gains *armor training,* as the fighter ability, but he only receives the first two benefits, and at a slower rate (see below)." replace="Improved spell combat~greater spell combat"} ::ab[Armor Training (Ex)]{icon=boost next flavor="Text from the fighter class ability, with levels adjusted." l8="Whenever you wear armor, you reduce the armor check penalty by 1 (to a minimum of 0) and increase the maximum Dexterity bonus allowed by the armor by 1. You can also move at your normal speed while wearing medium armor." l14="The penalty is now reduced by 2 (minimum 0) and the maximum Dex bonus is now increased by +2. You can also move at your normal speed while wearing heavy armor."} ::ab[Armor Mastery (Ex)]{l=20 icon=def passive="A myrmidarch gains DR 5/- when wearing armor." replace="True magus"} **Magus Arcana:** The following magus arcana complement the myrmidarch archetype: ‹arcana/accurate strike›, ‹arcana/arcane edge›, ‹arcana/lingering pain›, ‹arcana/prescient attack›, ‹arcana/prescient defense›, ‹arcana/spell shield›, ‹arcana/spellbreaker›.

name: Nature-Bonded Magus
description: ## Nature-Bonded Magus ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/92› A nature-bonded magus synergizes arcane magic and the divine magic traditions of druids into a deadly synthesis. ::ab[Natural Magic]{icon=learn ability="A nature-bonded magus adds one 0-level and one 1st-level spell from the ‹main/druid spell« list› to the magus spell list and his spellbook. Each time a nature-bonded magus gains the ability to cast a new level of spells, he can add one spell of that level from the druid spell list to both the magus spell list and his spellbook."} ::ab[Plant Familiar]{icon=power ability="A nature-bonded magus gains the ‹arcana/familiar› magus arcana. A nature-bonded magus must choose a plant familiar as his familiar." special="Plant ‹ability/familiars› include the creeper ivy, dweomer cap, flowering lattice, petrifern, ravenous tumbleweed, razor fern, and suture vine." replace="Arcane pool"} ::ab[Familiar Symbiosis (Su)]{l=4 icon=power-def standard="When a nature-bonded magus is adjacent to his familiar, he can merge with his familiar; both the nature-bonded magus and the familiar provoke attacks of opportunity with this action. Doing so causes the plant familiar to bond with a part of the nature-bonded magus's body as though it were growing on him. While merged, the nature-bonded magus's familiar can take no actions (but can still attempt Perception checks and communicate with the nature-bonded magus), and it can't be targeted or harmed by effects." special="As long as his familiar is merged, the nature-bonded magus gains half his plant familiar's natural armor adjustment to AC. The nature-bonded magus can separate from his plant familiar as a @HLstandard_action that provokes attacks of opportunity for both of them. Once they have separated, the familiar appears in an adjacent square of the nature-bonded magus' choosing." replace="Spell recall"} ::ab[Woodland Stride (Ex)]{l=7 icon=power ability="A nature-bonded magus can move through any sort of undergrowth (such as natural briars, overgrown areas, thorns, and similar terrain) at his normal speed and without taking damage or suffering any other impairment. Briars, overgrown areas, and thorns that are enchanted or magically manipulated to impede motion, however, still affect him." replace="Knowledge pool"} ::ab[Improved Familiar Symbiosis (Su)]{l=11 icon=boost passive="When a nature-bonded magus is merged with his familiar, he gains a +4 enhancement bonus to his Strength and Constitution." replace="Improved spell recall"}

name: Skirnir

features.name: Shielded Spell Combat (Su)
features.replaces: Improved spell combat~greater spell combat~greater spell access

description: ## Skirnir ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/56› Sometimes called a shield-vassal or shieldmaiden, the skirnir has learned to infuse his power into his shield. ::ab[Diminished Spellcasting]{icon=down ability="A skirnir casts one fewer spell of each level than normal. If this reduces the number to 0, he may cast spells of that level only if his Intelligence allows ‹rule/bonus spells› of that level."} ::ab[Arcane Bond (Su)]{l=1 icon=power head ability="A skirnir gains a shield (except for a tower shield) as an *arcane bond* item. This is identical to the ‹class/wizard› class ability, but the skirnir may only bond with a shield, not a familiar or other item."} :::ab{next title="Bonded Object" flavor="Relevant text from the wizard ability." icon=magic action=Ability} You begin play with a bonded object at no cost. This object is always masterwork quality. Weapons acquired at 1st level are not made of any special material. If the object is an amulet or ring, it must be worn to have effect, while staves, wands, and weapons must be wielded. If you attempt to cast a spell without your bonded object in hand, you must make a ‹rule/concentration› check or lose the spell. The DC for this check is equal to 20 + the spell's level. A bonded object can be used once per day to cast any one spell that you have in your spellbook and are capable of casting, even if the spell is not prepared. This spell is treated like any other spell cast by you, including casting time, duration, and other effects dependent on your level. This spell cannot be modified by metamagic feats or other abilities. You can add additional magic abilities to your bonded object as if you have the required item creation feats and if you meet the level prerequisites of the feat. For example, a wizard with a bonded dagger must be at least 5th level to add magic abilities to the dagger (see ‹feat/Craft Magic Arms and Armor›). The magic properties of a bonded object, including any magic abilities added to the object, only function for the wizard who owns it. If a bonded object's owner dies, or the item is replaced, the object reverts to being an ordinary masterwork item of the appropriate type. If a bonded object is damaged, it is restored to full hit points the next time you prepare your spells. If the object of an arcane bond is lost or destroyed, it can be replaced after 1 week in a special ritual that costs 200 gp per wizard level plus the cost of the masterwork item. This ritual takes 8 hours to complete. Items replaced in this way do not possess any of the additional enchantments of the previous bonded item. You can designate an existing magic item as your bonded item. This functions in the same way as replacing a lost or destroyed item except that the new magic item retains its abilities while gaining the benefits and drawbacks of becoming a bonded item. ::: ::ab[Arcane Pool]{l=1 icon=boost ability="A skirnir can use his *arcane pool* to grant an enhancement bonus to a weapon as normal, as well as to his shield, paying the *arcane pool* cost separately for each." imp5="He can also add the following shield special abilities: ‹magic-enh/animated›, ‹magic-enh/arrow catching›, ‹magic-enh/arrow deflection›, ‹magic-enh/bashing›, ‹magic-enh/blinding›, ‹magic-enh/fortification› (any), ‹magic-enh/reflecting›, ‹magic-enh/spell resistance› (any)."} ::ab[Sorcerous Shield (Ex)]{l=1 icon=power ability="Skirnirs are proficient with all types of shields, including tower shields, and do not suffer an arcane spell failure chance when casting magus spells while using a shield. They treat their magus levels as their fighter levels for the purpose of qualifying for shield-related feats." replace="Spell combat"} ::ab[Spellstrike (Su)]{l=1 icon=power ability="A skirnir may use this ability with a weapon or ‹misc/shield bash› attack." alter=Spellstrike} ::ab[Shield Pool (Ex)]{l=4 icon=def free="A skirnir may spend 1 point from his *arcane pool* to add his shield bonus to AC (not including enhancement bonuses) on a ‹rule/concentration› check to cast defensively. He may also use a touch attack or shield bash with his shield in conjunction with any *pool strike* magus arcana." replace="Spell recall"} ::ab[Spellshield (Su)]{l=7 icon=magic standard="A skirnir may store a magus spell in his shield by spending 1 point from his *arcane pool* per level of the spell. This functions as the ‹magic-enh/spell storing› weapon special ability, but activates only on a successful shield bash by the skirnir and is not limited to spells of 3rd level or less." replace="Knowledge pool"} ::ab[Shielded Spell Combat (Su)]{l=8 icon=power ability="A skirnir gains the *spell combat* ability, but only when wielding his *bonded shield.* A skirnir may use his shield hand to perform somatic components for magus spells, forfeiting the shield's bonus to AC until the beginning of his next turn; if the *bonded shield* is a buckler, he retains its bonus to AC." imp14="He gains the benefits of *improved spell combat.*" imp19="He retains his shield's bonus to AC when using any type of shield with *spell combat.*" alter="Spell combat" replace="Improved spell combat~greater spell combat~greater spell access"} ::ab[Greater Spellshield (Su)]{l=16 icon=magic immediate="A skirnir may activate a stored spell after being struck in combat. He may choose to have the spell affect himself or the creature that struck him." replace=Counterstrike} **Magus Arcana:** The following magus arcana complement the skirnir archetype: ‹arcana/arcane redoubt›, ‹arcana/greater arcane redoubt›, ‹arcana/enduring blade› (may use on weapon or shield), ‹arcana/pool strike›, ‹arcana/pool strike (arcing)›, ‹arcana/pool strike (clinging)›, ‹arcana/pool strike (thunderous)›, ‹arcana/prescient defense›, ‹arcana/reflection›.

name: Soul Forger
description: ## Soul Forger ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/57› The soul forger has learned the skill of infusing the raw magical essence of his soul into armaments of surpassing power, combining the mystic arts with the arts of war in a unity of steely perfection. ::ab[Diminished Spellcasting]{icon=down ability="A soul forger casts one fewer spell of each level than normal. If this reduces the number to 0, he may cast spells of that level only if his Intelligence allows ‹rule/bonus spells› of that level."} ::ab[Arcane Bond (Su)]{l=1 icon=power head ability="A soul forger gains a weapon as an *arcane bond* item. This is identical to the ‹class/wizard› class ability, but the soul forger must select a weapon."} :::ab{next title="Bonded Object" flavor="Relevant text from the wizard ability." icon=magic action=Ability} You begin play with a bonded object at no cost. The magic properties of a bonded object, including any magic abilities added to the object, only function for the wizard who owns it. If a bonded object's owner dies, or the item is replaced, the object reverts to being an ordinary masterwork item of the appropriate type. If a bonded object is damaged, it is restored to full hit points the next time you prepare your spells.
