You can designate an existing magic item as your bonded item. This functions in the same way as replacing a lost or destroyed item except that the new magic item retains its abilities while gaining the benefits and drawbacks of becoming a bonded item. ::: ::ab[Spell Combat (Su)]{icon=down ability="A soul forger may use this ability only when wielding his *bonded weapon.*" alter="Spell combat"} ::ab[Spellstrike (Su)]{icon=down ability="A soul forger may use this ability only when wielding his *bonded weapon.*" alter=Spellstrike} ::ab[Master Smith (Ex)]{icon=boost passive="A soul forger adds his magus class level on ‹skill/Craft› checks to manufacture armor, shields, and weapons. This bonus applies on skill checks required when using ‹feat/Craft Magic Arms and Armor›." imp7="A soul forger uses the 1/10 gp value of armor, shields, and weapons to determine how much time it takes to craft mundane items, and he requires only half the normal amount of time to enchant magical arms and armor." replace="Knowledge pool"} ::ab[Fortify Bond (Su)]{l=4 icon=boost ability="A soul forger may spend 1 point from his *arcane pool* to increase the hardness and hit points of his *bonded item* by an amount equal to his magus level. These hit points last until expended or until the soul forger next prepares spells. Multiple uses of this ability overlap and do not stack." replace="Spell recall"} ::ab[Reforge (Su)]{l=11 icon=aid standard="A soul forger can restore a number of hit points equal to his magus level to a damaged object by touching it and spending 1 point from his *arcane pool.* Repairing a destroyed object takes 1 minute and materials equal to 1/4 the item's sale value, and restores the object to 1 hit point." special="Restoring the enchantments of a destroyed magical item requires additional points from the soul forger's *arcane pool* equal to the item's caster level. The soul forger gains one temporary ‹rule/negative level› if the item's caster level is lower than his own, two negative levels if equal or greater (or none if the item is his *bonded weapon*); the save DC to remove these negative levels is equal to 10 + the item's caster level." replace="Improved spell recall"} ::ab[Destructive Counterstrike (Su)]{l=16 icon=lower passive="An opponent who activates a magical item while threatened by a soul forger provokes an attack of opportunity, either against the target or to ‹rule/sunder› the item. If the item is destroyed, its effects are negated." replace=Counterstrike} ::ab[Instantaneous Reconstruction (Su)]{l=19 icon=aid standard="A soul forger can reforge a destroyed item with a touch." provokes=No replace="Greater spell access"} **Magus Arcana:** The following magus arcana complement the soul forger archetype: ‹arcana/arcane accuracy›, ‹arcana/bane blade›, ‹arcana/devoted blade›, ‹arcana/dispelling strike›, ‹arcana/enduring blade›, and ‹arcana/ghost blade›.

name: Spellblade
description: ## Spellblade ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/49› A spellblade magus can manifest a ghostly blade of force that can be used as an off-hand weapon. ::ab[Force Athame (Sp)]{l=2 icon=power-melee swift="A spellblade magus can sacrifice a prepared magus spell of 1st level or higher to create a dagger of force in his off hand. The *athame* lasts for 1 minute or until dismissed, has an enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls equal to the level of the spell sacrificed (maximum +5), and is considered a weapon the spellblade is holding for purposes of his *arcane pool* feature (using the pool to add abilities to a held weapon applies to the magus's physical weapon and to the *athame* for no additional cost)." special="The *athame* acts as a ‹eq-weapon/dagger›, but the hand holding it is still considered free for the purpose of casting spells and delivering touch attacks. The magus can use the *athame* as if he were ‹rule/fighting with two weapons›, or can use that hand to cast spells as part of the *spell combat* class ability (but not both in the same round). Attacks with the *athame* are ‹spelldef/force› attacks and deal force damage." replace=Spellstrike} ::ab[Spellblade Arcana]{head icon=power ability="A spellblade gains access to the following magus arcana. He cannot select any arcana more than once."} ::ab[Pool-Sourced Athame (Su)]{next icon=power ability="Instead of sacrificing a prepared spell to create the *force athame,* the magus can spend points from his *arcane pool* to do so. An *athame* created this way has an enhancement bonus equal to the number of *arcane pool* points spent."} ::ab[Spellblade Parry (Su)]{next icon=def immediate="When an enemy makes a melee attack roll against the magus, he can end the *athame's* duration to gain a deflection bonus to his Armor Class until the end of his next turn. This bonus is equal to the level of the spell sacrificed to create the *athame* (maximum +5)."} ::ab[Throw Athame (Su)]{next icon=ranged standard="A spellblade magus can throw his *athame* up to 60 feet as a ranged attack (no range penalty). If the *athame* misses, it returns automatically to the magus' hand just before his next turn. If the *athame* hits, it deals damage and its duration ends; the magus can choose to spend up to 2 points from his *arcane pool* to increase the thrown *athame's* damage by +1d6 for each point spent."} **Magus Arcana:** The following magus arcana complement the spellblade archetype: ‹arcana/critical strike›, ‹arcana/hasted assault›, ‹arcana/pool strike›, and ‹arcana/spell shield›.

name: Staff Magus
description: ## Staff Magus ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/49› While most magi use a one-handed weapon as their melee implement of choice, one group of magi uses the quarterstaff instead. These lightly armored magi use staves for both defense and inflicting their spells upon enemies. Skilled in manipulating these weapons with one hand or two, they eventually learn how to use arcane staves as well, and are just as formidable in combat as their sword-swinging brethren. ::ab[Weapon and Armor Proficiency]{icon=down info="A staff magus is proficient with simple weapons only. He can cast magus spells while wearing light armor without incurring the normal arcane spell failure chance. Like any other arcane spellcaster, a magus wearing medium armor or heavy armor or using a shield incurs a chance of arcane spell failure if the spell in question has a somatic component. A multiclass magus still incurs the normal arcane spell failure chance for arcane spells received from other classes." replace="Weapon and armor proficiencies"} ::ab[Quarterstaff Master (Ex)]{l=1 icon=power ability="The staff magus gains the ‹feat/Quarterstaff Master› feat as a bonus feat, even if he does not meet the normal prerequisites. He only gains the benefit of this feat when wearing no armor or light armor."} ::ab[Quarterstaff Defense (Ex)]{l=7 icon=def passive="While wielding a quarterstaff, the staff magus gains a shield bonus to his Armor Class equal to the enhancement bonus of the quarterstaff, including any enhancement bonus on that staff from his *arcane pool* class feature." imp13="This bonus increases by +3." replace="Medium armor~heavy armor"} ::ab[Staff Weapon (Su)]{l=10 icon=melee order=pa passive="A staff magus treats any ‹main/magic«al» sta«ff<ves› he is wielding as a magical quarterstaff with an enhancement bonus to attack and damage equal to ‹misc/one-fourth› of the staff's caster level (minimum +1). The staff must have at least 1 charge for the magus to use this ability." ability="A staff magus can restore 1 charge to a staff by expending a number of points from his *arcane pool* equal to the level of the highest-level spell cast in the staff, as long as at least one spell in the staff is on the magus spell list. The magus cannot restore charges to more than one staff per day." replace="Fighter training"} **Magus Arcana:** The following magus arcana complement the staff magus archetype: ‹arcana/critical strike›, ‹arcana/dispelling strike›, ‹arcana/maneuver mastery›, and ‹arcana/spell shield›.

name: Black Asp
description: ## Black Asp ‹SOURCE Ultimate Intrigue/67› The black asps are a sinister order of monks who train as assassins and infiltrators with no need for weapons to achieve their goals. Through meditation and study, they learn how to use poison, hide any magics they choose to employ, and even empty their minds of thought to protect themselves from divinations. ::ab[Black Asp's Path (Ex)]{icon=def-power ability="A black asp is trained in the use of poison and cannot accidentally poison himself when applying poison to a weapon or when rolling a natural 1 on an attack roll with a poisoned weapon." imp3="The black asp's ability to use poison improves. He gains ‹feat/Adder Strike› as a bonus feat even if he does not meet the prerequisites." replace="Stunning fist~still mind"} ::ab[Forbidden Powers (Su)]{head icon=power ability="A black asp can select a *forbidden ki power* in place of any of the following monk class abilities: *slow fall* (4th), *high jump* (5th), *wholeness of body* (7th), *diamond body* (11th), *abundant step* (12th), *diamond soul* (13th), *quivering palm* (15th), *tongue of the sun and moon* (17th), and *empty body* (19th). If he chooses to do so, he replaces the monk class ability the black asp gives up for the chosen *forbidden ki power.* The black asp can select any of the following *forbidden ki powers.*"} ::ab[Black Asp Venom (Su)]{next prereq="12th-level monk" icon=power swift="A black asp with this ki power can poison his unarmed strike or a weapon in his hand. The poison lasts for 1 minute or until expended. A creature damaged by the poisoned weapon is affected as per the ‹spell/poison› spell. The save DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 the black asp's monk level + his Wisdom modifier. Each use of this ability costs 2 ki points."} ::ab[Hidden Magic (Sp)]{next icon=def immediate="The black asp can spend 1 ki point to hide the auras of all magic items he is carrying (as if they were all under ‹spell/magic aura›) for 1 hour per monk level."} ::ab[Greater Hidden Magic (Sp)]{next prereq="8th-level monk, *hidden magic* ki power" order=pi icon=def passive="As long as he has at least 1 point in his *ki pool,* all of the black asp's items are constantly under the effects of *magic aura.*" immediate="He can spend 2 ki points to cause himself and any magic items he is carrying to appear to be nonmagical (as if he had cast ‹spell/greater magic aura›) for 1 hour per monk level."} ::ab[Empty Mind (Sp)]{next icon=def ability="A black asp with this ki power can choose to lower the number of ki points in his *ki pool* by 3 when he recovers his ki points for the day. If he does so, he gains the benefits of ‹spell/mind blank› for 24 hours." prereq="16th-level monk, *greater hidden magic* ki power"} ::ab[Shifting Form (Su)]{next icon=def immediate="A black asp can spend 1 ki point to make his outline shift and waver for 1 round. This ability otherwise functions as per the spell ‹spell/blur›."}

name: Drunken Master
description: ## Drunken Master ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/110› Most monks lead lives of moderation and quiet contemplation. But the drunken master finds perfection through excess. Powered by strong wine, he uses his intoxication to reach a state where his ki is more potent, if somewhat fleeting. A drunken master has the following class features. ::ab[Drunken Ki (Su)]{l=3 icon=power provokes=No standard="A drunken master can drink a tankard of ale or strong alcohol and gain one temporary ki point. This does not provoke attacks of opportunity. The monk can have a maximum of 1 *drunken ki point.*" special="The monk can gain this temporary ki even before he gains a *ki pool* at 4th level. These *drunken ki points* last for 1 hour or until spent, whichever is shorter." order=sw swift="As long as he has at least 1 *drunken ki point,* the monk can spend 1 ki point to move 5 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity." replace="Still mind" incrementPlain="The monk's maximum~3~2" incrementEnd=" *drunken ki points.*"} ::ab[Drunken Strength (Su)]{l=5 icon=melee-boost swift="A drunken master can spend 1 point of ki to inflict 1d6 extra points of damage on a single successful melee attack. The monk can choose to apply the damage after the attack roll is made." incrementMulti="The monk may spend ~ *drunken ki points* to increase the extra damage to ~d6.~5/5;2/1" special="The monk must have at least 1 *drunken ki point* to use this ability." replace="Purity of body"} ::ab[Drunken Courage (Su)]{l=11 icon=def passive="A drunken master is immune to fear as long as he has at least 1 point of *drunken ki.*" replace="Diamond body"} ::ab[Drunken Resilience (Ex)]{l=13 icon=def passive="A drunken master gains ‹rule/DR› 1/- as long as he has at least 1 point of *drunken ki.*" imp16="The DR increases to 2/-." imp19="It increases to 3/-." replace="Diamond soul"} ::ab[Firewater Breath (Su)]{l=19 icon=cone standard="A drunken master can take a drink and expel a gout of alcohol-fueled fire in a 30-foot cone. Creatures within the cone take 20d6 points of fire damage. A successful Reflex saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 the monk's level + the monk's Wis modifier) halves the damage. Using this ability consumes 4 ki points from the monk's *ki pool.*" special="The monk must have at least 1 *drunken ki point* to use this ability." replace="Empty body"}

name: Flowing Monk

features.name: Unbalancing Counter (Ex)
features.replaces: The bonus feat gained at 2nd level

description: ## Flowing Monk ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/58› The flowing monk is the wind and the river. He knows how the world flows, and forces his enemies to flow with it. Even the most powerful stone breaks under the graceful and persistent pressure of wind and water. ::ab[Bonus Feat]{icon=power l1="A flowing monk replaces the normal monk bonus feats with the following: ‹feat/Agile Maneuvers›, ‹feat/Combat Reflexes›, ‹feat/Deflect Arrows›, ‹feat/Dodge›, ‹feat/Improved Reposition›, ‹feat/Improved Trip›, ‹feat/Nimble Moves›, and ‹feat/Weapon Finesse›." l6="The following feats are also available: ‹feat/Acrobatic Steps›, ‹feat/Bodyguard›, ‹feat/Improved Disarm›, ‹feat/Improved Feint›, ‹feat/Ki Throw›, ‹feat/Mobility›, ‹feat/Second Chance›, and ‹feat/Sidestep›." l10="The following feats are added: ‹feat/In Harm's Way›, ‹feat/Repositioning Strike›, ‹feat/Snatch Arrows›, ‹feat/Spring Attack›, and ‹feat/Tripping Strike›."} ::ab[Redirection (Ex)]{l=1 icon=melee immediate="A flowing monk can attempt a ‹rule/reposition› or ‹rule/trip› combat maneuver against a creature that the flowing monk threatens and that attacks him. If the combat maneuver is successful, the attacker is ‹misc/sickened› for a number of rounds equal to 1 + ‹misc/one-fourth› of her monk level (Reflex DC = 10 + 1/2 the monk's level + monk's Wisdom modifier to halve the duration). The monk gains a +2 bonus on the reposition or trip combat maneuver check and the save DC for redirection increases by 2 if the attacker is using ‹feat/Power Attack› or is ‹rule/charging› when attacking him. The benefit increases to a +4 bonus and an increase of the saving throw by 4 if both apply." imp4="A flowing monk can use redirection against an opponent that the flowing monk threatens and that attacks an ally with a melee attack." imp8="A flowing monk can make both a reposition and a trip maneuver as part of a single immediate action with this ability." imp12="A flowing monk can use redirection against any opponent that attacks him in melee, even if the flowing monk is not threatening the opponent who attacks him." special="A flowing monk can use this ability once per day per monk level, but no more than once per round." replace="Stunning fist"} ::ab[Unbalancing Counter (Ex)]{l=2 icon=lower ability="A flowing monk's attacks of opportunity render a struck creature ‹rule/flat-footed› until the end of the flowing monk's next turn (Reflex DC 10 + 1/2 the monk's level + Wisdom modifier negates)." replace="The bonus feat gained at 2nd level"} ::ab[Flowing Dodge (Ex)]{l=3 icon=def passive="A flowing monk gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC for each enemy adjacent to him, up to a maximum bonus equal to his Wisdom modifier (minimum 1)." replace="Fast movement"} ::ab[Elusive Target (Ex)]{l=5 icon=def immediate="A flowing monk may spend 2 points from his *ki pool* to attempt a Reflex save opposed by an attacker's attack roll to halve damage from that attack." imp11="The flowing monk suffers no damage on a successful save, or half damage on a failed save. If the attacker is ‹rule/flanking› the monk, the flanking opponent who is not attacking becomes the target of the attack. Use the same attack roll, and if the attack hits the new target, that creatures takes half damage (or full damage if the attack is completely avoided). Any associated effects from the attack (such as ‹umr/bleed›, poison, or spell effects) apply fully even if the attack deals only half damage." replace="Purity of body~diamond body"} ::ab[Volley Spell (Su)]{l=15 icon=def ability="When a targeted spell or spell-like ability fails to overcome a flowing monk's spell resistance, he may reflect the effect onto its caster as ‹spell/spell turning› by spending a number of points from his *ki pool* equal to 1/2 the spell's level (minimum 1)." replace="Quivering palm"}

name: Hungry Ghost Monk
description: ## Hungry Ghost Monk ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/110› The hungry ghost monk looks to spirits that prey upon the living as models of perfection. He sees the life energy of the universe as a resource to be manipulated, even stealing it from other creatures. It is through this constant influx of energy that the hungry ghost monk reaches his ultimate goal: power - personal, pure, and simple. A hungry ghost monk has the following class features. ::ab[Punishing Kick (Ex)]{l=1 icon=power ability="A hungry ghost monk gains ‹feat/Punishing Kick› as a bonus feat, even if he does not meet the prerequisites." imp10="The monk can push the target of his Punishing Kick an additional 5 feet (to 10 feet)." imp15="He can push the target 15 feet away. Or, he can instead choose to push the target 5 feet and knock the target ‹rule/prone› with the same attack. The target still gets a saving throw to avoid being knocked prone." imp20="He can push the target 20 feet away." replace="Stunning Fist"} ::ab[Steal Ki (Ex)]{l=5 icon=power-def flavor="A hungry ghost monk can steal ki from other creatures, though this ability is controversial in some circles of monks, who see it as nothing less than a form of vampirism." ability="If the monk scores a confirmed critical hit against a living enemy or reduces a living enemy to 0 or fewer hit points, he can steal some of that creature's ki. This ability replenishes 1 spent ki point to the monk's *ki pool,* as long as the monk has at least 1 ki point in his pool. He cannot exceed his *ki pool's maximum." imp11="Each time the monk successfully steals ki, he can make an immediate saving throw against one disease he is suffering from. There is no penalty for failing this saving throw. The monk gains a bonus equal to his Wisdom modifier on the saving throw." replace="Purity of body"} ::ab[Life Funnel (Su)]{l=7 icon=aid flavor="A hungry ghost monk can steal a creature's life force to replenish his own." ability="If the monk has at least 1 ki point in his *ki pool* and scores a confirmed critical hit against a living enemy or reduces a living enemy to 0 or fewer hit points, he heals a number of hit points equal to his monk level. As with *steal ki,* some monks believe that *life funnel* is an unsavory act, no better than what the undead do to the living." special="A monk with this ability cannot steal both ki and hit points at the same time." replace="Wholeness of body"} ::ab[Life from a Stone (Su)]{l=11 icon=def-aid flavor="A hungry ghost monk can steal ki or life force from any creature, not just living creatures." ability="If the monk has at least 1 ki point in his pool, he gains the benefit of *life funnel* and *steal ki* when he confirms a critical hit against any creature or reduces any creature to 0 or fewer hit points." replace="Diamond body"} ::ab[Sipping Demon (Su)]{l=13 icon=aid ability="A hungry ghost monk gains 1 ‹rule/temporary hit point<s› each time he hits an enemy with a melee attack. The monk gains a number of temporary hit points equal to his Wisdom modifier when he scores a critical hit. The maximum number of temporary hit points the monk can have is equal to his monk level. The temporary hit points disappear 1 hour later." special="The monk can only use this ability when he has at least 1 ki point in his *ki pool.* This ability is a proscribed manipulation of ki considered by many good monks to be a corruption." replace="Diamond soul"}

name: Ki Mystic
description: ## Ki Mystic ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/111› The ki mystic believes that violence is sometimes necessary, but knowing and understanding is the true root of perfection. Through meditation and spiritual visions, a ki mystic can see beyond the veil of reality to the underlying truth of all existence. A ki mystic has the following class features. ::ab[Ki Mystic (Su)]{l=3 icon=power-boost ability="A ki mystic gains a pool of ki points equal to his Wisdom modifier. If the monk has at least 1 point of ki in his *ki pool,* he gains a +2 bonus on all Knowledge skill checks." order=aw swift="The monk can spend 1 ki point immediately before making an ability or skill check to gain a +4 insight bonus on the check." imp4="The pool increases to 1/2 his monk level + his Wisdom modifier + 2." replace="Still mind"} ::ab[Mystic Insight (Su)]{l=5 icon=roll flavor="A ki mystic becomes apt at giving just the right word of advice in just the nick of time." immediate="The monk can spend 2 ki points to grant an ally within 30 feet the ability to reroll a single attack roll or saving throw. The ally must be able to hear the monk to gain the reroll benefit." replace="Purity of body"} ::ab[Mystic Visions (Su)]{l=11 icon=magic ability="A ki mystic may receive mystic visions when he rests. These visions can come as a dream, an epiphany, or even as the voice of an old friend whispering in the monk's mind. The effect is similar to a ‹spell/divination› spell with a caster level equal to the monk's level. The divination has no casting time; it is just part of the normal dreams or visions that occur every night. Using this ability costs 2 ki points that are removed from the next day's total." replace="Diamond body"} ::ab[Mystic Prescience (Su)]{icon=def l13="A ki mystic gains a +2 insight bonus to AC and CMD." l20="The bonus increases to +4." replace="Diamond soul"} ::ab[Mystic Persistence (Su)]{l=19 icon=aura-roll swift="A ki mystic can create an aura once per day at the cost of at least 2 points of ki. The aura emanates out to a 20-foot radius. The monk and all allies within the aura can roll two dice when making an attack roll or a saving throw and take the better result. The aura lasts for 1 round, plus an additional round for every 2 ki points spent when the monk created the aura." special="The monk can dismiss the aura at any time as a @HLfree_action, but the ki points for the full duration of the aura are lost." replace="Empty body"}

name: Maneuver Master
description: ## Maneuver Master ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/58› The maneuver master specializes in more complicated moves than simple damage-dealing strikes. ::ab[Bonus Feat]{icon=power l1="In addition to normal monk bonus feats, a maneuver master may select any Improved combat maneuver feat (such as ‹feat/Improved Overrun›) as a bonus feat." l6="He may select any Greater combat maneuver feat (such as ‹feat/Greater Grapple›) as a bonus feat." l10="He may select any maneuver Strike feat (such as ‹feat/Tripping Strike›) as a bonus feat."} ::ab[Flurry of Maneuvers (Ex)]{icon=melee l1="As part of a full-attack action, a maneuver master can make one additional combat maneuver, regardless of whether the maneuver normally replaces a melee attack or requires a standard action. The maneuver master uses his monk level in place of his base attack bonus to determine his CMB for the bonus maneuvers, though all combat maneuver checks suffer a -2 penalty when using a flurry." l8="A maneuver master may attempt a second additional combat maneuver, with an additional -3 penalty on combat maneuver checks." l15="A maneuver master may attempt a third additional combat maneuver, with an additional -7 penalty on combat maneuver checks." special="A maneuver master loses this ability when wearing armor, using a shield, or carrying a medium or heavy load." replace="Flurry of blows"} ::ab[Maneuver Defense (Ex)]{l=3 icon=lower passive="If a maneuver master has an Improved combat maneuver feat, any creature attempting that maneuver against the maneuver master provokes an attack of opportunity, even if it would not normally do so." replace="Still mind"} ::ab[Reliable Maneuver (Ex)]{l=4 icon=roll swift="A maneuver master may spend 1 point from his *ki pool* before attempting a combat maneuver. He can roll his combat maneuver check for that maneuver twice and use the better result." replace="Slow fall"} ::ab[Meditative Maneuver (Ex)]{l=5 icon=boost swift="A maneuver master can add his Wisdom modifier on any combat maneuver check he makes before the beginning of his next turn. He must choose which combat maneuver check to grant the bonus to before making the combat maneuver check." replace="Purity of body"} ::ab[Sweeping Maneuver (Ex)]{l=11 icon=melee ability="A maneuver master can make two combat maneuvers as a @HLstandard_action, as long as neither maneuver requires the maneuver master to move. He may perform two identical maneuvers against two adjacent enemies, or he may perform two different combat maneuvers against the same target." replace="Diamond body"} ::ab[Whirlwind Maneuver (Ex)]{l=15 icon=melee fullround="Once per day, a maneuver master can attempt a single combat maneuver against every opponent he threatens, as long as the combat maneuver does not require movement. He makes a single combat maneuver check, and it applies to all targets." replace="Quivering palm"}

name: Martial Artist

features.name: Physical Resistance (Ex)
features.replaces: Wholeness of body~timeless body~tongue of sun and moon

description: ## Martial Artist ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/59› The martial artist pursues a mastery of pure martial arts without the monastic traditions. He is a master of form, but lacks the ability to harness his ki. ::ab[Alignment]{icon=info info="A martial artist may be of any alignment."} ::ab[Pain Points (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost passive="A martial artist's advanced knowledge of humanoid anatomy grants a +1 bonus on critical hit confirmation rolls and increases the DC of his *stunning fist* and *quivering palm* by 1." replace="Still mind"} ::ab[Martial Arts Master (Ex)]{l=4 icon=boost ability="A martial artist may use his monk level to qualify for feats with a fighter level prerequisite when those feats are applied to unarmed strikes or weapons with the monk special quality." replace="Slow fall"} ::ab[Exploit Weakness (Ex)]{l=4 icon=boost-def order=wa swift="A martial artist can observe a creature or object to find its weak point by making a Wisdom check and adding his monk level against a DC of 10 + the object's hardness or the target's CR. If the check succeeds, the martial artist gains a +2 bonus on attack rolls until the end of his turn, and any attacks he makes until the end of his turn ignore the creature or object's DR or hardness." ability="A martial artist may instead use this ability as a @HLswift_action to analyze the movements and expressions of one creature within 30 feet, granting a bonus on Sense Motive checks and Reflex saves and a dodge bonus to AC against that opponent equal to 1/2 his monk level until the start of his next turn." replace="Ki pool"} ::ab[Extreme Endurance (Ex)]{icon=def l5="A martial artist gains immunity to ‹misc/fatigue›." l10="He also gains immunity to ‹misc/exhaustion›." l15="He gains immunity to stunning." l20="He gains immunity to death effects and ‹rule/energy drain›." replace="Purity of body~diamond body~perfect self"} ::ab[Physical Resistance (Ex)]{l=7 icon=def passive="If a martial artist suffers any effect that causes ‹rule/ability damage›, ability drain, or temporary ability score penalties, the effect is reduced by 1 point." incrementPlain="This reduction~7~3" incrementEnd=" points." replace="Wholeness of body~timeless body~tongue of sun and moon"} ::ab[Bonus Feats]{l=12 icon=power ability="A martial artist gains an additional bonus feat, selected from those available in the monk class feature." replace="Abundant step"} ::ab[Defensive Roll (Ex)]{l=13 icon=def ability="A martial artist may use the defensive roll ‹ability/advanced rogue talent› once per day." incrementUse=He~13~3 replace="Diamond soul"} ::ab[Quivering Palm]{alter="Quivering palm" icon=boost l16="A martial artist may use this ability one additional time per day." incrementUse=He~16~1 incrementEnd=" additional times per day." special="A martial artis may not have more than one *quivering palm* in effect at a time."} ::ab[Greater Defensive Roll (Ex)]{l=19 icon=def passive="A martial artist suffers no damage on a successful defensive roll, and only half damage if the Reflex saving throw fails." replace="Empty body"}

name: Master of Many Styles
description: ## Master of Many Styles ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/59› The master of many styles is a collector. For every move, he seeks a counter. For every style, he has a riposte. Ultimately, he seeks perfection through the fusion of styles. ::ab[Bonus Feat]{icon=power l1="A master of many styles may select a bonus ‹main/style feat› or the ‹feat/Elemental Fist› feat. He does not need to meet the prerequisites of that feat, except the Elemental Fist feat." l2="He may select another such feat." l6="A master of many styles can choose to instead another such feat, or gain a *wildcard style slot.* Whenever he enters one or more styles, he can spend his *wildcard style slots* to gain feats in those styles' feat paths (such as ‹feat/Earth Child Topple›) as long as he meets the prerequisites. Each time he changes styles, he can also change these *wildcard style slots.*" repeat="He gains another feat or *slot,* as above.~10~4" replace="Standard bonus feats"} ::ab[Fuse Style (Ex)]{icon=power-boost flavor="A master of many styles can fuse two of the styles he knows into a more perfect style." l1="The master of many styles can have two style feat stances active at once. Starting a stance provided by a style feat is still a @HLswift_action, but when the master of many styles switches to another style feat, he can choose one style whose stance is already active to persist. He may only have two style feat stances active at a time." l8="The master of many styles can fuse three styles at once, having the stances of three style feats active at the same time. He gains a bonus on attack rolls equal to the number of styles whose stances he currently has active. Furthermore, he can enter up to three stances as a @HLswift_action." l15="The master of many styles can fuse four styles at once, having the stances of four style feats active at the same time. Furthermore, he can enter up to four stances as a @HLfree_action by spending 1 point from his *ki pool.*" replace="Flurry of blows"} ::ab[Perfect Style (Ex)]{l=20 icon=power ability="A master of many styles can have the stances of five style feats active at once, and can change those stances as a @HLfree_action." replace="Perfect self"}

name: Menhir Guardian
description: ## Menhir Guardian ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/64› Menhir guardians are ascetic protectors of sacred druidic sites, less concerned with structure and maintaining internal order than they are with preserving the natural balance of the world. ::ab[Alignment]{icon=info info="A menhir guardian can be lawful neutral, neutral good, neutral evil, or neutral. While they can work with chaotic allies, they cannot themselves be chaotic." alter="Alignment requirement"} ::ab[Weapon and Armor Proficiency]{icon=power-down ability="A menhir guardian is proficient with the ‹eq-weapon/club›, ‹eq-weapon/dagger›, ‹eq-weapon/dart›, ‹eq-weapon/quarterstaff›, ‹eq-weapon/sickle›, ‹eq-weapon/shortspear›, ‹eq-weapon/sling›, and ‹eq-weapon/spear›. A menhir guardian can use these weapons in conjunction with his *wild flurry* ability." replace="Weapon and armor proficiency"} ::ab[Claws (Ex)]{icon=melee flavor="A menhir guardian learns to draw upon natural forces to subtly change his body." ability="He gains the ‹class/shifter«'s› *shifter claws* class feature and treats his monk level as his shifter level for the purposes of this ability." replace="Unarmed strike~ki strike" alter="Ki pool" head} ::ab[Shifter Claws (Su)]{next flavor="Text from the shifter class" icon=melee order=wn swift="In your natural form, you can extend your claws to use as a weapon." info="The claws on each hand can be used as a primary ‹umr/natural attack›, dealing 1d4 points of piercing and slashing damage (1d3 if you are Small). If you use one of your claw attacks in concert with a weapon held in the other hand, the claw acts as a secondary natural attack instead." imp3="Your claws ignore DR/cold iron, DR/magic, and DR/silver." imp7="Your claw damage becomes 1d6 (1d4 if Small)." imp11="Your claw damage becomes 1d8 (1d6 if Small)." imp17="Your claws' critical multiplier becomes &times&3." imp19="Your claws ignore DR/adamantine and DR/-." } ::ab[Wild Flurry (Ex)]{icon=melee ability="A menhir guardian gains *flurry of blows.* He can use this ability with the natural attacks provided by his *shifter claws* ability or the weapons specified above under weapon and armor proficiency." alter="Furry of blows"} ::ab[Rebuking Strike (Ex)]{l=1 icon=melee flavor="A menhir guardian can channel his ki into a devastating strike that repels his enemies." ability="A menhir guardian must declare that he is using *rebuking strike* before making a natural attack with his claws. On a hit, a foe damaged by the menhir guardian's claws must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw (DC = 10 + half the menhir guardian's level + his Wisdom modifier) or be pushed back 5 feet directly away from the menhir guardian." incrementPlain="The distance the foe is pushed~1~4~10~5" incrementEnd=" feet." special="If this movement would be blocked by a solid object, the target of *rebuking strike* takes 1d6 points of damage per 10 feet moved and falls ‹rule/prone› at the end of the movement." imp5="A creature pushed also has its speed reduced by half for a number of rounds equal to the menhir guardian's level." imp15="A pushed creature is also affected by ‹spell/aversion›, making it avoid the menhir guardian's current location for 1 round per level the menhir guardian has." usage="The menhir guardian can attempt a *rebuking strike* a number of times per day equal to his monk level, but only once per round." replace="Stunning fist~high jump~quivering palm"}

name: Monk of the Empty Hand
description: ## Monk of the Empty Hand ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/111› The monk of the empty hand eschews normal weapons in favor of whatever is lying around - rocks, chair legs, flagons of ale, even a simple quill pen all become deadly weapons in the hands of such a monk. A monk of the empty hand draws on his own ki to infuse his improvised weapons with power, and can transform a broken bottle into a magical weapon. ::ab[Weapon and Armor Proficiency]{icon=power-down ability="Monks of the empty hand are proficient with the ‹eq-weapon/shuriken› only. A monk of the empty hand treats normal weapons as ‹misc/improvised weapons› with the following equivalencies (substituting all of their statistics for the listed weapon): a light weapon functions as a ‹eq-weapon/light hammer›, a one-handed weapon functions as a ‹eq-weapon/club›, and a two-handed weapon functions as a ‹eq-weapon/quarterstaff›." replace="Weapon proficiencies"} ::ab[Flurry of Blows (Ex)]{l=1 icon=power ability="A monk of the empty hand can make a *flurry of blows* using any combination of unarmed strikes or attacks with an improvised weapon. He may not make a *flurry of blows* with any other weapons, including special monk weapons. A monk of the empty hand's *flurry of blows* otherwise functions as normal for a monk of his level." alter="Flurry of blows"} ::ab[Bonus Feat]{icon=power l6="A monk of the empty hand adds the following feats to his list of bonus feats: ‹feat/Improved Dirty Trick›, ‹feat/Improved Steal›, and ‹feat/Improvised Weapon Mastery›."} ::ab[Versatile Improvisation (Ex)]{l=3 icon=melee swift="A monk of the empty hand may use an improvised weapon to deal damage as if it were another type (bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing) for 1 round, regardless of the weapon's normal damage type." replace="Still mind"} ::ab[Ki Pool (Su)]{l=4 icon=ranged-boost ability="In addition to the normal abilities of his *ki pool,* a monk of the empty hand may spend 1 point from his *ki pool* to increase the range increment for an improvised thrown weapon or shuriken by 20 feet for 1 round."} ::ab[Ki Weapons (Su)]{l=5 icon=boost swift="A monk of the empty hand may spend 1 point from his *ki pool* to deal damage equal to his unarmed strike damage with an improvised weapon for 1 round." imp11="The monk may spend ki to grant an enhancement bonus or magical weapon abilities to an improvised weapon for 1 round, at the rate of 1 point of ki per +1 bonus or its equivalent. The monk may not spend more than 3 points of ki at one time for this purpose. For example, a monk can spend 2 points of ki to give his improvised weapon a +1 enhancement bonus and the ‹magic-enh/ki focus› quality, or just the ‹magic-enh/flaming burst› quality." imp15="The limit increases to 5 ki per round. The monk may use this ability to add magical weapon qualities to improvised weapons that could not normally have such a quality, such as adding the ‹magic-enh/disruption› quality to a slashing weapon, or the ‹magic-enh/vorpal› quality to a bludgeoning weapon." replace="Purity of body~diamond body"}

name: Monk of the Four Winds
description: ## Monk of the Four Winds ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/112› The monk of the four winds is connected to the natural world in a way few other creatures - even other monks - can hope to match. He can call upon the elements and the spirits of the world in times of need, and as he nears his goal of perfection, he gains the ability to slow down time and even defeat death itself. A monk of the four winds has the following class features. ::ab[Elemental Fist (Su)]{icon=power-melee l1="A monk of the four winds gains ‹feat/Elemental Fist› as a bonus feat, even if he does not meet the prerequisites." l5="The monk increases the damage of his Elemental Fist by 1d6." imp10="The damage is now increased by 2d6." imp15="The damage is now increased by 3d6." imp20="The damage is now increased by 4d6." replace="Stunning Fist"} ::ab[Slow Time (Su)]{l=12 icon=magic-power flavor="A monk of the four winds can use his ki to slow time or quicken his movements, depending on the observer." swift="The monk can expend 6 ki points to gain three standard actions during his turn instead of just one. The monk can use these actions to do the following: take a melee attack action, use a skill, use an extraordinary ability, or take a move action. The monk cannot use these actions to cast spells or use spell-like abilities, and cannot combine them to take full-attack actions. Any move actions the monk makes this turn do not provoke attacks of opportunity." replace="Abundant step"} ::ab[Aspect Master (Su)]{head l=17 icon=power-warning ability="A monk of the four winds must choose an aspect of one of the great spirits of the world. Once made, this choice cannot be changed. This spirit grants the monk a new appearance and new abilities, as well as changing or augmenting the monk's personality in some way. Once this choice is made, it cannot be changed." special="The monk must abide by the alignment restrictions of the aspect. If the monk ever changes his alignment to something outside the aspect's alignment restrictions, he loses this ability and cannot regain it unless his alignment later changes again to match that of the aspect." replace="Timeless body"} ::ab[Aspect of the Carp]{next icon=power ability="The monk's skin becomes a coat of golden, iridescent fish scales, his neck grows gills, and his fingers become webbed. He can breathe water and gains a swim speed equal to his land speed." special="The carp is heroic and adventurous - a monk must be nonevil to take on the aspect of the carp."} ::ab[Aspect of the Ki-Rin]{next icon=power ability="The monk's skin takes on a golden luminescence, and a silvery mane that cannot be bound grows atop his head. He gains a fly speed equal to his land speed, but he must end each turn on the ground. If the monk does not land by the end of his turn, he falls from whatever height he has attained." special="The ki-rin is honorable, honest, and self-sacrificing - a monk must be lawful good to take on the aspect of the ki-rin."} ::ab[Aspect of the Monkey]{next icon=power-melee ability="The monk's face becomes that of a monkey, and he grows a prehensile tail. The monk can pick up objects and make unarmed attacks with his tail (though the tail does not grant additional unarmed attacks or natural attacks). In addition, the monk gains a climb speed equal to his land speed." special="The monkey is a creature of whimsy and a lover of pranks - a monk of any alignment can take on the aspect of the monkey."} ::ab[Aspect of the Oni]{next icon=magic ability="The monk's skin becomes pitch black, and his hair turns white, black, red, or violet. He can assume ‹spell/gaseous form› (as the spell) as a standard action for 1 minute per day per monk level. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments." special="The oni is treacherous and deceitful, and it hungers for the pain and death of living creatures - a monk must be evil to take on the aspect of the oni."} ::ab[Aspect of the Owl]{next icon=power ability="The monk grows feathers, and his head becomes avian, with wide, unblinking eyes. He gains a fly speed of 30 feet." special="The owl is a sage creature, deeply serious, and driven toward a single goal - a monk of any alignment can take on the aspect of the owl."} ::ab[Aspect of the Tiger]{next icon=melee ability="Dark stripes appear on the monk's skin, and his face becomes more feline. His eyes become cat-like, with vertical pupils, and his canines enlarge. Once per hour, the monk can move at 10 times his normal land speed when he makes a charge and is treated as if he had the ‹umr/pounce› ability." special="The tiger is swift, fierce, and deadly - a monk of any alignment can take on the aspect of the tiger."} ::ab[Immortality (Su)]{l=20 icon=def passive="A monk of the four winds no longer ages. He remains in his current age category forever. Even if the monk comes to a violent end, he spontaneously ‹spell/reincarnate«s› (as the spell) 24 hours later in a place of his choosing within 20 miles of the place he died. The monk must have visited the place in which he returns back to life at least once." replace="Perfect self"}

name: Monk of the Healing Hand
description: ## Monk of the Healing Hand ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/113› Monks of the healing hand seek perfection through helping others. By focusing their meditations on the flow of life within themselves and all creation they gain an understanding of how to share their ki with others, healing wounds and even bringing the dead back to life. For such a monk, sacrificing himself to save another is the surest way to achieve transcendence. A monk of the healing hand has the following class features. ::ab[Ancient Healing Hand (Su)]{l=7 icon=aid flavor="A monk of the healing hand can heal another creature's wounds with a touch." fullround="The monk can spend 2 ki points to heal a number of hit points equal to the monk's level. He needs at least one hand free to use this ability, and cannot heal himself. If the action is interrupted, the subject heals no hit points, and the ki points are lost." replace="Wholeness of body"} ::ab[Ki Sacrifice (Su)]{l=11 icon=magic ability="A monk of the healing hand can use his entire *ki pool* to bring a person back to life. It takes 1 hour to perform this ritual. At the end of the ritual, the monk sacrifices all of his ki in order to cast ‹spell/raise dead› (as the spell) with a caster level equal to his monk level. The ritual uses all of the ki in the monk's *ki pool;* the monk must have at least 6 points of ki in his *ki pool* to use this ability." imp15="The monk may sacrifice his ki to cast ‹spell/resurrection›. The monk must have at least 8 points of ki in his *ki pool* to use this ability." special="These rituals do not require material components. When this ability is used, the monk's *ki pool* is not replenished until 24 hours have passed." replace="Diamond body~quivering palm"} ::ab[True Sacrifice (Su)]{l=20 icon=aura-magic-down ability="In a final selfless act, a monk of the healing hand can draw in his entire ki, which then explodes outward in a 50-foot-radius ‹misc/emanation›. All dead allies within the emanation are brought back to life, as if they were the subject of a ‹spell/true resurrection› spell with a caster level equal to the monk's level." special="When the monk does this, he is truly and utterly destroyed. A monk destroyed in this way can never come back to life, not even by way of a ‹spell/wish› or ‹spell/miracle› spell or by the power of a deity. Furthermore, the monk's name can never be spoken or written down again. All written mentions of his name become nothing more than a blank space." replace="Perfect self"}

name: Monk of the Lotus

features.name: Learned Master (Ex)
features.replaces: Tongue of the sun and the moon

description: ## Monk of the Lotus ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/114› Monks are warriors who hone their bodies into deadly weapons, but some monks eschew violence in favor of a more peaceful philosophy. While a monk of the lotus realizes that combat cannot always be avoided - and is more than capable in a fight - he understands that all creatures are connected, and to harm another is to harm the self. Instead, he strives to find peaceful resolutions to conflicts, and in doing so, hopes to achieve inner peace. A monk of the lotus has the following class features. ::ab[Touch of Serenity (Su)]{l=1 icon=power ability="A monk of the lotus gains ‹feat/Touch of Serenity› as a bonus feat, even if he does not meet the prerequisites. The duration of Touch of Serenity is increased by ‹misc/one-sixth› of his monk level." special="Each round on its turn, the target may attempt a new Will save to end the effect. This duration does not stack; only the longest remaining duration applies." replace="Stunning Fist"} ::ab[Touch of Surrender (Su)]{l=12 icon=melee-lower flavor="A monk of the lotus makes a foe into a friend with a single show of mercy." immediate="When one of his melee attacks would reduce a creature to 0 or fewer hit points, the monk can spend 6 ki points to make the target of that attack surrender. When the target surrenders, it is reduced to 0 hit points, becomes ‹misc/disabled›, and is charmed, as if the monk had cast ‹spell/charm monster› with a caster level equal to the monk's level. The target does not get a saving throw against this effect." special="This charm lasts until its duration expires, until the monk dismisses it or uses it on another creature, or until the target is again reduced to 0 or fewer hit points, whichever happens first. The monk can only have one creature charmed with *touch of surrender* at a time. This is a mind-affecting charm effect." replace="Abundant step"} ::ab[Touch of Peace (Su)]{l=15 icon=melee flavor="A monk of the lotus can set up vibrations within the body of another creature to win over the creature's mind." ability="The monk can use *touch of peace* once per day, and must announce his intent before making his attack roll. On a successful hit, the attack deals no damage, but the target is charmed as if the monk had cast *charm monster* with a caster level equal to the monk's level. The target does not get a saving throw against this effect. The creature is charmed for 1 day per level." special="If the monk or his allies attack the charmed creature, or if the monk asks or commands the charmed creature to take hostile actions, the effect ends. This is a mind-affecting charm effect." replace="Quivering palm"} ::ab[Learned Master (Ex)]{l=17 icon=boost ability="A monk of the lotus gains all ‹skill/Knowledge› skills and the ‹skill/Linguistics› skill as class skills. The monk uses Wisdom instead of Intelligence as the key ability for these skills." replace="Tongue of the sun and the moon"}

name: Monk of the Sacred Mountain

features.name: Vow of Silence (Su)
features.replaces: Tongue of the sun and the moon

description: ## Monk of the Sacred Mountain ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/114› The monk of the sacred mountain finds strength and power in the earth beneath his feet. Rather than spinning though the battlefield with the fluid motion of the river, he roots himself to the ground, as immovable and unshakable as the stones of the mountain. A monk of the sacred mountain has the following class features. ::ab[Iron Monk (Ex)]{l=2 icon=power-def ability="A monk of the sacred mountain gains ‹feat/Toughness› as a bonus feat." passive="The monk gains a +1 natural armor bonus." order=ap replace=Evasion} ::ab[Bastion Stance (Ex)]{icon=def l4="A monk of the sacred mountain becomes like stone, nearly impossible to move when he stands his ground. If the monk starts and ends his turn in the same space, he cannot be knocked ‹rule/prone› or forcibly moved until the start of his next turn, except by mind-affecting or teleportation effects." l16="He is immune to any attempts to force him to move, even mind-affecting and teleportation effects." replace="Slow fall"} ::ab[Iron Limb Defense (Ex)]{l=5 icon=def-boost ability="A monk of the sacred mountain can deflect blows with an active defense that complements his bastion stance. If the monk starts and ends his turn in the same space, he gains a +2 shield bonus to AC and CMD until the start of his next turn." swift="He can spend 1 ki point to increase this bonus to +4." order=aw replace="High jump"} ::ab[Adamantine Monk (Ex)]{l=9 icon=def passive="A monk of the sacred mountain has muscles so strong and skin so resilient that he gains DR 1/-." order=pw incrementPlain="The monk's DR~9~3" incrementEnd="/-." swift="The monk can spend 1 ki point to double his DR until the beginning of his next turn." replace="Improved evasion"} ::ab[Vow of Silence (Su)]{l=17 icon=def-boost-warning passive="A monk of the sacred mountain becomes as impassive as stone, making a vow of silence in exchange for greater abilities. The monk gains a +2 insight bonus to AC and CMD and a +4 bonus on Sense Motive, Stealth, and Perception checks." special="The monk does not lose the capacity for speech, but if he ever speaks, he loses this feature for 24 hours." replace="Tongue of the sun and the moon"}

name: Qinggong Monk
sourceBook: Advanced Race Guide, Martial Arts Handbook, Ultimate Magic

features.name: Ki Power
features.replaces: The monk class abilities the qinggong monk gives up for a ki power.

description: ## Qinggong Monk ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/51;Martial Arts Handbook/21;Advanced Race Guide/149› The qinggong monk is a master of her ki, using it to perform superhuman stunts or even blast opponents with supernatural energy. Some achieve their power over ki through extreme discipline, while others attain this power by intentionally or accidentally ingesting rare herbs or strange mystical fruits, and a few are gifted these abilities by a dying qinggong master. ::ab[Ki Power]{icon=power clear head ability="A qinggong monk can select a ki power (see below) for which she qualifies in place of the following monk class abilities." imp4="Slow fall" imp5="High jump" imp7="Wholeness of body" imp11="Diamond body" imp12="Abundant step" imp13="Diamond soul" imp15="Quivering palm" imp17="Timeless body; Tongue of the sun and moon" imp19="Empty body" imp20="Perfect self" replace="The monk class abilities the qinggong monk gives up for a ki power." special="Ki powers are abilities that draw on the power of a monk's ki. The standard monk has several abilities that count as ki powers, such as *wholeness of body, abundant step,* and *empty body.* A qinggong monk can learn additional ki powers, which often replaces a non-ki monk ability such as *purity of body.* Ki powers are divided into three categories: **feats, monk abilities,** and **spells.**"} ::ab[Feats]{sub icon=power info="These ki powers duplicate the effects of specific feats. A monk does not need to qualify for a feat to select it as a ki power. For example, a qinggong monk can select Spring Attack as a ki power even if she doesn't meet the prerequisites for selecting Spring Attack as a feat. Activating one of these ki powers is a @HLfree_action on the monk's turn; until the start of her next turn, the monk is treated as if she had that feat. Some of these ki powers that duplicate feats may also be activated as an @HLimmediate_action; these powers are noted in the ki powers list."} ::ab[Monk Abilities]{sub icon=power info="Some ki powers are standard monk abilities. Even if a qinggong monk selects a different ki power in place of a standard monk ability, she can select that monk ability later as one of her ki powers."} ::ab[Spells]{sub icon=magic info="These ki powers duplicate the effects of a spell, and are spell-like abilities. A qinggong monk's class level is the caster level for these spell-like abilities, and she uses Wisdom to determine her ‹rule/concentration› check bonus."} :::ab{title="List of Ki Powers" action=Ability icon=info} All ki powers have a minimum monk level requirement to select them. A monk who does not meet this requirement cannot select that ki power. Most ki powers require the monk to spend ki points; the exact amount is listed after the ki power. Ki powers that cost 0 ki do not require the monk to have any ki points in her *ki pool* to use the ability. description: ## Sage Counselor ‹SOURCE Ultimate Intrigue/67› Sage counselors are ascetics and mystics who leave the confines of the monastery walls to advise secular people about spiritual truths and to seek knowledge of the outside world. They often find work as mentors teaching religion and martial arts, and some of them even become counselors for people in high places. Sage counselors often speak in metaphors, knowing that indirect persuasion is more effective than speaking plainly, and they use indirect tactics in combat as well. ::cskill{gain=bluff~diplo~kno lose=climb~ea~per} ::ab[Cunning Fist (Ex)]{icon=power ability="A sage counselor gains ‹feat/Combat Expertise› as a bonus feat, and he can ignore the Intelligence prerequisite on feats that have Combat Expertise as a prerequisite." imp2="He gains ‹feat/Improved Feint›." imp6="He gains ‹feat/Greater Feint›." special="He doesn't need to meet the prerequisites of these bonus feats." replace="Bonus feats gained at 1st, 2nd, and 6th levels"} ::ab[Feinting Flurry]{l=4 icon=power-down swift="A sage counselor can spend 1 ki point while performing a *flurry of blows* to ‹skill/feint› an opponent, but he can't spend 1 ki point to make an additional attack when making a *flurry of blows.*" imp10="He can also choose to replace his first attack during a *flurry of blows* with a feint check." alter="Flurry of blows~ki pool" replace="The ability to spend ki to make an additional attack with a *flurry of blows*~bonus feat gained at 10th level"} ::ab[Deceptive Ki (Su)]{l=4 icon=boost swift="The sage counselor can spend 1 point from his *ki pool* to give himself a +4 insight bonus on his next Bluff check." replace="The ability to spend ki to increase his speed by 20 feet for 1 round" alter="Ki pool"}

name: Sensei

features.name: Mystic Wisdom (Su)
features.replaces: Bonus feats gained at 6th, 10th, and 14th level

description: ## Sensei ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/60› The sensei is a revered teacher who imparts lessons on the oneness of mind, body, and spirit, along with occasional correction that is subtle and swift. name: Sohei

features.replaces: Purity of body~diamond body~quivering palm~timeless body~tongue of sun and moon

description: ## Sohei ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/60› The sohei are masters of the horse and the hunt. A monastic soldier, the sohei is equally adept at combat afoot or on horseback. Your previously selected group's bonus increases to +2." imp18="You select a new weapon group and gain the +1 bonus when using weapons from that group. name: Tetori

features.replaces: Abundant step~improved evasion~timeless body~tongue of sun and moon

features.replaces: Bonus feats gained at 2nd, 6th, 10th, 14th, and 18th levels

name: Weapon Adept
description: ## Weapon Adept ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/114› While all monks train in both unarmed combat and with weapons, the weapon adept seeks to become one with his weapons, transforming them into perfect extensions of his own body. name: Dual-Cursed Oracle

sourceBook: Ultimate Wilderness, People of the Sands

features.name: Bonus Spells

description: ## Elementalist Oracle ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/68;People of the Sands/15› An elementalist oracle shares an affinity with the elements and elemental creatures. She can communicate with elemental creatures and can eventually become an elemental herself. She sees perfection in manifestations of elemental fury in the natural world, be they the thunderous wrath of the storm, the churning waters of the ocean's tides or a flooding river, the terrain-shaping power of a landslide or earthquake, or the apocalyptic fury of a volcanic eruption. @HL[Recommended Mysteries:] ‹mystery/Flame›, ‹mystery/stone›, ‹mystery/waves›, ‹mystery/wind›. ::ab[Bonus Spells]{icon=learn info="The oracle gains these bonus spells at the listed levels." replace="The bonus spells gained at 4th, 6th, 8th, 10th, 12th and 18th levels from the oracle's mystery" s4="Elemental touch" s6="Protection from energy" s8="Elemental body I" s10="Summon monster V|(elementals only)" s12="Elemental body III" s18="Elemental swarm"} ::ab[Revelations]{head icon=info info="An elementalist oracle must take the following revelations at the listed levels."} ::ab[Elemental Linguist (Su)]{next l=1 icon=power ability="You gain a bonus language of your choice from the following list: Aquan, Auran, Ignan, or Terran." repeatAt="You gain another language chosen from this list.~5~10~15"} :::ab{title="Elemental Form (Su)" action=Ability next l=11 icon=power} You gain the ‹subtype/air›, ‹subtype/earth›, ‹subtype/fire›, or ‹subtype/water› subtype and an associated ability: - @HL[Air:] Fly speed of 30 feet with perfect maneuverability. - @HL[Earth:] ‹umr/Tremorsense› with a range of 30 feet. - @HL[Fire:] Immunity to fire and vulnerability to cold. - @HL[Water:] Swim speed of 30 feet and the ability to breathe underwater. ::: ::ab[Elemental Revelation (Su)]{next l=20 icon=magic-lower ability="You fully harness the power of the elements. You can apply the ‹feat/Elemental Spell› metamagic feat to spells you cast without increasing the level or casting time. You can choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire each time you use this ability." order=ap passive="Whenever you score a critical hit with an attack that deals energy damage, you ignore the target's energy resistance (if any). If you score such a critical hit against a creature that has immunity to the energy type you are attacking with, the creature takes half damage from the attack." replace="Final revelation"}

description: ## Enlightened Philosopher ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/58› The enlightened philosopher seeks enlightenment through compassion, moderation, and humility. By following her philosophy's teachings, the enlightened philosopher seeks to reach enlightenment and become one with the universe. ::prereq{other="Alignment must be lawful"} @HL[Recommended Mysteries:] ‹mystery/ancestor›, ‹mystery/flame›, ‹mystery/heavens›, ‹mystery/lore›, ‹mystery/metal›, ‹mystery/nature›, ‹mystery/stone›, ‹mystery/time›, ‹mystery/waves›, ‹mystery/wood›. ::cskill{gain=ka~kd~ke~kg~kl~kna~kno~ling noAlter preTitle=Replaces pre="Bonus skills from the oracle's mystery" preHL} ::ab[Bonus Spells]{icon=learn info="The oracle gains these bonus spells at the listed levels." replace="All bonus spells gained from the oracle's mystery after 2nd level" s4="Owl's wisdom" s6="Water walk" s8="Discern lies" s10="True seeing" s12="Wind walk" s14="Ethereal jaunt" s16="Moment of prescience" s18="Astral projection"} ::ab[Revelations]{head l7="An enlightened philosopher must take the following revelation." icon=power} ::ab[Mental Acuity (Ex)]{next icon=boost order=np info="This is the same as the ‹mystery/lore› mystery revelation of the same name." flavor="Your explorations into the secret mysteries of the world have granted you a preternatural understanding of all things - and you just keep getting smarter." passive="You gain a +1 inherent bonus to Intelligence upon taking this revelation." increment="The bonus to Intelligence~7~3"} ::ab[Final Revelation]{l=20 order=pa flavor="You achieve true enlightenment and become one with the universe." icon=def-power-magic passive="You receive a bonus on all saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier. You become immune to confusion, exhaustion, fatigue, nausea, and sickened effects." ability="You can take 20 on all Knowledge skill checks." special="Should you die, you are reborn 3 days later as a living example of the summoning of your chosen philosophy (treat as the ‹spell/reincarnate› spell)." replace="Final revelation"}

She is at home on the multiple planes of the Great Beyond, and can eventually become an outsider herself. @HL[Recommended Mysteries:] ‹mystery/dark tapestry›, ‹mystery/flame›, ‹mystery/heavens›, ‹mystery/stone›, ‹mystery/waves›, ‹mystery/wind›. ::ab[Bonus Spells]{icon=learn info="The oracle gains these bonus spells at the listed levels." replace="All bonus spells from the oracle's mystery" s2="Endure elements" s4="Elemental speech" s6=Tongues s8="Planar adaptation" s10="Plane shift" s12="Mass planar adaptation" s14="Shadow walk" s16=Etherealness s18=Gate} ::ab[Revelations]{head icon=info l1="You must choose one Outer Plane with which you have an affinity. name: River Soul

features.name: Bonus Spells
features.replaces: The bonus spells gained at 2nd, 6th, 8th, 10th, and 18th levels from the oracle's mystery

description: ## River Soul ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/68› River soul oracles derive their powers from their bonds with rivers, whether these waterways are rapid cascades or lazy channels plied by boats. The powerful bond formed with a river is also the river soul oracle's curse, as he must always carry water from the river with him, and his fate is bound to it. River soul oracles can be gentle and still when calm, but they're raging torrents when angered. ::cskill{gain=ea~kna~sur~swim noAlter preTitle=Replaces pre="Bonus skills from the oracle's mystery" preHL} @HL[Recommended Mysteries:] ‹mystery/Life›, ‹mystery/nature›, ‹mystery/stone›, ‹mystery/waves›. ::ab[Bonus Spells]{icon=learn info="The oracle gains these bonus spells at the listed levels." replace="The bonus spells gained at 2nd, 6th, 8th, 10th, and 18th levels from the oracle's mystery" s2="Hydraulic push" s6="Hydraulic torrent" s8="Control water" s10="Cone of cold" s18="World wave"} ::ab[River Bound Curse (Su)]{icon=info-warning order=na info="You bind your power to one particular river, which is the source of your spells and class abilities. You must carry a small vessel containing water from the river you are bound to at all times. If the vessel is destroyed or travels more than 10 feet away from you, you are unable to cast oracle spells or use your supernatural or spell-like class abilities until you recover the vessel or fill a new one with water from the river to which you are bound." ability="Once per month, you can bond with a different river in a ceremony at that river that takes 12 hours to complete. You lose your bond with the previous river in the process." replace="Oracle's curse"} ::ab[Revelations]{head icon=info info="A river soul oracle must take the following revelations at the listed levels." replace="Revelations gained at 1st and 11th levels"} ::ab[River Flow (Su)]{next l=1 icon=boost free="While you are underwater, you can negate the ‹rule/penalties you take»<underwater_combat› for making bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing melee attacks underwater." useMod=Charisma1 useM=1 useNC} ::ab[River Form (Su)]{next l=11 icon=magic flavor="You can become one with a river." standard="Once a day, while immersed in a river, you can completely merge with it. Your body and all your gear meld into the water, as per ‹spell/meld into stone›, except abilities that control or shape water expel you and deal you 5d6 damage rather than abilities that control or shape stone. You travel along with the river at the rate it is currently moving." useMod=Charisma3 useUnit=hour special="Transforming back to your normal form is a @HLswift_action."} ::ab[River Soul Revelation (Su)]{l=20 icon=def-magic flavor="You strengthen your ties to the river with which you bonded." passive="While traveling on or immersed in the river, you gain ‹umr/fast healing› 10 and immunity to bleed, death attacks, exhaustion, fatigue, nausea effects, negative levels, and sickened effects." special="If you are slain and your body or some part of your body (including your ashes, if applicable) is floated down the river in a specially prepared vessel costing 5,000 gp, you return to life as per ‹spell/resurrection› once you reach the mouth of the river, as long as the trip has taken 24 hours or longer." replace="Final revelation"}

name: Seer

features.name: Bonus Spells
features.replaces: Bonus spells granted by the oracle's mystery after 2nd level

description: ## Seer ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/59› While all oracles possess some ability at divination, the seer is a true prophet, able to see things as they really are, or will be. @HL[Recommended Mysteries:] ‹mystery/lore›, ‹mystery/nature›, ‹mystery/time›. ::ab[Bonus Spells]{icon=learn info="The oracle gains these bonus spells at the listed levels." replace="Bonus spells granted by the oracle's mystery after 2nd level" s4="Detect thoughts" s6="Clairaudience/clairvoyance" s8=Scrying s10="True seeing" s12="Legend lore" s14="Greater scrying" s16=Vision s18=Foresight} ::ab[Revelations]{head icon=info info="A seer must take the following revelations at the listed levels."} ::ab[Natural Divination (Ex)]{next l=1 info="This is the same as the ‹mystery/nature› mystery revelation of the same name." icon=def-boost ability="You can read the entrails of a freshly killed animal or humanoid to gain an insight bonus equal to your Charisma modifier on one saving throw." ability2="Alternatively, by observing and interpreting the flights of birds, you may apply a +10 competence bonus on any one skill check." ability3="Finally, by charting marks in dirt or stone, or observing the behavior of sand when thrown into the wind, you gain a +4 insight bonus on one initiative check." special="These bonuses must be used during the next 24 hours and you must declare you are using the bonus before the check or save is made." usage="Making a natural divination takes 10 minutes. You may use natural divination (in any combination) once per day plus a number of additional times per day equal to ‹misc/one-fourth› of your oracle level." order=na23u} ::ab[Gift of Prophecy (Su)]{next l=3 icon=magic ability="Once per day, you can enter a trance to gain a glimpse of the future. This trance lasts for 1 minute, which must be uninterrupted and during which you can take no other actions. You gain the benefits of an ‹spell/augury› spell with 90% effectiveness." imp5="You gain the benefits of a ‹spell/divination› spell with 90% effectiveness." imp9="The knowledge you gain is equivalent to a ‹spell/commune› spell." special="None of these spell effects require material components."}

name: Stargazer

features.name: Bonus Spells
features.replaces: The bonus spells gained at 2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th, and 18th levels from the oracle's mystery

description: ## Stargazer ‹SOURCE Ultimate Magic/59› Some oracles seek meaning in the pattern of the stars across the night sky, the trails of comets, and the eternal orbits of the planets. @HL[Recommended Mysteries:] ‹mystery/dark tapestry›, ‹mystery/heavens›, ‹mystery/lore›, ‹mystery/nature›, ‹mystery/time›. ::cskill{gain=kna~perf~sur noAlter preTitle=Replaces pre="Bonus skills from the oracle's mystery" preHL} ::ab[Bonus Spells]{icon=learn info="The oracle gains these bonus spells at the listed levels." replace="The bonus spells gained at 2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th, and 18th levels from the oracle's mystery" s2="Faerie fire" s4=Glitterdust s6="Guiding star" s8="Wandering star motes" s18="Meteor swarm"} ::ab[Revelations]{head icon=info info="A stargazer must take the following revelations at the listed levels."} ::ab[Guiding Star (Su)]{next order=nap2 icon=power-boost l=1 info="This is the same as the ‹mystery/heavens› mystery revelation of the same name." ability="Whenever you can see the open sky at night, you can determine your precise location." passive="When the night sky is visible to you, you may also add your Charisma modifier to your Wisdom modifier on all Wisdom-based checks." ability2="Once per night while outdoors, you can cast one spell as if it were modified by the ‹feat/Empower Spell›, ‹feat/Extend Spell›, ‹feat/Silent Spell›, or ‹feat/Still Spell› feat without increasing the spell's casting time or level."} ::ab[Star Chart (Ex)]{next order=na l=7 icon=magic info="This is the same as the *heavens* mystery revelation of the same name." ability="Your copious notes contain a working model of the night sky expressed in artistic scribbles and arcane mathematical formulae. Once per day, you may spend 10 minutes contemplating your star chart to gain the benefit of the spell ‹spell/commune›."}

name: Tree Soul

features.name: Bonus Spells
features.replaces: The bonus spells gained at 2nd, 10th, 12th, 14th, 16th, and 18th levels from the oracle's mystery

description: ## Tree Soul ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/69› Tree souls develop an affinity not just with trees but also with objects carved from them, feeling the essence of the tree's spirit living within. By bonding to trees, they learn to manipulate the trees' power to produce divine energy. The type of tree a tree soul oracle bonds to often seems to influence the oracle's personality. A tree soul who is bound to a towering redwood may value traditions and be slow to anger, while a tree soul bound to a smaller pine tree might be quick to react and have a somewhat prickly personality. Regardless of the trees they form their metaphysical attachment to, tree soul oracles tend to be steadfast and stubborn, having an aura of timelessness even as the world changes around them. ::cskill{gain=acro~climb~kna~sur noAlter preTitle=Replaces pre="Bonus skills from the oracle's mystery" preHL} ::ab[Weapon and Armor Proficiency]{icon=down-warning ability="Tree souls are proficient with light and medium armor but are prohibited from wearing metal armor. A tree soul can also wear wooden armor that has been altered by the ‹spell/ironwood› spell so that it functions as though it were steel. Tree souls are proficient with shields (except tower shields) but can use only those crafted from wood." order=an info="A tree soul who wears prohibited armor or uses a prohibited shield is unable to cast oracle spells or use any of her supernatural or spell-like class abilities while doing so and for 24 hours thereafter."} @HL[Recommended Mysteries:] ‹mystery/Ancestor›, ‹mystery/lore›, ‹mystery/nature›, ‹mystery/wood›. ::ab[Bonus Spells]{icon=learn info="The oracle gains these bonus spells at the listed levels." replace="The bonus spells gained at 2nd, 10th, 12th, 14th, 16th, and 18th levels from the oracle's mystery" s2="Warp wood" s10="Tree stride" s12=Ironwood s14=Changestaff s16="Repel metal or stone" s18="Greater siege of trees"} ::ab[Tree Bound Curse (Su)]{icon=down ability="You bind your power to a specific tree. Any damage to the tree deals the same amount of damage to you, overcoming DR, energy resistance, and immunities. Damage you take in this way cannot be healed by normal or magical means until your bonded tree is healed or destroyed. The damage can reduce you to 0 hit points but not below. If the tree is destroyed, you are considered to be ‹misc/staggered› and are unable to cast oracle spells or use supernatural or spell-like class abilities until you bond with a new tree in a ceremony that takes 12 hours to complete." special="Once per month, you can create a new bond with a different tree in a ceremony at that tree that takes 12 hours to complete. You lose your bond with your previous tree in the process." replace="Oracle's curse"} ::ab[Revelations]{head icon=info info="A tree soul oracle must take the following revelations at the listed levels."} ::ab[Transform Wood (Su)]{next l=1 icon=magic standard="You can temporarily transform a number of 5-foot cubes of wood each day equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier. The wood takes on the quality of ‹eq-material/darkwood› for 1 minute per oracle level." imp11="You can have it instead take on the quality of ‹eq-material/living steel› for the same duration."} ::ab[Living Steel Dolls (Ex)]{next l=11 icon=learn-boost ability="You add ‹spell/animate objects› to your list of spells known. When you cast this spell on wooden objects, the objects' wooden parts immediately transform into living steel. If the objects are destroyed or the duration ends, the wooden parts revert back to their original material."} ::ab[Tree Soul Revelation (Su)]{next l=20 icon=def-magic order=ps passive="Your skin takes on the appearance and properties of a tree trunk. This bark-like skin grants you a +4 natural armor bonus to your Armor Class and DR 10/slashing. You also regrow any severed limbs except your head within 24 hours as per ‹spell/regenerate›." standard="Once a day, you can assume the form of a ‹monster/treant›, as per ‹spell/plant shape III›, for a number of minutes equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier (minimum 1)." replace="Final revelation"}

name: Divine Defender
description: ## Divine Defender ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/116› Some paladins see themselves as the last line of defense between the teeming hordes of evil and the innocent folk trying to make a living in a harsh, unforgiving world. These defenders spend their lives protecting others and taking on foes that the common man should not even know exist. To aid them in their holy mission, they have special powers to protect themselves and those around them. The divine defender has the following class features. ::ab[Shared Defense (Su)]{l=3 icon=protect standard="A divine defender can spend one use of her *lay on hands* ability to grant all adjacent allies (including paladins) a bonus. Adjacent allies receive a +1 sacred bonus to their AC and CMD and on their saving throws. These bonuses last for a number of rounds equal to the divine defender's Charisma modifier." increment="The bonus~3~6" imp6="These bonuses are granted to all allies within 10 feet, and allies that are at fewer than 0 hit points within this area are automatically stabilized." imp12="These bonuses are granted to all allies within 15 feet, and allies within this area are immune to ‹umr/bleed› damage." imp18="These bonuses are granted to all allies within 20 feet, and allies within this area gain a 25% chance to negate any sneak attack or critical hit scored against them. This ability does not stack with the chance provided from the light, medium, or heavy fortification armor special abilities." special="These bonuses are cumulative with each other. Allies only benefit from these bonuses while in the listed area." replace=Mercy} ::ab[Divine Bond (Su)]{l=5 icon=def-warning flavor="Instead of forming a *divine bond* with her weapon or a mount, a divine defender can form a bond with her armor." standard="A divine defender can enhance her armor by calling upon the aid of a celestial spirit. This bond lasts for 1 minute per paladin level. When called, the spirit causes the armor to shed light like a ‹eq-misc/torch›. The spirit grants the armor a +1 enhancement bonus." incrementOrd="The armor gains~5~3" incrementDesc=a incrementEnd=" +1 enhancement bonus." imp8="These bonuses can be added to the armor, stacking with existing armor bonuses to a maximum of +3, or they can be used to add any of the following armor properties: ‹magic-enh/champion›, ‹magic-enh/ghost touch<_a›, ‹magic-enh/heavy fortification›, ‹magic-enh/invulnerability›, ‹magic-enh/light fortification›, ‹magic-enh/moderate fortification›, ‹magic-enh/spell resistance› (13, 15, 17, or 19). Adding these properties consumes an amount of bonus equal to the property's cost. If the armor is not magical, at least a +1 enhancement bonus must be added before any other properties can be added." imp11="In addition, the bonuses can be consumed at the listed amount to add any of the following armor properties: ‹magic-enh/energy resistance› for +3 bonus, ‹magic-enh/improved energy resistance› for +5 bonus, or ‹magic-enh/righteous› for +4 bonus." special="These bonuses are added to any properties the armor already has, but duplicate abilities do not stack. The bonus and properties granted by the spirit are determined when the spirit is called and cannot be changed until the spirit is called again. The celestial spirit imparts no bonuses if the armor is worn by anyone other than the divine defender, but it resumes giving bonuses if the divine defender dons the armor again. If a suit of armor with a celestial spirit is destroyed, the divine defender loses the use of this ability for 30 days, or until she gains a level, whichever comes first. During this 30-day period, the divine defender takes a -1 penalty on attack and weapon damage rolls." useInc=paladin~3~5 useF="5~1~3"}

name: Divine Hunter
description: ## Divine Hunter ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/62› Most paladins rush into battle, meeting evil toe-to-toe. The divine hunter prefers to engage evil from afar, striking down her foes before they can threaten her allies. ::ab[Precise Shot]{icon=power l1="A divine hunter gains ‹feat/Precise Shot› as a bonus feat, even if she doesn't meet the prerequisites." replace="Heavy Armor Proficiency"} ::ab[Shared Precision (Su)]{l=3 icon=boost ability="When a divine hunter hits a creature with a ranged attack, she grants her allies within 10 feet of her the benefit of the Precise Shot feat against that target until the start of her next turn. Her allies must remain within 10 feet of her, and must be able both to see and hear the divine hunter to gain this benefit." replace="Aura of courage"} ::ab[Divine Bond (Su)]{l=5 icon=boost ability="A divine hunter forms a bond with her deity. This functions as the paladin's *divine bond* ability, except the bond must always take the form of a ranged or throwing weapon (excluding ammunition).
