In addition to the listed abilities, a divine hunter can add the ‹magic-enh/distance›, ‹magic-enh/returning›, or ‹magic-enh/seeking› special abilities to her weapon, but she cannot add the *defending* or *disruption* special abilities." special="Special abilities added to throwing weapons function normally when the weapon is used in melee." replace="Divine bond"} ::ab[Distant Mercy (Sp)]{l=6 icon=aid ability="A divine hunter can expend two uses of her *lay on hands* abilities to use her *lay on hands* ability on a target within 5 feet per paladin level. *Distant mercy* has no effect on creatures harmed by positive energy, such as undead." replace="6th-level mercy"} ::ab[Aura of Care (Su)]{l=8 icon=boost passive="A divine hunter and her allies gain a preternatural awareness of each other's position in battle. She and any allies within 10 feet of her no longer provide ‹rule/cover› against each other's ranged attacks unless they wish to. Allies who cannot move or otherwise take actions still provide cover, as do ‹rule/flat-footed› allies. The divine hunter and her allies must be able to see or hear each other to use this ability." replace="Aura of resolve"} ::ab[Hunter's Blessing (Su)]{l=11 icon=power swift="A divine hunter can expend a use of her *smite evil* ability to grant herself and all allies within 10 feet the ‹feat/Deadly Aim›, Precise Shot, and ‹feat/Improved Precise Shot› feats, even if they lack the prerequisites. The effects last for 1 minute." special="Evil creatures gain no benefit from this ability." replace="Aura of justice"} ::ab[Righteous Hunter (Su)]{l=14 icon=lower passive="A divine hunter's ranged weapons are treated as good-aligned for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction. Any ranged attacks made by an ally within 10 feet of her are likewise treated as good-aligned for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction." special="This ability functions only while the divine hunter is conscious." replace="Aura of righteousness"}

name: Empyreal Knight
description: ## Empyreal Knight ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/62› The empyreal knight dedicates her life to serving the celestial beings that guide mortals in their struggle toward the light. ::ab[Voices of the Spheres]{l=2 icon=power ability="An empyreal knight learns to speak and read Celestial, if she could not already." replace="Divine grace"} ::ab[Celestial Heart (Su)]{icon=def-power-protect flavor="As an empyreal knight advances, her ties with the celestial realms grant her a portion of the abilities and defenses of true ‹family/angel«s›." l3="She gains resistance 5 against acid, cold, and electricity." l6="She gains a +4 racial bonus on saves against poison." l9="Her defenses improve to resistance 10 against acid, cold, and electricity." l12="She gains immunity to petrification." l15="She gains *truespeech,* the ability to speak with any creature that has a language as though using a ‹spell/tongues› spell. This ability functions with a caster level equal to her character level, and is always active." l18="As a @HLswift_action, the empyreal knight can manifest a protective aura against evil. Against abilities or effects created by evil creatures, this ability provides a +4 deflection bonus to AC and a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws to anyone within 20 feet of her. It otherwise functions as a ‹spell/magic circle against evil›. She can use this ability for a maximum of 1 round per day per paladin level. These rounds do not need to be consecutive." replace=Mercy} ::ab[Celestial Ally (Sp)]{l=4 icon=magic fullround="An empyreal knight can summon a celestial ally. This functions as ‹spell/summon monster I›, except it can only be used to summon ‹template/celestial› creatures, ‹family/archon«s›, and angels." incrementRoman="This improves to ‹spell/summon~4~2" incrementDesc=monster incrementEnd="›." usage="A number of times per day equal to the empyreal knight's Charisma modifier (minimum 1), but only one ally can be summoned at a time." replace="Lay on hands~channel positive energy"} ::ab[Divine Bond (Su)]{icon=power l5="An empyreal knight forms a bond with a mount, as the standard paladin ability." l8="Her mount gains the *celestial* template." l12="Her mount sprouts wings if it cannot already fly, and gains a fly speed of twice its land speed and good maneuverability. If the mount could already fly, its fly speed and maneuverability improve to at least this level." special="This ability otherwise functions as the paladin ability of the same name." alter="Divine bond"} ::ab[Empyreal Champion]{l=20 icon=def-power passive="An empyreal knight transcends her mortal self. Her DR increases to 10/evil. Her type is treated as ‹type/outsider› for the purposes of spells and magical effects. She gains darkvision 60 feet and low-light vision." standard="As a supernatural ability, she can sprout wings that allow her to fly at twice her land speed with average maneuverability. Any armor or clothing reshapes to allow her to fly when she uses this ability. She can retract the wings as a @HLfree_action." special="Unlike other outsiders, an empyreal knight can still be brought back from the dead as if she were a member of her previous creature type." order=ps replace="Holy champion"}

name: Forest Preserver
description: ## Forest Preserver ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/70› Forest preservers are sacred defenders of the woodlands and of the wild creatures and natural beauty within them. ::cskill{gain=climb~kna~sur lose=diplo~kno~sm} ::ab[Favored Terrain (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost ability="A forest preserver gains the ranger's ‹ability/favored terrain› ability but must select either forest or jungle as her favored terrain." info="Text from the ability: *The ranger gains a +2 bonus on initiative checks and Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival skill checks when he is in this terrain. A ranger traveling through his favored terrain normally leaves no trail and cannot be tracked (though he may leave a trail if he so chooses).*" order=an increment="The bonuses granted by this ability~3~5~4~2" special="She does not gain additional favored terrains." replace="Aura of courage"} ::ab[Woodland Stride (Ex)]{l=3 icon=power ability="A forest preserver (as well as her *divine bond* creature, if she has one) gains ‹ability/woodland stride›, as per the druid class feature." replace="Divine health"} ::ab[Sacred Botany (Ex)]{l=4 icon=learn info="A forest preserver adds the following spells to her spell list at the listed spell level." s1="Detect animals or plants~entangle~goodberry~shillelagh" s2="Barkskin~eagle eye~tree shape~warp wood~wood shape" s3="Diminish plants~plant growth~snare~speak with plants~spike growth" s4="Antiplant shell~awaken|(trees only)~blight~command plants~commune with nature~thorn body~tree stride~wall of thorns" special="In addition, she treats her caster level as 1 higher when casting these spells in her favored terrain." replace="Channel positive energy"} ::ab[Fireproof Aura (Su)]{l=8 icon=def-protect order=pi passive="A forest preserver and creatures within 10 feet of her gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against fire effects and gain fire resistance 5; these are doubled for plant allies, which also gain ‹ability/evasion› against fire effects only." immediate="Whenever a fire spell would affect a creature within the *fireproof aura,* the forest preserver can expend three uses of her *lay on hands* ability to attempt to counter the effect, as if she had readied a ‹spell/dispel magic› spell (caster level = her paladin level) to counterspell." special="This ability functions only if the forest preserver is conscious." replace="Aura of resolve"} ::ab[Sacred Grove (Su)]{l=11 icon=magic ability="A forest preserver can expend two uses of her *smite evil* ability to consecrate a 20-foot-radius area that must contain a living tree. This fills the area with dense undergrowth, though it does not impede her allies' movement. In addition, animals, fey, and plants allied with the forest preserver gain a +1 sacred bonus on attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throws, and animals, fey, and plants called or summoned within this area gain 1 hit point per Hit Die as long as the calling or summoning effect lasts or until the *sacred grove* effect ends (whichever comes first). If the area contains a shrine or hallowed area dedicated to a good-aligned deity (or at the GM's discretion, a place of natural magical power, such as a natural portal to the First World), these bonuses are doubled." ability2="When she uses this ability in her favored terrain, she can also imbue plants in the area with limited animation, allowing them to obscure vision and impede movement and attacks as if the area were affected by ‹spell/solid fog›." order=a2 special="A *sacred grove* remains enhanced in this way for a number of minutes equal to the paladin's level." replace="Aura of justice"} ::ab[Aura of Preservation (Su)]{l=14 icon=protect passive="A forest preserver grants animals and plants within 10 feet spell resistance equal to 11 + her paladin level. This spell resistance doesn't apply against harmless effects created by the forest preserver or allies within 10 feet of her. This ability functions only if the forest preserver is conscious." replace="Aura of faith"}

name: Gray Paladin

features.name: Code of Conduct
features.replaces: Code of conduct and associated abilities

description: ## Gray Paladin ‹SOURCE Ultimate Intrigue/69› Gray paladins have discovered that in a world of intrigue, a strict code of honor hinders their options. Their divergence from the paladin's normal code still drains them, but somehow, they have found a way to avoid losing all of their powers. ::ab[Alignment]{icon=info info="A gray paladin can be lawful good, lawful neutral, or neutral good, though she must still follow a lawful good, neutral good, or lawful neutral deity." alter="Alignment restrictions"} ::cskill{gain=bluff~dis~intm} ::ab[Weakened Grace]{icon=down-info flavor="A gray paladin's loosened code weakens her connection to the power that grants her paladin abilities." imp2="She gains her first use of *smite evil* at 2nd level, instead of 1st." info="She never gains the *aura of good* or *divine grace* class features. Her *aura of courage* does not make her immune to fear, her *aura of resolve* does not make her immune to charms, and her *aura of righteousness* does not make her immune to compulsions." incrementOrd="She gains~1~3" incrementDesc=her incrementEnd=" use of *smite evil* per day." alter="Smite evil~aura of courage~aura of resolve~aura of righteousness" replace="Aura of good~divine grace"} ::ab[Code of Conduct]{icon=warning info="A gray paladin must be of lawful good, lawful neutral, or neutral good alignment and loses all class features except proficiencies if she ever willingly commits an evil act (for example, casting a spell with the evil descriptor). She should strive to act with honor and uphold the tenets of her faith, but failing to do so is not a violation of her code, and other than evil actions, she can do whatever else she feels is necessary to uphold the causes of law and good." replace="Code of conduct and associated abilities" alter=Ex-paladin} ::ab[Enhanced Health (Ex)]{l=3 icon=def passive="A gray paladin is far less a stranger to poisons than a normal paladin. She gains a +4 sacred bonus on all saving throws against poisons and diseases." replace="Divine health"} ::ab[Smite Foe (Su)]{l=4 icon=power ability="A gray paladin can spend two uses of *smite evil* in order to smite a nongood creature that is not evil and gain her full benefits. The gray paladin must truly believe that the creature she smites is an opponent to the cause of good. Even if this nonevil foe is an outsider, undead, or dragon, she doesn't add increased damage to her first attack." replace="Channel positive energy" alter="Smite evil"} ::ab[Aura of Subtlety (Sp, Su)]{l=11 icon=def-protect passive="A gray paladin learns how to protect herself from detection. She and her allies within 10 feet gain a +4 morale bonus on saving throws against divination effects. Furthermore, casters of divinations that target the gray paladin or her nearby allies must succeed at a caster level check as though the gray paladin and her nearby allies were under the effect of a ‹spell/nondetection› spell cast by the gray paladin, with a caster level equal to the gray paladin's paladin level." special="This ability functions while the gray paladin is conscious and while she is sleeping, but not if she is unconscious for any other reason, or dead." replace="Aura of justice"}

name: Holy Gun
description: ## Holy Gun ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/63› Not all paladins are knights in shining armor. Holy guns roam the world searching for evil. And where they find it, they put it down. ::ab[Weapon and Armor Proficiency]{icon=down-power info="Holy guns are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, ‹main/equipment_>firearms›, and light armor."} ::ab[Have Gun]{l=1 icon=power-ranged ability="The holy gun gains the ‹feat/Amateur Gunslinger› feat and ‹feat/Gunsmithing› as a bonus feat. She also gains a battered gun identical to the one gained by the ‹class/gunslinger›." replace="Detect evil"} ::ab[Divine Deed]{head l=2 icon=power ability="The holy gun gains the following deed. This deed works and interacts with grit the same way as ‹ability/gunslinger deeds›, but only the holy gun can use it. If the holy gun also has levels in gunslinger, she can spend grit points from that class to use this deed." replace="Smite evil"} ::ab[Smiting Shot (Su)]{next icon=ranged standard="A holy gun can spend 1 grit point to make a *smiting shot* with a firearm attack. If the target is evil, the holy gun adds her Charisma bonus and her paladin level to the damage of the firearm attack. If the target of the *smiting shot* is an outsider with the evil subtype, an evil-aligned dragon, or an undead creature, the bonus to damage increases to the Charisma modifier plus 2 points of damage per level the paladin possess. Regardless of the target, *smiting shot* automatically bypasses any DR the creature might have."} ::ab[Divine Bond]{l=5 icon=power ability="A holy gun forms a bond with her deity. This functions as the paladin's *divine bond* ability, except the bond must always take the form of a firearm. In addition to the listed abilities, a holy gun can add the ‹magic-enh/distance›, ‹magic-enh/reliable›, or ‹magic-enh/seeking› special abilities to her weapon, but she cannot add the *defending* or *disruption* special abilities." replace="Divine bond"} ::ab[Holy Grit (Ex)]{l=11 icon=power ability="A holy gun gains a number of grit points equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 1) and gains the use of a single gunslinger deed. She can select any deed that a 7th-level gunslinger could use." incrementOrd="The holy gun gains another point of grit and another gunslinger deed that~11~3~10~3" incrementDesc=a incrementEnd="-level gunslinger could use." special="If she already has levels in gunslinger, she gains a bonus to the maximum amount of grit she can have each day, equal to her Charisma bonus (if any) but gains no extra grit as the start of each day."} ::ab[Holy Slinger (Ex)]{icon=info info="This ability function like the *holy champion* paladin class feature, but the banishment occurs when she hits an evil outsider with the *smiting shot* deed." alter="Holy champion"}

name: Holy Tactician
description: ## Holy Tactician ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/64› The holy tactician inspires her allies on the field of battle. Her place is at their side against overwhelming odds, and her guidance brings out their true potential. :::ab{icon=boost l=1 title="Weal's Champion (Su)" action="Swift Action" replace="Smite evil" special="She can grant this bonus against more than one creature at a time. To gain this benefit, the holy tactician's allies must be able to see or hear her, and she must be conscious." useInc=paladin~3~1 useF="1~1~3"} A holy tactician can call on the powers of good to aid her against evil. Against evil targets, the holy tactician gains her Charisma bonus (if any) on her attack rolls against evil creatures, and if she hits, she adds 1/2 her paladin level on her weapon damage rolls as well. These bonuses last for 1 round for every two paladin levels the holy tactician has attained (minimum 1 round). In addition, for 1 round after the holy tactician successfully strikes an evil creature, all non-evil allies within 30 feet of her gain a competence bonus on attack rolls equal to 1/2 her Charisma bonus against that creature as well as a competence bonus on damage rolls. The bonus on damage rolls is equal to 1 + ‹misc/one-fifth› of her paladin level. ::: ::ab[Tactical Acumen (Ex)]{l=3 icon=power ability="A holy tactician gains a ‹main/teamwork feat› as a bonus feat." special="She must meet the prerequisites for these feats." repeat="She gains an additional bonus teamwork feat.~7~4" replace="Divine health~divine bond"} ::ab[Battlefield Presence (Su)]{l=3 icon=power standard="A tactician can direct her allies in battle, granting each ally within 30 feet one teamwork feat she possesses as a bonus feat. All allies must receive the same feat, but do not need to meet the prerequisites of this bonus feat." special="This ability does not function if the paladin is ‹rule/flat-footed› or unconscious. Allies must be able to see and hear the holy tactician in order to gain this benefit." swift="She may change the bonus feat granted." order=sw replace="Aura of courage"} ::ab[Guide the Battle (Ex)]{l=8 icon=power move="The paladin can direct her allies into an advantageous position once per round. Each ally (if physically able to) can move 5 feet without expending an action. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. The allies must be able to see or hear the paladin in order to make this movement and cannot be flat-footed." imp15="Her allies can make this 5-foot move and ignore ‹rule/difficult terrain›." replace="Aura of resolve"} ::ab[Weal's Wrath (Su)]{l=11 icon=boost ability="A tactician can expend two uses of her *weal's champion* ability at once to enhance its effects. This functions as *weal's champion,* except the bonus she provides to her allies lasts until each creature she strikes is slain, her *weal's champion* ability expires, or the paladin herself is slain or knocked unconscious, whichever happens first." replace="Aura of justice"} ::ab[Masterful Presence (Su)]{l=20 icon=power-boost ability="A tactician gains the ability to grant a different bonus feat to each ally affected by her *battlefield presence.* In addition, all critical threats made by her and her allies against creatures affected by her *weal's champion* ability are automatically confirmed (no confirmation roll is needed)." replace="Holy champion"}

name: Hospitaler
description: ## Hospitaler ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/116› Paladins are known for their charity and for tending to the sick. The hospitaler takes to this calling above all others, spending much of her time healing the poor, and giving aid and succor to those in need. The hospitaler has the following class features. ::ab[Smite Evil (Su)]{icon=down info="This functions as the paladin ability, with the adjusted advancement stated below." order=nu useInc=paladin~6~1 useF="1~1~6" alter="Smite evil"} ::ab[Channel Positive Energy (Su)]{icon=aura l4="A hospitaler gains the ability to channel positive energy as a ‹class/cleric› equal to her paladin level - 3." special="Using this ability does not expend uses of *lay on hands,* as it does with other paladins." useMod=Charisma3 replace="Channel positive energy"} ::ab[Aura of Healing (Su)]{l=11 icon=aura-aid ability="A hospitaler can expend one use of her *channel positive energy* ability to emit a 30-foot aura of healing for a number of rounds equal to her paladin level. Allies in this aura (including the hospitaler) automatically ‹misc/stabilize› if below 0 hit points and are immune to ‹umr/bleed› damage." order=ap passive="Allies (including the paladin) that spend at least 1 full round inside the aura are healed an amount of damage equal to their total number of Hit Dice and may make a saving throw against any afflictions they are suffering from, such as a curse, disease, or poison. This saving throw only counts toward curing the affliction and does not impose any penalty on a failed save." special="Allies can only be healed once by a use of this ability and they can only attempt additional saving throws once per day, even if they are exposed to this aura multiple times." replace="Aura of justice"}

name: Hunting Paladin
description: ## Hunting Paladin ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/70› Hunting paladins are tenacious trackers and stealthy stalkers in pursuit of evildoers. ::cskill{gain=kna~per~stl~sur lose=diplo~heal~kno~spc} ::ab[Weapon and Armor Proficiency]{icon=down info="A hunting paladin is not proficient with heavy armor." alter="Armor proficiencies"} ::ab[Hunt Evil (Su)]{icon=boost-power-roll-def-warning ability="Once per day, a hunting paladin can designate a single evil creature within her sight or one that she has determined to be evil by declaring it the target of her hunt and following its tracks; this allows her to add her Charisma modifier as a bonus on Survival checks to follow that creature's tracks and on Perception and Stealth checks opposed by the target of her hunt. She can sense her target's presence and location, which lets her pinpoint her target's location when within 10 feet; if the target has ‹rule/concealment›, she can roll twice and use the better result on rolls to determine whether she misses due to the concealment. She gains ‹ability/uncanny dodge› as per the ‹class/barbarian› class feature against her target." special="If the hunting paladin targets a nonevil creature with *hunt evil,* the ability fails and it is wasted. This ability ends after 24 hours (unless she spends the next day's use of this ability to continue hunting the same target), after the hunting paladin or the target is killed or when she designates a new target for her hunt." replace="1st-level use of smite evil"} ::ab[Detect Evil (Su)]{icon=down-magic ability="A hunting paladin cannot use this ability as a move action. However, when a hunting paladin has successfully followed a creature's tracks for at least 1 minute, she can discern whether the tracked creature's alignment was evil, as if she had cast ‹spell/detect evil› in its presence and concentrated for 3 rounds." alter="Detect evil"} ::ab[Smite Evil (Su)]{icon=down l4="A hunting paladin gains this ability at 4th level, and it functions at her paladin level - 3. She can expend a daily use of *smite evil* to gain an additional daily use of *hunt evil.* She can use *smite evil* and *hunt evil* against the same target." alter="Smite evil"} ::ab[Spells]{icon=learn ability="For each level of spell she can cast, a hunting paladin can prepare and cast one spell per day from the ‹main/ranger spell« list› rather than the paladin spell list." alter=Spells} ::ab[Tireless Aura (Su)]{l=8 icon=def-protect passive="A hunting paladin becomes immune to ‹misc/fatigue› and sleep effects, and allies within 10 feet gain a +4 bonus on saving throws to avoid becoming fatigued or falling asleep." replace="Aura of resolve"}

name: Sacred Servant
description: ## Sacred Servant ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/117› Paladins as a general rule, venerate the gods of good and purity, but some take this a step further, dedicating themselves to a specific deity and furthering the cause of the faith. These sacred servants are rewarded for their devotion with additional spells and powerful allies. A sacred servant must select one deity to worship. This deity's alignment must be lawful good, lawful neutral, or neutral good. A sacred servant has the following class features. ::ab[Smite Evil (Su)]{icon=down info="This functions as the paladin ability, but the sacred servant has fewer uses of *smite evil* per day." order=nu replace="Smite evil" useInc=paladin~6~1 useF="1~1~6"} ::ab[Spells]{l=4 icon=learn-magic ability="When a sacred servant gains the ability to cast spells, she also chooses one ‹ability/domain<s› associated with her deity. Her effective ‹class/cleric› level for this domain is equal to her paladin level - 3. In addition, she also gains one domain spell slot for each level of paladin spells she can cast. Every day she must prepare the domain spell from her chosen domain in that spell slot."} :::ab{l=5 title="Divine Bond (Su)" icon=boost-warning flavor="Instead of forming a *divine bond* with her weapon or a mount, a sacred servant forms a bond with her holy symbol." action="Standard Action" alter="Divine bond" incrementMulti="The spirit grants ~ bonuses.~5/3;2/1~~A sacred servant can use this ability ~ times a day.~5/4;2/1" special="The celestial spirit imparts no enhancements if the holy symbol is held by anyone other than the sacred servant, but resumes giving enhancements if returned to the sacred servant.~~~If a holy symbol with a celestial spirit is destroyed, the sacred servant loses the use of this ability for 30 days, or until she gains a level, whichever comes first. During this 30-day period, the sacred servant takes a -1 penalty on attack and weapon damage rolls."} Once a day, a sacred servant can bind a celestial spirit to her holy symbol for 1 minute per paladin level. When called, the spirit causes the sacred servant's holy symbol to shed light like a ‹eq-misc/torch›. Starting out, the spirit grants one bonus. As the sacred servant gains levels, the spirit grants more bonuses. These bonuses can be spent in a number of ways to grant the paladin enhanced abilities to channel positive energy and to cast spells. Each bonus can be used to grant one of the following enhancements: - +1 caster level to any paladin spell cast - +1 to the DC to halve the damage of channel positive energy when used to harm undead - +1d6 to channel positive energy - +1 use/day of *lay on hands* These enhancements stack and can be selected multiple times. The enhancements granted by the spirit are determined when the spirit is called and cannot be changed until the spirit is called again. If the sacred servant increases her number of uses of *lay on hands* per day in this way, that choice is set for the rest of the day, and once used, these additional uses are not restored (even if the spirit is called again that day). ::: ::ab[Call Celestial Ally (Sp)]{icon=magic l8="A sacred servant can call upon her deity for aid, in the form of a powerful servant. This allows the sacred servant to cast ‹spell/lesser planar ally› once per week as a spell-like ability without having to pay the material component cost or the servant (for reasonable tasks)." l12="This improves to ‹spell/planar ally›." l16="This improves to ‹spell/greater planar ally›." special="The sacred servant's caster level for this effect is equal to her paladin level." replace="Aura of resolve"}

name: Sacred Shield
description: ## Sacred Shield ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/65› When faced by evil, the sacred shield reaches first not for a weapon, but for her trusty shield. With her faith, she can ward others from harm. ::ab[Bastion of Good (Su)]{l=1 icon=protect-def ability="A sacred shield can call upon the powers of good to defend her and her allies against evil. This ability functions as *smite evil,* except that the paladin gains no benefit on attack or damage rolls against her target. Instead, any attacks the target makes against allies within 10 feet of the paladin deal half damage. Attacks against the paladin deal full damage, but the paladin gains a deflection bonus to her AC against attacks made by the target of the smite. @B-4f-paladin + her Charisma bonus (if any)." special="As with *smite evil,* if the paladin targets a creature that is not evil, her *bastion of good* ability is wasted with no effect. Feats, abilities, and the like that increase a paladin's number of uses of *smite evil* per day increase a sacred shield's uses of *bastion of good* per day." replace="Smite evil"} ::ab[Holy Shield (Su)]{icon=protect l4="A sacred shield can channel her faith into her shield, protecting any nearby allies. All allies adjacent to the paladin gain a shield bonus equal to the sacred shield's own shield bonus, including any increase from the shield's enhancement bonus. This bonus does not stack with any existing shield bonuses. The paladin herself radiates light as a ‹spell/light› spell while the shielding is active." l11="This protection expands to cover any allies within 10 feet and the radiance increases to the effects of a ‹spell/daylight› spell." l20="Any allies within 20 feet are protected." special="Using this ability consumes two uses of the sacred shield's *lay on hands* ability, and the effects last for 3 rounds plus a number of rounds equal to her Charisma bonus (if any)." replace="Channel positive energy"} ::ab[Divine Bond (Su)]{l=5 icon=def-warning order=usn flavor="Instead of forming a *divine bond* with her weapon or a mount, a sacred shield forms a bond with her shield." standard="A sacred shield can enhance her shield by calling on the aid of a celestial spirit. This bond lasts for 1 minute per paladin level. When called, the spirit causes the shield to shed light like a ‹eq-misc/torch›. The spirit grants the shield a +1 enhancement bonus." increment="The shield's bonus~5~3" special="These bonuses can be added to the shield, stacking with existing enhancement bonuses to a maximum of +5, or they can be used to add any of the following armor special abilities: ‹magic-enh/arrow deflection›, ‹magic-enh/bashing›, ‹magic-enh/blinding›, ‹magic-enh/fortification› (any), ‹magic-enh/reflecting›, and ‹magic-enh/spell resistance› (any). The *reflecting* enhancement may be used once each time the sacred shield makes use of her *divine bond.*~~~Adding these armor special abilities consumes an amount of bonus equal to the property's cost. These bonuses are added to any properties the shield already has, but duplicate special abilities do not grant any extra benefit. If the shield is not magical, at least a +1 enhancement bonus must be added before any other special abilities can be added.~~~The bonus and special abilities granted by the spirit are determined when the spirit is called and cannot be changed until the spirit is called again. The celestial spirit imparts no bonuses if the shield is used by anyone other than the sacred shield, but it resumes giving bonuses if the sacred shield resumes using the shield." useInc=paladin~4~5 useF="5~1~4" info="If a shield with a celestial spirit is destroyed, the sacred shield loses the use of this ability for 30 days, or until she gains a level, whichever comes first. During this period, the sacred shield takes a -1 penalty to her armor class and on saving throws."} ::ab[Improved Bastion]{l=11 icon=aura ability="The radius of a sacred shield's *bastion of good* ability increases to 20 feet." replace="Aura of justice"} ::ab[Perfect Bastion]{l=20 icon=aid passive="A sacred shield and her allies within 20 feet gain ‹umr/regeneration› 10 against the target of her *bastion of good* ability (essentially regeneration that is overcome by any damage not caused by the target)." replace="Holy champion"}

name: Shining Knight
description: ## Shining Knight ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/117› While paladins often are seen mounted atop a loyal steed, the shining knight is the true symbol of mounted bravery. They are never far from their steeds and are always clad in brightly polished armor. The shining knight has the following class features. ::ab[Skilled Rider (Ex and Su)]{l=3 icon=boost passive="A shining knight does not take any penalty to her Ride skill due to her armor check penalty. In addition, any mount she is riding gains the benefit of her *divine grace* class feature, adding her Charisma bonus (if any) to its saving throws." replace="Divine health"} ::ab[Divine Bond (Su)]{icon=info l5="A shining knight must form a bond with a mount. This ability otherwise functions as the paladin ability." alter="Divine bond"} ::ab[Knight's Charge (Su)]{l=11 icon=def-protect-lower ability="Whenever a mounted shining knight charges a foe, her movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity, for either her or her mount." order=a2 ability2="If her target is also the target of her *smite evil* ability and the charge attack hits, the target must make a Will save or be ‹misc/panicked› for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 the shining knight's level. The DC of this save is equal to 10 + 1/2 the shining knight's level + the shining knight's Charisma modifier." replace="Aura of justice"}

name: Undead Scourge
description: ## Undead Scourge ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/117› Undead are an abomination in the eyes of the just and righteous. It is no surprise then that there are some paladins that dedicate themselves to wiping these unholy terrors from the world. The following are the class features of the undead scourge. ::ab[Smite Evil (Su)]{icon=down-boost info="This functions as the paladin ability of the same name, but the undead scourge does not deal 2 points of damage per level on the first successful attack against evil dragons and evil outsiders. She does deal 2 points of damage per level on all smite attacks made against evil undead creatures."} ::ab[Aura of Life (Su)]{l=8 icon=aura-lower passive="An undead scourge emits a 10-foot aura of life around her that weakens undead creatures. Undead in this aura take a -4 penalty on Will saves made to resist positive energy. In addition, undead in this aura do not regain hit points from channeled negative energy." replace="Aura of resolve"} ::ab[Undead Annihilation (Su)]{l=11 icon=melee standard="An undead scourge can expend one use of her *smite evil* ability and make a single melee attack against an undead creature. If this attack hits, the undead creature must make a Will save or be destroyed. The save DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 the undead scourge's level + the undead scourge's Charisma modifier." special="Undead with twice as many Hit Dice as the undead scourge are unaffected by this ability. If the attack misses, the *smite evil* is wasted without effect." replace="Aura of justice"}

name: Warrior of the Holy Light
description: ## Warrior of the Holy Light ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/118› Some paladins use their gifts to focus on the holy light that shines within their souls. With the gifts of purity and redemption, these paladins spend much of their lives helping others find the true path. Unleashing this power takes patience and comes at a steep price. Warriors of the holy light have the following class features. ::ab[Power of Faith (Su)]{icon=down-boost-def-protect-aid info="A warrior of the holy light learns to use the power of her faith to bolster her defenses and aid her allies. A warrior of the holy light does not gain any spells or spellcasting abilities, does not have a caster level, and cannot use spell trigger or spell completion magic items." repeat="The warrior of the holy light gains one additional use of her *lay on hands* ability per day.~4~4" imp4="She can spend a use of her *lay on hands* ability to call upon the power of her faith as a @HLstandard_action. This causes a nimbus of light to emanate from the warrior of the holy light in a 30-foot radius. All allies in this area (including the warrior of the holy light) receive a +1 morale bonus to AC and on attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throws against fear as long as they remain in the area of light. This power lasts for 1 minute." imp8="The nimbus of light heals the paladin and her allies, curing of them of 1d4 points of ability damage, as per the spell ‹spell/lesser restoration›. A creature can only be healed in this way once per day." imp12="The nimbus of light is treated as ‹spell/daylight› for the purposes of affecting creatures with sensitivity to light. In addition, the nimbus grants the warrior of the holy light and her allies in the area ‹umr/resistance› 10 to one type of energy, selected by the warrior of the holy light when this power is activated." imp16="The nimbus of light grants the warrior of the holy light and her allies protection from critical hits. There is a 25% chance that critical hits made against the warrior of the holy light and her allies in the area are instead treated as normal hits. This does not stack with other abilities that grant similar protection (such as ‹magic-enh/light fortification›)." imp20="The nimbus of light increases in size out to a range of 60 feet. In addition, all of its bonuses increase. The morale bonus to AC and on attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throws against fear increases to +2. The amount of ability damage healed increases to 2d4. The energy resistance increases to 20 against one energy type. Finally, protection against critical hits increases to 50%." replace=Spells} ::ab[Shining Light (Su)]{l=14 icon=aura-lower-aid standard="Once per day, a warrior of the holy light can unleash a 30-foot ‹misc/burst› of pure, white light. Evil creatures within this burst take 1d6 points of damage for every two paladin levels and are ‹misc/blinded› for 1 round. Evil dragons, evil outsiders, and evil undead are blinded for 1d4 rounds on a failed save. A Reflex save halves this damage and negates the blindness. The DC of this save is equal to 10 + 1/2 the warrior of the holy light's level + the warrior of the holy light's Charisma modifier." special="Good creatures within this burst are healed 1d6 points of damage per two paladin levels and receive a +2 sacred bonus on ability checks, attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks for 1 round." useInc=paladin~3~14 useF="14~1~3" replace="Aura of faith"}

name: Wilderness Warden
description: ## Wilderness Warden ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/71› Wilderness wardens are vigilant guardians of natural places of all kinds, from mountain peaks to tangled thickets. ::cskill{gain=climb~kg~kna~sur~swim lose=diplo~heal~kno~spc} ::ab[Natural Defense (Su)]{l=2 icon=def ability="Once per day, a wilderness warden can grant herself energy resistance 10 to cold, electricity, or fire and a +2 insight bonus to her CMD for a number of minutes equal to her paladin level." incrementMulti="The energy resistance increases to ~ and the CMD bonus increases to +~.~0/5;15/5;3/1" replace="Divine grace"} ::ab[Smite Evil (Su)]{icon=down-boost l4="A wilderness warden gains this ability at 4th level, and it functions at her paladin level - 3. She can expend a daily use of *smite evil* to gain an additional daily use of *natural defense.* She deals additional damage on her first successful attack when the target of her *smite evil* is an evil fey, humanoid (giant), magical beast, or monstrous humanoid, rather than an evil dragon, outsider (evil), or undead." alter="Smite evil"} ::ab[Aura of Comfort (Ex)]{l=3 icon=def-protect passive="A wilderness warden is comfortable in nearly any climate, as if she were affected by a constant ‹spell/endure elements› spell, and she and allies within 10 feet of her gain a +4 bonus on Constitution checks and saving throws to resist fatigue; exhaustion; and the effects of hunger, thirst, and hot or cold climates (including from magical effects)." replace="Aura of courage"} ::ab[Favored Terrain (Ex)]{l=3 icon=power ability="A wilderness warden selects a ‹ability/favored terrain›, as per the ‹class/ranger› class feature." repeat="She selects an additional favored terrain, and the bonuses she gains in her previous favored terrain(s) increase by 2.~9~6" replace="3rd-, 9th-, and 15th-level mercies"} ::ab[Spells]{icon=learn-magic passive="For each level of spell she can cast, a wilderness warden can prepare and cast one spell per day from the ‹main/druid spell« list› rather than the paladin spell list." alter=Spells} ::ab[Aura of Purity (Su)]{l=8 icon=def-protect passive="A wilderness warden gains immunity to poison. Each ally within 10 feet gains a +2 bonus on saving throws against disease and poison." replace="Aura of resolve"} ::ab[Natural Shield (Su)]{l=11 icon=protect ability="A wilderness warden can expend two daily uses of her *natural defense* ability to grant the benefits of that ability to all nonevil allies within 10 feet for 1 minute." replace="Aura of justice"}

name: Battle Scout
description: ## Battle Scout ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/66› Armies need clean water, safe routes, and intelligence about their enemies. Though regular outdoorsmen might suffice in many cases, some large forces look to battle scouts to keep the body of their troops safe and prepared for the terrain and whatever dangers that terrain hides. ::ab[Hunter's Bond (Ex)]{l=4 icon=down info="When a battle scout gains the *hunter's bond* ability, he must choose to bond with his companions. Battle scouts do not have animal companions." alter="Hunter's bond"} ::ab[Advantageous Terrain (Ex)]{head l=5 icon=power ability="When a battle scout is within one of his *favored terrains,* he can spend up to 3 consecutive rounds studying an area of terrain to gain the benefits below. Each round of studying terrain is a @HLstandard_action. During the first round of studying terrain, the battle scout designates a 60-foot-radius-‹misc/burst› area from a single square within line of sight. Depending on how many rounds the battle scout spends studying the area, he or his allies gain the following benefits for 10 minutes per ranger level he possesses. (For example, if he spends 2 rounds, he or his allies gain the first two benefits.)" replace="2nd favored enemy"} ::ab[1st Round]{next icon=boost passive="Allies within line of sight and that can hear the battle scout gain a +2 bonus on initiative checks while within the *advantageous terrain* area."} ::ab[2nd Round]{next icon=boost passive="Allies within line of sight and that can hear the battle scout gain a +2 on Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks while within the *advantageous terrain* area."} ::ab[3rd Round]{next icon=boost ability="The battle scout's movement is not hampered by ‹rule/difficult terrain› while within the *advantageous terrain* area. Furthermore, the battle scout can take 10 on Climb and Swim checks and checks to jump while within the area, even when in immediate danger or distracted."} ::ab[Infiltration (Ex)]{l=10 icon=boost ability="Once per day, a battle scout can choose a single terrain type that is not his *favored terrain.* For the next hour per ranger level, he treats that terrain as if it were one of his *favored terrains.*" replace="3rd favored enemy"} ::ab[Superior Tactics (Ex)]{l=15 icon=roll ability="Once per day, after a battle scout and his allies roll initiative, the battle scout can arrange his and his allies' initiative rolls any way he wishes. If he has already taken 3 rounds to scout out the terrain with his *advantageous terrain* ability and both he and his allies are within the effect area, they gain a +2 bonus to initiative checks. Using this ability is not an action." replace="4th favored enemy"} ::ab[Perfect Advantage (Ex)]{l=20 icon=boost ability="When using his *advantageous terrain* ability, a battle scout needs only to study the terrain as a @HLstandard_action to gain all of the benefits. Furthermore, the area of his *advantageous terrain* increases to a 1-mile-radius ‹misc/spread› from the single square within line of sight." replace="Master hunter"}

name: Beast Master
description: ## Beast Master ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/124› Some rangers, particularly those in primitive lands or who were raised by animals, have unusually strong bonds with animals. Unique among rangers, they can bond with multiple animals of any kind, creating a menagerie of wild yet loyal creatures, like a strange family. A beast master has the following class features. ::cskill{gain=acro~ea lose=kd~kg~prof~spc} ::ab[Animal Companion (Ex)]{l=4 icon=power ability="A beast master forms a close bond with an ‹sidekick/animal companion›.@FN1 This ability functions like the druid ‹ability/animal companion› ability except that the ranger's effective druid level is equal to his ranger level - 3. The ranger gains a +2 bonus on *wild empathy* and Handle Animal checks made regarding his animal companion. Unlike a normal ranger, a beast master's choice of animal companion is not limited to a subset of all possibile animal companion choices - he may choose freely among all animal companion choices, just as a druid can." info="The beast master may have more than one animal companion, but he must divide up his effective druid level between his companions to determine the abilities of each companion. For example, a beast master with an effective druid level of 4 can have one 4th-level companion, two 2nd-level companions, or one 1st-level and one 3rd-level companion." ability2="Each time a beast master's effective druid level increases, he must decide how to allocate the increase among his animal companions (including the option of adding a new 1st-level companion). Once an effective druid level is allocated to a particular companion, it cannot be redistributed while that companion is in the ranger's service (he must release a companion or wait until a companion dies to allocate its levels to another companion)." special="The *share spells* animal companion ability does not give the ranger the ability to cast a single spell so that it affects all of his animal companions." order=an2 replace="Hunter's bond"} ::ab[Improved Empathic Link (Su)]{icon=power l=6 icon=power ability="The beast master gains@FN1-2 an empathic link with all of his animal companions. This functions like an empathic link with a ‹sidekick/familiar›, except the ranger can also see through a companion's eyes as a @HLswift_action, maintaining this connection as long as he likes (as long as the companion is within 1 mile) and ending it as a @HLfree_action." special="The ranger can only see through the eyes of one companion at a time, and is ‹misc/blinded› while maintaining this connection." replace="6th-level combat style feat"} ::ab[Strong Bond (Ex)]{l=12 icon=boost ability="The ranger strengthens his bond with his animal companions. The ranger's effective druid level for his animal companions is now equal to his ranger level; he may immediately allocate these additional levels to his companions as he sees fit." replace=Camouflage} :::fakeFootnotes @FN[The text does not specify when these abilities are granted. The listed levels are an educated guess, equal to the same level of the features they are replacing.]{from=1 multi=2} :::

name: Code Runner
description: ## Code Runner ‹SOURCE Ultimate Intrigue/40› A code runner specializes in the subtle and speedy transfer of secret messages. He performs long runs between distant lands, sometimes spanning continents and often traversing difficult terrain. He trains his mind both to memorize long messages and to resist any attempts to steal his covert communiques. ::cskill{gain=kl~ling lose=ha~heal} ::ab[Mnemonic Genius (Ex)]{flavor="A code runner learns to memorize and accurately recall information, even if he does not speak or understand the language in which the information was presented." ability="The code runner can spend 1 hour and attempt a DC 15 Linguistics check to memorize a single passage of up to 150 words of information in a language he speaks. For every 5 by which he exceeds the DC, he can memorize 150 additional words. The DC is increased by 10 if the message is encoded or in a language he doesn't understand." icon=power special="A code runner can memorize one such message at any given time. If he fails to memorize a message, he can retry as many times as he wants, as long as he spends 1 hour each time. Once a message has been memorized, he can recall it with perfect accuracy until he memorizes a different message." replace="Wild empathy"} ::ab[Resist Interrogation (Ex)]{icon=def l4="A code runner gains a bonus equal to half his ranger level on saving throws against divination effects." l11="If he succeeds at a saving throw against a divination effect that would grant its caster knowledge or information, the caster is not aware that the saving throw was successful, and the code runner can attempt a Bluff check opposed by the caster's Sense Motive check in order to send false information to the caster." replace="Hunter's bond"}

name: Dandy
description: ## Dandy ‹SOURCE Ultimate Intrigue/41› The antithesis of the gruff and wild woodsmen, a dandy takes effort to master the subtle etiquette of noble courts, the whispers of dark rumors, and the customs of the cultured world. Nonetheless, he is still a ranger at heart, and he hunts for rumors and gossip throughout the grand ballrooms of the wealthy and powerful just as most rangers hunt for enemies in the wilderness. ::cskill{gain=bluff~diplo~kl~kno~sm lose=ha~kd~kg~kna~sur} ::ab[Favored Nation (Ex)]{icon=power order=ca choice="Each time he would select a *favored enemy,* a dandy instead selects a country with whose courtly graces he is wholly versed and studied. He gains a +2 bonus on Bluff, Diplomacy, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks against courtiers, officials, nobles, and gentry from that nation. Likewise, he gains a +2 bonus on weapon attack and damage rolls against them." ability="A dandy can attempt the appropriate Knowledge checks untrained to identify such people from the selected country." special="A dandy gains additional favored nations, and can increase the bonuses of one of his current favored nations, in the same way he would with a normal ranger's *favored enemy.*" replace="Favored enemy"} :::ab{title="Rumor Empathy (Ex)" action=Ability icon=power replace="Wild empathy"} A dandy can alter the flow and spread of ‹rule/rumors› in his favor. This functions similarly to *wild empathy,* except that it takes 1 day (8 hours of work), instead of 1 minute, and it affects the general tenor of a rumor instead of a wild animal. A successful *rumor empathy* check allows the dandy to increase or decrease the rumor's tone by one step. For example, he could make an indifferent rumor friendly and thus positive toward its target, or an unfriendly rumor hostile and thus even more negative toward its target than it was originally. The difficulty of influencing a rumor depends on the size of the community in which it is spreading. The DC of the check is 15 in a village or smaller settlement. This DC increases by 5 and the number of days required to attempt the check increases by 2 for every ‹rule/settlement« size category<s_and_districts› larger than a village - to a maximum of DC 40 and 11 days to affect a rumor spreading through an entire metropolis. If the rumor is only spreading through a smaller segment of the population, such as the elven district in a larger metropolis, use the population of that smaller segment to determine the DC and number of days of work required to use *rumor empathy.* The DC also increases by 10 if the rumor is about the dandy himself, since the dandy is obviously a biased source with respects to rumors about his own person. ::: ::ab[Favored Terrain (Ex)]{l=3 icon=down ability="A dandy gains *favored terrain (urban),* and though the ability continues to increase at the same levels, he doesn't add additional terrains." imp8="Whenever he is at a courtly function or party, his *favored terrain* bonuses increase by an additional 2." alter="Favored terrain"} ::ab[Hobnob (Ex)]{l=4 icon=down-boost info="A dandy must choose his allies as his *hunter's bond,* not an animal companion." ability="In addition to the usual *hunter's bond* ability, the dandy can spend 10 minutes at a particular event or party hobnobbing and introducing his allies to the right people in order to provide them with half the skill bonuses of his favored nation (though not the bonuses on attack and damage rolls) for the duration of the event." order=na alter="Hunter's bond"} ::ab[Dandy Spells (Su)]{l=4 icon=magic flavor="The dandy gains a different sort of spellcasting than most rangers." info="A dandy uses his Charisma instead of his Wisdom to determine spells per day, DCs, and other factors related to spellcasting. He casts spells spontaneously from the ‹main/bard spell« list› (rather than the ranger spell list) with the same number of spells known and spells per day as a ‹class/medium› of his ranger level." alter=Spellcasting} ::ab[Party Crasher (Ex)]{l=7 icon=power ability="The dandy is able to finagle his way into fancy parties, kings' balls, and other social events meant for the cream of society. To do so, he must attempt a DC 25 Diplomacy check, which takes 1d4 hours. If he succeeds, he finds himself an invitation, an invitee looking for a date, a staff member willing to look the other way, or some other way to enter the party. This does not allow him to break into restricted areas or to infiltrate strictly closed gatherings, such as secret meetings; it only allows him access to social events." replace="Woodland stride"}

name: Deep Walker
description: ## Deep Walker ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/66› Some rangers devote their lives to the woods, becoming hunters, protectors, and wilderness guides among its diverse terrain types. The deep walker is instead a master of the strange terrain of the deep earth, exploring its caverns and caves, becoming a master of the dark corridors most surface dwellers fear to explore - and perhaps the reason they fear to explore them. ::ab[Deep Knowledge (Ex)]{l=3 icon=boost passive="A deep walker gains a +2 bonus on initiative checks and Knowledge (dungeoneering), Perception, Stealth, and Survival skill checks while underground (in caves and dungeons)." increment="The bonus~3~5~5~3" replace="Favored terrain"} ::ab[Rock Hopper (Ex)]{l=7 icon=boost flavor="A deep walker instinctively grasps for the most stable surfaces and holds on tighter while moving over underground rock and stone." ability="The deep walker gains a +5 bonus on all Acrobatics and Climb checks made to traverse underground terrain. Furthermore, the deep walker ignores ‹rule/difficult terrain› created by underground terrain and subterranean flora." replace="Woodland stride"} ::ab[Deep Walker Camouflage (Ex)]{l=12 icon=power ability="A deep walker can use the Stealth skill to hide in underground environments, even if the terrain does not grant cover or concealment." replace=Camouflage} ::ab[One with the Stone (Ex)]{l=17 icon=power ability="A deep walker can use the Stealth skill while he is underground, even when being observed." replace="Hide in plain sight"}

name: Falconer
description: ## Falconer ‹SOURCE Ultimate Combat/67› Rangers have always enjoyed a special bond with a specific animal, but the falconer takes this bond to a deeper level. Falconers begin with their companion earlier than other rangers, and have the ability to teach their companions special tricks. ::ab[Feathered Companion (Ex)]{l=1 icon=power ability="A falconer earns the trust and companionship of a bird of prey. The bird can be of any type of large hunting or scavenging bird (even a vulture). This ability functions like the druid ‹ability/animal companion› ability (which is part of the *nature bond* class feature), but the falconer must take the ‹companion/bird› (or ‹companion/falcon›) ‹sidekick/animal companion›, and that companion has only half the normal hit points." special="The falconer cannot teach the bird of prey the *work* trick, but can teach it either the *roam* or *distract* trick for free. Whichever trick the falconer does not pick then can be picked as a trick later." head replace="Wild empathy"} ::ab[Roam (DC 15)]{next icon=power ability="The falconer can let his animal companion loose to roam and forage. He must let it roam for no more than a week. When the falconer lets it roam, it agrees to return to the place he let it loose within the time period he designates."} ::ab[Distract (DC 20; bird only)]{next icon=melee ability="The animal companion flutters wildly around any enemy it would normally attack with the *attack* trick. It makes an attack roll against that enemy. On a hit, the enemy is ‹misc/shaken› for 1 round."} ::ab[Hunter's Bond (Ex)]{l=4 icon=down-boost ability="A falconer must select an animal companion when he gains *hunter's bond.* He does not gain a new companion at 4th level; rather, his feathered companion gains full hit points."} ::ab[Swoop for the Kill (Ex)]{head l=6 icon=power ability="When outdoors, a falconer can direct his feathered companion to strike an enemy from high above. His feathered companion gains the following trick as a bonus trick." replace="6th-level combat style feat"} ::ab[Swooping Charge (DC 20; bird)]{next icon=melee ability="The falconer's bird companion flies up and then swoops down into a charge. To perform this trick, the companion must be able to fly, and it must be outdoors or someplace with enough room for the bird to fly great distances in (a grand cathedral may have enough room, but dungeons usually do not). It spends a @HLfull-round_action flying to a high vantage point, and on the next round makes a ‹rule/charge› attack upon an enemy the falconer designates. If that charge attack hits, the bird deals 2d4 points of damage instead of 1d4 with its bite and gains a &times&4 critical modifier when making the attack. If the bird hits, the target is ‹misc/staggered› for 1 round."}

name: Flamewarden
description: ## Flamewarden ‹SOURCE Ultimate Wilderness/72› Emulating the blazing phoenix, flamewardens sweep through the world like a selective forest fire, burning away corruption, evil, and those who cling to decay. ::ab[Touch of Flame (Su)]{l=4 icon=boost flavor="A flamewarden can cause his weapons to burst into flame." standard="The ranger can grant a single weapon he holds the ‹magic-enh/flaming› special ability for 1 minute; while under this effect, the weapon counts as magic for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction." useMod=Wisdom3 imp12="Weapons affected by this ability gain the ‹magic-enh/flaming burst› special ability instead." replace="Hunter's bond"} ::ab[Spells]{icon=learn info="A flamewarden can prepare spells from the ‹main/spells_>druid« list› that have the fire descriptor." alter=Spells} ::ab[Stoking the Embers (Sp)]{l=9 icon=aid flavor="A flamewarden can fan the last spark of a recently slain creature's life force back into a full flame." standard="Once per day, a flamewarden can touch the corpse of a creature that has died within 1 round to grant it the effects of ‹spell/breath of life›." replace=Evasion} ::ab[Burning Renewal (Su)]{l=12 icon=def order=ua2 flavor="A flamewarden can use the cleansing power of fire to remove afflictions from his body, mind, and soul." useMod=Wisdom3 ability="When the flamewarden takes 5 or more points of fire damage, he can remove one of the following conditions: fatigued, shaken, or sickened. Alternatively, he can remove 1 point of ‹rule/ability damage› or drain from an ability score of his choice." ability2="If the flamewarden takes 10 or more points of fire damage, he can remove one of the following conditions: exhausted, frightened, or nauseated. Alternatively, he can remove 1d6 points of ability damage or drain from an ability score of his choice." special="The ranger can use this ability only once each time he takes fire damage, regardless of how much damage it deals over the required amount. If the flamewarden has fire ‹umr/resistance› or ‹umr/immunity› to fire, fire damage he would have otherwise taken still counts toward activating *burning renewal.*" replace=Camouflage} ::ab[Phoenix Rising (Su)]{l=16 icon=aura-magic-aid passive="If a flamewarden dies, his body explodes in a conflagration in a 20-foot ‹misc/spread›. Each hostile creature in the area takes 10d6 points of fire damage unless it succeeds at a Reflex save (DC = 10 + half the ranger's level + his Constitution modifier) for half damage. The flames don't harm the flamewarden's allies, who instead are healed 5d6 points of damage, and any poisons they are currently suffering are neutralized as per ‹spell/neutralize poison›. The flamewarden's body is reduced to ashes by the explosion." imp20="The flamewarden gains immunity to fire, and once per week, the flamewarden rises from the ashes of his own destruction 1 round after dying. The flamewarden's body re-forms with all his equipment, and he returns to life with half his maximum hit points. Any ability scores that were 0 become 1, and nonmagical diseases and poisons are cured. A ‹spell/limited wish›, ‹spell/miracle›, or ‹spell/wish› spell cast before he rises from the ashes prevents him from doing so, as does the area of an ‹spell/unhallow› effect." replace="Improved evasion~master hunter"}

name: Guide
description: ## Guide ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/125› Many rangers are loners, but some choose to use their familiarity with the land to guide others safely through the wilderness. The guide forgoes a *favored enemy* to focus on the task or foe at hand, and can pass his knowledge and luck on to his charges. A guide has the following class features. ::ab[Ranger's Focus (Ex)]{l=1 icon=boost swift="The guide can focus on a single enemy within line of sight. That creature remains the ranger's focus until it is reduced to 0 or fewer hit points or surrenders, or until the ranger designates a new focus, whichever occurs first. The ranger gains a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls against the target of his focus." increment="This bonus~0~5~4~2" useInc=ranger~3~1 useF="1~1~3" replace="Favored enemy"} ::ab[Terrain Bond (Ex)]{l=4 icon=boost-power flavor="The guide forms a bond with the land itself, enabling him to direct others in such terrain." passive="When in his *favored terrain,* the ranger grants all allies within line of sight and that can hear him a +2 bonus on initiative checks and Perception, Stealth, and Survival skill checks." order=pa ability="As long as they travel with him, the ranger's allies leave no trail and can't be tracked. The ranger can choose for the group to leave a trail, or even specific members of the group to leave a trail if he so desires." replace="Hunter's bond"} ::ab[Ranger's Luck (Ex)]{icon=roll l9="The guide can either reroll one of his attack rolls or force an enemy who just hit him with an attack to reroll the attack roll. The ranger must take the result of the second roll even if it is worse." useInc=ranger~5~9 useF="9~1~5" replace=Evasion} ::ab[Inspired Moment (Ex)]{l=11 icon=power-boost free="The guide can have an inspired moment once per day. The ranger gains the following benefits until the end of his next turn. His speed increases by 10 feet. He can take an extra @HLmove or @HLswift_action on his turn. He gains a +4 bonus to AC and on attack rolls, skill checks, or ability checks. Finally, he automatically confirms any critical threat he scores." imp19="He can use this ability twice a day." replace="Quarry~improved quarry"} ::ab[Improved Ranger's Luck (Ex)]{icon=roll-boost l16="The ranger's luck increases. He gains a +4 bonus on his rerolls made with the *ranger's luck* ability, or if he forces an enemy to reroll an attack, that enemy takes a -4 penalty on the roll. This bonus or penalty is also applied on any roll to confirm critical hits." replace="Improved evasion"}

name: Guildbreaker
description: ## Guildbreaker ‹SOURCE Ultimate Intrigue/41› Some rangers aren't the type to put their steel and sweat behind fighting particular kinds of creatures. Instead, these shrewd warriors alter their focus and dedicate their efforts to dismantling enemy organizations. Guildbreakers stoke their enmity for their foes, and they train to track the movements of rival organizations, and even to infiltrate these groups to gather secret intelligence. ::cskill{gain=bluff~dis~kl lose=ha~heal~kg} ::ab[Favored Organization (Ex)]{icon=down-power ability="When a guildbreaker selects a *favored enemy,* he can opt to select a specific organization, such as a particular thieves' guild, in lieu of a specific creature type. The guildbreaker must select this option for his first *favored enemy,* but he can choose either option for his later *favored enemies.*" special="The guildbreaker's bonuses from *favored enemy* apply against official members of this organization regardless of their creature type, but not against the organization's allies, paid mercenaries, or forced labor. This ability only applies if the guildbreaker knows that the target is a member of the organization." alter="Favored enemy"} ::ab[Read the City (Ex)]{icon=power flavor="A guildbreaker spends most of his time in cities and large population centers. As a result, he gains an innate sense of comings and goings in the hustle around him." ability="When in an urban environment, a guildbreaker can use the Survival skill to gather information, but only about the movements of creatures and what sort of people (races, social classes, predominant professions, and the like) occupy the community. Unlike with the normal way to gather information, the guildbreaker studies the signs of the city instead of asking around, so it doesn't spread word about the nature of his questions to others." replace="Wild empathy"} ::ab[Deep Cover (Ex, Su)]{icon=boost-def flavor="Guildbreakers may work to dismantle their enemies' power structures from within, and they know how to gather resources and the necessary trappings in order to masquerade as a member of those organizations." l=4 passive="A guildbreaker adds a circumstance bonus equal to twice his *favored organization* bonus to all Bluff and Disguise checks to appear to be a member of the organization (this does not apply on Disguise checks to change his appearance and replace a specific member, but rather to checks related to appear to be a general member of the organization)." special="The bonus on Bluff checks from *deep cover* stacks with the guildbreaker's overall bonus from *favored organization* if the person he is attempting to deceive is also a member of that organization.~~~A guildbreaker posing as a member of one of his *favored enemy* organizations automatically defeats truth-telling magic (as if under the effects of ‹spell/glibness›), but only for the purpose of claiming to be a member of the organization. Truth-telling magic can still expose him with a more indirect question, such as a member of a non-religious evil organization asking the guildbreaker for the identity of his patron deity." replace="Hunter's bond"} ::ab[Crowd Stride (Ex)]{icon=boost l7="A guildbreaker can slip through crowded streets with ease. His movement speed is not reduced when moving through a crowd." replace="Woodland stride"}

name: Horse Lord
description: ## Horse Lord ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/125› Rangers of the plains use horses or other riding beasts to hunt their lands, forging a near-mystical relationship with their mounts. Horse lords are unparalleled mounted combatants, the envy of even the most dedicated cavalier. Though called "horse lords" as a generic term, these rangers are not restricted to horses for their animal companions - any creature the ranger can ride is included in these abilities. A horse lord has the following class features. ::ab[Combat Style Feat (Ex)]{l=2 icon=down choice="A horse lord must choose the mounted ‹ability/combat style<s›."} ::ab[Mounted Bond (Ex)]{l=4 icon=power-boost order=ap ability="The horse lord forms a bond with an animal he can use as a mount, which becomes his ‹sidekick/animal companion›. A Medium ranger can select a ‹companion/camel› or a ‹companion/horse›. A small ranger can select a ‹companion/pony› or ‹companion/wolf›, but can also select a ‹companion/boar› or ‹companion/dog› if he is at least 7th level. This ability functions like the druid ‹ability/animal companion› ability except that the ranger's effective druid level is equal to his ranger level - 3." passive="The ranger gains a +2 bonus on Handle Animal and Ride checks with his animal companion mount." replace="Hunter's bond"} ::ab[Strong Bond (Ex)]{l=12 icon=boost flavor="The horse lord strengthens his bond with his mount." ability="The ranger's effective druid level for his mount is now equal to his ranger level." replace=Camouflage} ::ab[Spiritual Bond (Su)]{l=17 icon=boost-protect ability="The horse lord can grant his animal companion ‹rule/temporary hit points› equal to his ranger level once per day. While these temporary hit points last, when his mount is within 30 feet of the him, he can choose to share the damage taken by his mount as if using ‹spell/shield other›." replace="Hide in plain sight"}

name: Infiltrator
description: ## Infiltrator ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/125› Some rangers study their *favored enemies* and learn their ways, applying this knowledge to their own abilities and using their foes' strengths against them. Infiltrators are willing to walk a mile in an enemy's shoes so as to learn eveything there is to know about their foes in order to more effectively hunt and kill them. ::ab[Adaptation (Ex)]{l=3 head icon=power-def flavor="An infiltrator learns how to copy the unusual abilities of his prey." useL=ranger~10 useUnit=minute useNC=10 ability="He chooses one type of creature he has selected as a *favored enemy,* such as &quot&aberrations.&quot& The ranger selects one ability or feat from the adaptation list for that type (see below). If the adaptation requires the ranger to make a more specific choice (such as what skill to use with ‹feat/Skill Focus›), this choice is permanent and cannot be changed." repeatAt="The ranger chooses another one of his *favored enemy* types and selects one adaptation from that type's list, as well as an additional adaptation from any one list of a creature type he's selected (including the one just chosen, if so desired).~8~13~15" special="The infiltrator can only use one adaptation at a time. The ranger can use the *camouflage* and *hide in plain sight* class features whenever he is using adaptations." replace="Favored terrain"} ::ab[Aberration]{next icon=power-def choice="‹umr/amphibious›, darkvision 60 ft., ‹feat/Iron Will›, natural armor +2."} ::ab[Animal]{next icon=power-def choice="climb 15 ft., darkvision 60 ft., ‹feat/Great Fortitude›, ‹feat/Lightning ft., *‹race/d«efensive training elf› blood,* low-light vision, *‹race/elven› immunities, elven magic, keen senses,* Skill Focus (choose one skill), *weapon familiarity.*"} ::ab[Humanoid (giant)]{next choice="darkvision 60 ft., ‹feat/Exotic Weapon Proficiency› (‹eq-weapon/dire flail›), natural armor +2."} ::ab[Humanoid (gnome)]{next icon=power-def choice="defensive training, *‹race/gnome› magic, name: Sentinel

features.name: Sense Intruder (Su)
features.replaces: Combat style feat gained at 6th level

description: ## Sentinel ‹SOURCE Ultimate Intrigue/42› A sentinel specializes in heightening all of her senses to expose spies and those who work for opposing factions, rooting out all who attempt to slip past her evervigilant watch. Her uncanny skills are in ready demand by city guards, business owners, and even criminal organizations that desire to keep the authorities out of their disreputable affairs. ::ab[Mugshot (Sp)]{icon=boost ability="A sentinel can spend 1 minute studying the appearance of a target or a likeness of the target in the form of a picture, carving, or visual illusion and memorize it with perfect recall. From that point on, the sentinel gains a +4 bonus on Perception checks to notice the target in disguise or pick him out of a crowd. The sentinel is automatically allowed a Perception check against the target's Disguise check whenever she sees the target, even if the individual isn't doing anything to draw attention to himself." special="A sentinel can memorize the appearance of a number of targets equal to her Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) at any given time. Once a sentinel has reached her maximum number of memorized appearances, she must forget one of the memorized faces before gaining a new one." replace="Wild empathy"} ::ab[Uncanny Alertness (Ex)]{l=4 icon=def-power flavor="A sentinel is always ready to defend against incoming attacks." passive="A sentinel is never ‹rule/flat-footed› before acting in combat, even if she is surprised (she can still become flat-footed by any other effect or situation that would render her flat-footed)." imp7="The sentinel also always acts on the surprise round. If she would have acted on the surprise round anyway, or if there is no surprise round, she gains a bonus on initiative checks equal to half her ranger level." replace="Hunter's bond~woodland stride"} ::ab[Sense Intruder (Su)]{l=6 icon=aura flavor="A sentinel gains the ability to establish an incredibly effective watch by standing still and focusing on all of her senses as once." ability="At any time, she can spend 1 minute setting up this ability. Once she has done so, she must stand still, taking no other actions except to keep track of her surroundings; she can't even take free actions like talking. Her heightened senses grant her a supernatural awareness of her surroundings within 20 feet. If any Tiny or larger creature enters the area over which her awareness extends, she automatically knows that it did so (this part of the ability is a divination effect and can't be deceived by spells that block sensory input, only by extreme effects like ‹spell/mind blank›). Furthermore, unless that creature is simultaneously negating its visual, auditory, and scent stimuli (such as by being under ‹spell/invisibility›, ‹spell/silence›, and ‹spell/negate aroma› all at once), the sentinel can attempt a Perception check as an @HLimmediate_action to pinpoint the intruder's location, ignoring any Stealth bonuses the intruder might gain from effects that obscure only one of those senses, such as invisibility, camouflage, or other spells or abilities." imp10="Starting at 10th level, whenever the sentinel gains a combat style feat, she can choose to trade it for a 10-foot increase in the radius of this ability." special="This sort of heightened analysis of sensory stimuli is taxing, as much so as ‹rule/hustling› overland for an equivalent period of time, despite not moving from a single spot. The sentinel can use this ability for 1 hour without penalty. Using *sense intruder* for a second hour in between sleep cycles deals 1 point of nonlethal damage to the sentinel, and each additional hour deals twice the damage taken during the previous hour. A sentinel who takes any nonlethal damage from using this ability becomes ‹misc/fatigued›. Each hour the sentinel uses *sense intruder* also counts as 1 hour of hustling overland for the purpose of determining how much nonlethal damage the sentinel takes in a single day." replace="Combat style feat gained at 6th level" alter="Combat style feats"} ::ab[Mugshot Quarry (Ex)]{l=11 icon=power ability="The sentinel can activate her *quarry* ability (and her *improved quarry* ability at 19th level) against any of the targets she has memorized with the *mugshot* ability, even if the creature in question is not within her line of sight." alter="Quarry~improved quarry"}

name: Shapeshifter
description: ## Shapeshifter ‹SOURCE Advanced Player's Guide/126› Most rangers venture into the wilderness, but there are some who let the wilderness seep into them. Whether by curse, disease, ancient rite, a slight lycanthropic influence in the blood, or the corrupting influence of chaos, these rangers embrace the wild to transform themselves into something untamed and feral. Shapeshifters are often held in awe, but are even more often feared. A shapeshifter has the following class features. ::ab[Combat Style Feat (Ex)]{l=2 icon=down ability="A shapeshifter ranger must choose the natural weapon ‹ability/combat style<s›."} ::ab[Shifter's Blessing (Su)]{head l=3 icon=magic swift="The shapeshifter can take on the aspects of a wild creature once per day. He can remain in this form for a number of rounds equal to his ranger level + his Wisdom modifier. While in one of his shifter's blessing forms, the ranger gains the ‹subtype/shapechanger› subtype." order=wc choice="The shapeshifter must choose one of the following forms. Once this choice is made, it cannot be changed." incrementUse="The ranger may select an additional form for his *shifter's blessing* and~3~5" special="This is not a polymorph ability; a ranger with *shifter's blessing* in one of his shifted forms can be affected by a polymorph ability and retain his bonus and traits gained by the class feature." replace="Favored terrain"} ::ab[Form of the Bear]{next icon=boost-down ability="The ranger's muscles enlarge and tighten, and his facial features become more ursine. While in this form, the ranger gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength, but his base speed becomes 20 feet."} ::ab[Form of the Cat]{next icon=boost ability="The ranger's muscles become lean and defined, and his gait more deliberate and graceful. While in this form, the ranger increases his base speed by 10 feet, and he gains a +4 bonus on Acrobatics and Climb checks."} ::ab[Form of the Dragon]{next icon=def ability="The ranger's skin becomes rough and scaly. While in this form, the ranger gains a +2 natural armor bonus to AC."} ::ab[Form of the Eagle]{next icon=boost ability="The ranger's skin stretches, his nose becomes hooked, and his eyes enlarge. While in this form, the ranger gains a +10 bonus on Perception checks."} ::ab[Form of the Jackal]{next icon=power-def ability="The ranger becomes thin and hyperactive, his movements taking on a nervous spryness. While in this form, the ranger can spend a @HLmove_action to move up to 1/2 his speed without provoking attacks of opportunity."} ::ab[Form of the Otter]{next icon=power-boost ability="The ranger's hands and feet grow webs, and his body grows an oily fur that is water resistant. While in this form, the ranger gains a swim speed of 30 feet and a +8 bonus on Swim checks."} ::ab[Dual Form Shifter (Ex)]{l=12 icon=boost ability="When the shapeshifter takes on a *shifter's blessing* form, he can take on a hybrid of two of his forms. He gains the bonuses for both forms." replace=Camouflage} ::ab[Master Shifter (Su)]{head l=20 icon=boost ability="The ranger's *shifter's blessing* forms improve, and he can take on true forms of beasts. The ranger can use *dual form shifter* with this ability, although he cannot use more than one polymorph effect at any one time. The ranger's forms from *shifter's blessing* improve to the following." replace="Master hunter "} ::ab[Form of the Bear]{next icon=boost-magic ability="The ranger's muscles enlarge and tighten, and his facial features become more ursine. While in this form, the ranger gains a +8 enhancement bonus to Strength and he does not suffer any reduction of speed. Alternatively, the ranger can polymorph into the form of a bear as if the caster of ‹spell/beast shape IV›."} ::ab[Form of the Cat]{next icon=boost-magic ability="The ranger's muscles become lean and defined, and his gait more deliberate and graceful. While in this form, the ranger increases his base speed by 20 feet and he gains a +10 bonus on Acrobatics and Climb checks. Alternatively, the ranger can polymorph into the form of a cat of any size as if the caster of *beast shape IV.*"} ::ab[Form of the Dragon]{next icon=def-power-magic ability="The ranger's skin becomes rough and scaly. While in this form, the ranger gains a +4 natural armor bonus to AC and a fly speed of 30 feet with average maneuverability. Alternately, the ranger can polymorph into the form of a dragon as if the caster of ‹spell/form of the dragon I›."} ::ab[Form of the Eagle]{next icon=boost-power-magic ability="The ranger's skin stretches, his nose becomes hooked, and his eyes enlarge. While in this form, the ranger gains a +10 bonus on Perception checks and a fly speed of 40 feet with good maneuverability.
